izzyondroid:com.onemoresecret.name: OneMoreSecret
izzyondroid:com.onemoresecret.summary: Your phone as a key to your secrets - no master password, no cloud.
izzyondroid:com.onemoresecret.description:
OneMoreSecret is a decentralized secrets manager that leverages your smartphone's hardware keystore and biometric authentication to protect your passwords. Instead of relying on a cloud database, your sensitive data (e.g. passwords, TOTP tokens, files, and Bitcoin private keys are encrypted into QR codes or text payloads that can be safely embedded anywhere — even on a public wiki or plain text file.
 When you need to use a secret, you simply scan the code or tap the link with your phone, authenticate with your fingerprint to decrypt it locally, and the app acts as a virtual Bluetooth keyboard to instantly "auto-type" the password into your computer. This creates a seamless, air-gapped bridge that keeps your private keys entirely offline, protecting your credentials from keyloggers and cloud breaches while making cross-device authentication completely effortless.
 See project home page for detailed introduction and tutorial.

izzyondroid:eu.fulldisclosure.android.lu.name: Android LUKS
izzyondroid:eu.fulldisclosure.android.lu.summary: secure LUKS unlocking using usb accessory mode without typing your LUKS password
izzyondroid:eu.fulldisclosure.android.lu.description:
android-luks is an app that allows secure LUKS unlocking using usb accessory mode without typing your LUKS password.
 The app has two functions: Init and Unlock. Init creates a new random encryption key and securely encrypts it using biometrcs. Unlock gets biometrics, decrypts the key and sends it over USB.
 How to use 
 Install the Android app, install the Linux host program and scripts, initialize the key and plug your phone over USB. Now, when your Linux machine boots, you should see the Android app automatically popping up. As soon as you press "Unlock" button and confirm your biometrics, the boot process will continue without typing in the password.

fdroid:com.manichord.mgit.name: MGit
fdroid:com.manichord.mgit.summary: View and interact with git repositories
fdroid:com.manichord.mgit.description:
MGit is a full featured Git client that allows you to manage files in a local Git repository, clone, push and pull to and from remote repositories. It allows you to browse files in your local repositories, see diffs of changed files, stage and commit files all in your local repository while offline.
Features include:
* Create local repositories
* Clone remote repositories
* Fetch, Pull, Push from remote repositories
* Delete local repositories
* Browse files
* Browse commit messages
* Checkout branches and tags
* HTTP/HTTPS/SSH are supported (including SSH with private key passphrase)

fdroid:com.monuk7735.nope.remote.name: Nope Remote
fdroid:com.monuk7735.nope.remote.summary: Universal IR & Android TV remote control with custom remotes, buttons & macros.
fdroid:com.monuk7735.nope.remote.description:
Nope-Remote is an open-source Android application that turns your smartphone into a powerful, universal remote control for both Infrared (IR) devices and Android TV / Google TV.
Built with modern Android technologies, it offers a sleek Material You interface and advanced features like Custom Remote Creation and Custom Macros to automate your home entertainment system. Even if your phone lacks a built-in IR blaster, you can seamlessly discover and control Android TV devices over Wi-Fi.
Key Features:
- Android TV & Google TV Control: Seamlessly discover (mDNS) or manually connect (by IP/hostname across VLANs) and control Android TVs with saved remotes, secure pairing, directional pad, media playback, text input, and quick app launch shortcuts.
- Universal IR Compatibility: Control TVs, Set-Top Boxes, ACs, and more using your phone's built-in IR blaster.
- Custom Remote Creation: Build fully customized remotes from scratch tailored specifically to your home setup.
- Custom Buttons: Add, customize, and configure buttons on any remote with custom icons, labels, IR codes, and protocols.
- Hardware Volume Button Control: Optionally adjust TV volume directly using your phone's physical volume buttons.
- Custom Macros: Create "Macros" to chain multiple commands together (e.g., Turn on TV, STB, and Soundbar with one tap).
- Offline IR Database: Direct database downloads for seamless offline access without reliance on third-party CDNs.
- Enhanced Repository Support: Expanded support for multiple community repositories and improved setup process.
- Performance: Optimized internal architecture for smoother operation and better maintainability.
- Material You Design: Beautiful, modern UI that adapts to your wallpaper's colors.
- Dark/Light Mode: Fully supports system-wide themes.
- Haptic Feedback: Tactile confirmation for button presses with customizable vibration preferences.

fdroid:com.ritesh.cashiro.name: Cashiro
fdroid:com.ritesh.cashiro.summary: All-In-One Expense-Budget tracker for bank SMS and PDF statements with optional
fdroid:com.ritesh.cashiro.description:
Cashiro — Free & Open-Source, private SMS-powered expense tracker
Automatically extracts transaction data from bank SMS messages and PDF Statements [Gpay & Phonepe UPI] using pattern-based parsing. Works 100% offline - no internet connection required.
Key Features:
• Multi-Source Transaction Extraction - Automatically parses SMS and PDF Statements [Gpay & Phonepe UPI] with pattern-based extraction
• 100% Offline Core Features - Transaction parsing, analytics, and exports work without internet
• Optional AI Chat - Download Qwen 2.5 model (1.5GB, Apache 2.0) for natural language queries
• Dynamic Home Screen - Customizable widgets including heatmaps, analytics, and transaction lists
• Advanced Budgeting - Track historical spending, manage monthly limits, and view subscription trends
• Auto-Categorization - Intelligent merchant cleaning and categorization for clear spending insights
• Data Portability - Export as CSV ; smart backup/restore for all preferences and data
• Premium Material You Design - Sleek interface with blur effects and fully customizable dynamic theming
Currently Supported Banks & Countries (80+ banks across 14 countries):
• India: HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, PNB, IDBI, Indian, Federal, BOB, Canara, etc.
• USA: Citi, Discover, Old Hickory, Charles Schwab, Navy Federal
• UAE: FAB, ADCB, Emirates NBD, Mashreq, Liv Bank
• Nepal: Laxmi Sunrise, Everest, NMB, Siddhartha, Prime Commercial
• Thailand: Bangkok Bank, Kasikorn, SCB, Krungthai, Krungsri, etc.
• Other regions: Ethiopia (CBE), Tanzania (M-Pesa), Kenya (M-PESA), Pakistan, Iran, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Colombia, Belarus.
• Plus payment services like Slice, LazyPay, Jio Pay, and Juspay.
Privacy & Security:
• No internet required for core functionality (SMS parsing, analytics, exports)
• Pattern-based transaction extraction - no AI needed for parsing
• Optional AI chat uses on-device Qwen 2.5 model (Apache 2.0 licensed)
• SMS permission is read-only - we never send messages
• No user accounts or cloud sync required
• Open source - audit the code yourself on GitHub
• Zero data collection or tracking
How It Works:
1. Grant SMS permission (read-only access)
2. App automatically parses bank SMS using regex patterns
3. View categorized transactions, analytics, and subscriptions
4. Optionally download AI model for chat features
Perfect for:
• Automatic daily expense tracking
• Understanding spending patterns and budgeting
• Managing subscription payments
• Financial planning and analysis
• Maintaining detailed transaction records
Technical Notes:
• Core SMS parsing uses regex patterns, not AI
• Optional Qwen 2.5 model (Apache 2.0) for chat feature only
• F-Droid flavor excludes all proprietary dependencies
Cashiro respects your privacy while helping you take control of your finances. Join thousands of users who trust Cashiro for secure, automatic expense tracking without compromising their data.

fdroid:com.worxbend.scenedeck.name: SceneDeck
fdroid:com.worxbend.scenedeck.summary: Control OBS scenes, audio, streaming and recording from your Android device
fdroid:com.worxbend.scenedeck.description:
Turn your Android phone or tablet into an OBS Studio remote control deck.
SCENES
Switch scenes from a numbered grid, search your scene collection, and curate a personal Deck. Use Studio Mode to choose a preview scene and control transitions.
MIXER
Adjust audio levels, watch live meters, mute channels, and lock controls to prevent accidental changes.
OUTPUTS AND STATS
Control streaming, recording and the virtual camera. See live output timers and monitor FPS, bitrate, dropped frames, CPU usage and render time.
YOUR SETUP
Save connection profiles, choose light or dark themes, and adjust motion and confirmation settings. The standard Play/GitHub build also supports OBS connection QR codes; the F-Droid build uses manual connection entry. Optional widgets and background connection support keep useful controls close at hand.
Scene curation stays on your device and does not modify the OBS scene collection.
REQUIREMENTS
Android 9 or later and OBS Studio 28 or later on your computer. Enable the OBS WebSocket server and connect your device to a network that can reach it. SceneDeck controls OBS on your computer; it does not replace OBS Studio or broadcast video directly from your phone.
SceneDeck is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with the OBS Project.

fdroid:eu.berdosi.app.heartbeat.name: HeartBeat
fdroid:eu.berdosi.app.heartbeat.summary: Calculate heart rate from camera image
fdroid:eu.berdosi.app.heartbeat.description:
Simple way to estimate the heart rate. Please do not use it for medical purposes !
This utility works by covering the flash as well as the device's camera with a finger, and waiting for 10 seconds. It works best when the person stays still, and the environment is dark. 
The phone analyzes the amount of red captured by the camera, and attempts to calculate the heart rate based on the subtle changes it detects.
During the measurement, the application shows the current calculation results, and shows the captured data on a line chart.
Once completed, the following further details are shown:
 Standardized values, along with their timestamp (the values are scaled between 0 and 1, and a rolling average is applied for smoothing)
 Timings where a new heart beat is detected.
These data can be shared with other application in order to be exported.

fdroid:info.metadude.android.datenspuren.name: Datenspuren 2026 Schedule

 Let's "aufbrechen" together: boxes, systems and into new worlds!

 https://datenspuren.de

 * Read detailed descriptions (speaker names, start time, room name, links, ...) of sessions
 * Search and filter through all sessions
 * Add sessions to favorites list
 * Export favorites list
 * Setup alarms for individual sessions
 * Add sessions to your personal calendar
 * Share a website link to a session with others
 * Keep track of program changes
 * Automatic program updates (configurable in settings)
 * Integration with the Zengelsystem project https://engel.datenspuren.de - Online tool for coordinating helpers and shifts on large events
 * Integration with Chaosflix https://github.com/NiciDieNase/chaosflix - Android App for https://media.ccc.de, share schedule favorites with Chaosflix and import them as bookmarks
 🔤 Supported languages

 * Danish
 * Dutch
 * English
 * Finnish
 * French
 * German
 * German (Austria)
 * Italian
 * Japanese
 * Lithuanian
 * Polish
 * Portuguese (Brazil)
 * Portuguese (Portugal)
 * Russian
 * Spanish
 * Swedish
 * Turkish

fdroid:io.github.ezberlin.keinplan.name: KeinPlan
fdroid:io.github.ezberlin.keinplan.description:
KeinPlan is an unofficial and open-source client for the DSBmobile replacement table management system. It aims to optimize the user experience locally via a native UI and personalized filtering options.
Advantages to the official client:
- Native UI: In contrary to DSBmobile, KeinPlan follows the Material You guidelines and supports a Dark Mode
- Personalization: Using your course and the subjects relevant to you, KeinPlan only displays data relevant for you
- Intuitive structure: KeinPlan uses color coding and a compact design so you can see at first glance what affects you in what way
- Data minimization: The full plan is only then fetched if it has been updated by the provider, while cached plans can also be accessed offline
- Free software: The client is free and open-source under the GNU General Public License
Issues/Concerns:
- To allow for the degree of personalization, assumptions for the structure of plans have been made which may not apply to the plans of your organization
- Push Notification currently cannot be supported for technical reasons; the official DSBmobile application is necessary for that
- As the client is under development and is not supported by DSB or heinekingmedia, the validity of the data cannot be guaranteed for
DSBmobile is a program which distributes posts and replacement plans of an organization, commonly generated using Untis, via a mobile client. It is only usable if your organization utilizes DSBmobile.
KeinPlan is an alternative Client and is in no way supported by or affiliated with DSB or heinekingmedia GmbH.

fdroid:io.github.wandomium.viewcarousel.description:
Application features a circular carousel of maximum five pages that users can swipe through. Each slot in the loop is configured as either a web page or direct phone dialer for up to 4 contacts.

fdroid:net.asksakis.massdroidv2.tv.name: MassDroid TV
fdroid:net.asksakis.massdroidv2.tv.summary: Music Assistant on your TV: browse, discover and control every player.
fdroid:net.asksakis.massdroidv2.tv.description:
MassDroid TV is the Android TV edition of MassDroid, a native client for Music Assistant (music-assistant.io), the open-source music server that unifies your streaming services, local files and players into one library. It is built for the remote: every screen works with the D-pad, and a mouse works too.
You need your own Music Assistant server to use this app.
The sign-in screen finds the Music Assistant servers on your network by itself, through mDNS. This search stays on your local network.
This edition is made for Android TV and Google TV and launches only from the TV home screen, so on a phone it installs without an app icon. On phones and tablets, use the MassDroid app instead.
Features:
* Discover home: recently played, top picks, Smart Mix and Genre Radio, built from your own listening history.
* Browse your library: artists, albums, tracks, playlists, radios and audiobooks.
* Control any Music Assistant player from a mini player that is always at hand, with a full-screen now playing view.
* The TV as a speaker (Sendspin): the TV becomes a Music Assistant player, on its own or in time with your other speakers, with an output delay you can adjust.
* Rename the TV's player from Settings.
* Shows what is playing to the Android TV system controls.
Genres come from your Music Assistant library and from MusicBrainz, with no account or API key to set up; the recommendation data stays on the device. The few words about the playing album or artist come from Wikipedia, by way of MusicBrainz and Wikidata, when Music Assistant has none.
This app is an unofficial, third-party client and is not affiliated with the Music Assistant project.

fdroid:net.kaltner.LoanPro.name: LoanPro
fdroid:net.kaltner.LoanPro.summary: Fast mortgage, auto, credit, and personal loan calculations
fdroid:net.kaltner.LoanPro.description:
LoanPro is a fast financial calculator for running loan numbers without a spreadsheet.
Enter any three of loan amount, payment, term, and interest rate, then tap the missing value to solve it. It works for mortgage scenarios, vehicle loans, credit cards, and other amortized loans.
Features:
- Calculate payment, loan amount, term, or interest rate
- Supports taxes, insurance, down payment, LTV, PMI, and bi-weekly views
- Quick calculator-style numeric entry

fdroid:rocks.mm_dev.BendyStraw.description:
BendyStraw 
An app for managing NewPipe databases.
 BendyStraw imports NewPipeData-*.zip files and lets you:
 Open multiple zip s at the same time, so you can combine data from several devices
 Delete Copy Move Rename your custom playlists
 Delete Copy Move streams from one playlist to another
 Delete Copy Move channel subscriptions between databases
 Delete Copy Move remote (bookmarked) playlists
 Re-order playlists, sorting the streams by Title , Channel or Length (just tap the column headings in the tables)
 Shuffle or reverse playlists
 Create new playlists 
 Drag and drop tracks to re-order playlists 
 After editing simply export a new zip file, then import it back into NewPipe . 
 Import/export playlists: 
 Streams (audio/video) can be opened directly from
 BendyStraw , as the URLs are clickable
 If you set video links (in your Android settings) to open in NewPipe you can make a split-screen view and jump around your playlists
 Export playlist as raw text , for example to be used with yt-dlp 
 Import playlists from JSON (the button to do this is hidden by default, go to the settings menu to show it)
 Open as a temporary YouTube playlist in your browser 
 Depending on your device settings YouTube might open in your browser or a web view or something else... to find out how to configure this do a web search for 'android set default apps'
 Dark/light themes
 Search your watch history to build new playlists 
 Search through your watch history
 Results are displayed in a special search playlist and can be copied into other playlists
 Note about Permissions On Android 13+ 
 BendyStraw asks for the manage external storage permission, here's why:
 A typical use-case for this app is to open several zip files, concurrently, from multiple locations including Download directories (these files would be, for example, multiple NewPipe exports from multiple devices, which you want to combine).
 Each zip is extracted so that its contained newpipe.db SQLite database can be read/written while you are editing.
 After editing, the extracted files are written back to a new zip , and/or overwrite the original zip s.
 I aim to minimise the permissions I request in everything I build . Android 13 introduced changes to make doing what I decribed above difficult. I explored alternative methods requiring fewer permissions and felt that it compromised the user experience for my (as the app's first user) typical usage, making it more complicated and annoying. I treat users as responsible human beings, so give you this info to allow you to make an informed choice. If you are not happy with this, you can:
 Choose not to grant the permission, and uninstall the app.
 Check the source code to see that I'm not doing anything nefarious, or ask somebody to check it for you (at time

flathub:org.freedesktop.appstream.genera.name: AppStream Generator
flathub:org.freedesktop.appstream.genera.description:
AppStream is a metadata specification which permits software components to provide information
 about themselves to automated systems and end-users before the software is actually installed.
 The appstream-generator tool generates AppStream metadata from the repositories of a
 software distribution. It currently supports the following repository formats / distributions: Debian,
 Ubuntu, Arch Linux, RPM-MD (Fedora, Mageia).
 The generator will produce AppStream catalog metadata files in the AppStream YAML or XML format
 to be shipped to users, as well as a detailed HTML report about found components and HTML and JSON
 reports on issues detected with the scanned metadata. It reads .desktop files as well as metainfo
 files, renders fonts, scales images, caches screenshots etc. to produce high-quality metadata for
 AppStream based software centers to consume. Usually, appstream-generator is integrated
 with the existing software build & packaging workflow of a distribution.

firefox-addons:776805.description:
Smart HTTPS is a Firefox extension that helps you always use the secure HTTPS protocol, if supported by the site’s server. It automatically changes HTTP protocol to the secure HTTPS, and if loading errors occur, the extension will revert back to the original HTTP protocol.
 HTTP vs. HTTPS — why it matters 
HTTP, or Hyper-Text Transfer Protocol, is the way a server communicates with the browser. HTTP enables visitors to view a website and send information back and forth to the server. HTTPS, or Hyper-Text Transfer Protocol Secure, is communication through a secure connection. Communications through HTTPS are encrypted by a secure certificate known as an SSL. The encryption prevents third-parties from eavesdropping on communications to and from the server. Read more about HTTPS here.
 Key features 
a. Automatically change all HTTP requests to the secure HTTPS.
b. All websites (addresses) that do not support HTTPS are remembered in order to speed up the protocol-check process. Note that you can see and delete these items from the extension's Options page.
c. Toolbar button serves as the extension’s ON-OFF switch. Blue indicates ON and Gray is OFF.
d. Add desired websites to the whitelist (see Options page).
Note: to report bugs, please visit the extension homepage and find the bug report form.

firefox-addons:954390.name: Facebook Container
firefox-addons:954390.summary: Prevent Facebook from tracking you around the web. The Facebook Container extension for Firefox helps you take control and isolate your web activity from Facebook.
firefox-addons:954390.description:
What does it do? 
Facebook Container works by isolating your Facebook identity into a separate container that makes it harder for Facebook to track your visits to other websites with third-party cookies.
 How does it work? 
Installing this extension closes your Facebook tabs, deletes your Facebook cookies, and logs you out of Facebook.
The next time you navigate to Facebook it will load in a new blue colored browser tab (the “Container”). 
You can log in and use Facebook normally when in the Facebook Container. If you click on a non-Facebook link or navigate to a non-Facebook website in the URL bar, these pages will load outside of the container. 
Clicking Facebook Share buttons on other browser tabs will load them within the Facebook Container. You should know that using these buttons passes information to Facebook about the website that you shared from.
 Which website features will not function? 
Because you will be logged into Facebook only in the Container, embedded Facebook comments and Like buttons in tabs outside the Facebook Container will not work. This prevents Facebook from associating information about your activity on websites outside of Facebook to your Facebook identity.
In addition, websites that allow you to create an account or log in using your Facebook credentials will generally not work properly. Because this extension is designed to separate Facebook use from use of other websites, this behavior is expected.
 What does Facebook Container NOT protect against? 
It is important to know that this extension doesn’t prevent Facebook from mishandling the data that it already has, or permitted others to obtain, about you. Facebook still will have access to everything that you do while you are on facebook.com , including your Facebook comments, photo uploads, likes, any data you share with Facebook connected apps, etc. 
Rather than stop using a service you find valuable, we think you should have tools to limit what data others can obtain. This extension focuses on limiting Facebook tracking, but other ad networks may try to correlate your Facebook activities with your regular browsing. In addition to this extension, you can change your Facebook settings, use Private Browsing, enable Tracking Protection, block third-party cookies, and/or use Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension to further limit tracking.
 What data does Mozilla receive from this extension? 
Mozilla does not collect data from your use of the Facebook Container extension. We do receive the number of times the extension is installed or removed. Learn more 
 Other Containers 
Facebook Container leverages the Containers feature that is already built in to Firefox. When you enable Facebook Container, you may also see Containers named Personal, Work, Shopping, and Banking while you browse. If you wish to use multiple Containers, you’ll have the best user experience if you install the Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension. Learn more about Containers on our support site . 
 Known Issues 
When Facebook is open and you navigate to another website using the same tab (by entering an address, doing a search, or clicking a bookmark), the new website will be loaded outside of the Container and you will not be able to navigate back to Facebook using the back button in the browser.
 NOTE: If you are a Multi-Account Containers user who has already assigned Facebook to a Container, this extension will not work. In an effort to preserve your existing Container set up and logins, this add-on will not include the additional protection to keep other sites out of your Facebook Container. If you would like this additional protection, first unassign facebook.com in the Multi-Account Container extension, and then install this extension.
 What version of Firefox do I need for this? 
This extension works with Firefox 57 and higher on Desktop. Note that it does not work on other browsers and it does not work on Firefox for mobile.
If you believe you are using Firefox 57+, but the install page is telling you that you are not on a supported browser, you can try installing by selecting or copying and pasting this link . (This may be occurring because you have set a preference or installed an extension that causes your browser to obscure its user agent for privacy or other reasons.)
 How does this compare to the Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension? 
Facebook Container specifically isolates Facebook and works automatically. Firefox Multi-Account Containers is a more general extension that allows you to create containers and determine which sites open in each container.
You can use Multi-Account Containers to create a container for Facebook and assign facebook.com to it. Multi-Account Containers will then make sure to only open facebook.com in the Facebook Container. However, unlike Facebook Container, Multi-Account Containers doesn’t prevent you from opening non-Facebook sites in your Facebook Container. So users of Multi-Account Containers need to take a bit extra care to make sure they leave the Facebook Container when navigating to other sites. In addition, Facebook Container assigns some Facebook-owned sites like Instagram and Messenger to the Facebook Container. With Multi-Account Containers, you will have to assign these in addition to facebook.com .
Facebook Container also deletes Facebook cookies from your other containers on install and when you restart the browser, to clean up any potential Facebook trackers. Multi-Account Containers does not do that for you.
 Report Issues 
If you come across any issues with this extension, please let us know by filing an issue here . Thank you!

firefox-addons:3101197.name: Theme Weaver
firefox-addons:3101197.summary: Design your own Firefox theme live: palettes from photos or websites, day/night schedules and a colour per window.
firefox-addons:3101197.description:
Firefox lets an add-on repaint the browser: title bar, tabs, toolbar, address
 bar, the main menu and panels, sidebar and new tab page. Theme Weaver turns
 that into a design tool.
Design it live
 • Every themeable part of Firefox, 37 in all, in one editor: hue, saturation,
 lightness and opacity sliders, a hex field and a colour picker.
 • The real window changes while you drag, and a full mock of Firefox in the
 studio lets you click any part to edit it.
 • Undo and redo everything.
Start from anywhere
 • 20 hand-made presets, light and dark.
 • From a photo: drop any picture and get a five-colour palette, plus the photo
 as your header if you like.
 • From this site: weave a theme from the colours of the page you're on.
 • Surprise me: a random theme built on colour-harmony rules (analogous,
 complementary, triad).
Readable by design
 • A contrast guard checks all 14 text and icon pairs against WCAG AA and fixes
 any that fail in one click.
It runs itself
 • Day and night: two themes that take turns at fixed times, at your local
 sunrise and sunset (pick a city, no location permission), or following your
 system's light and dark mode.
 • Per-window themes: make your work window unmistakable. They last until the
 window closes. New private windows can wear their own theme too, once you
 allow Theme Weaver in private windows.
 • Ctrl+Shift+0 puts Firefox back to its default theme from anywhere.

bluejetty:00072735:ios.description:
If you are looking for a calorie counter with a barcode scanner, food scanner, and macros tracker, or effective diet plans that fit your lifestyle, including intermittent fasting, Appediet is your answer. Sleek, smart, and simple, it's the ultimate personal assistant for weight loss, diet, and nutrition.
DIFFERENT FROM OTHER DIET APPS
• Appediet is simple, straightforward, and packed with generous features. 
• Snap any food photo and get calories & nutritional breakdown;
• Lightning-fast food entry with a barcode scanner - log foods faster than anywhere else
• The only diet app with an accurate, verified food database - over 1.5 million items and 108 nutrients
PROVEN SUCCESS
• Active members lose an average of 1.4 lbs/week;
• Over 21 million users have chosen Appediet, many switched from other diet apps.
More Features of Appediet are...
- Unleash the Power of Camera -
Say goodbye to tedious manual input! With Appediet's state-of-the-art AI food scanner, simply snap a photo or scan the barcode of your meal, and watch as the app automatically recognizes the food, analyzes its composition, and calculates the precise calorie count. 
- Elevate Your Nutritional Knowledge -
Take a dive into a vast database of millions of foods and explore detailed nutrition information at your fingertips. Discover the caloric content, macronutrient breakdown, and essential vitamins and minerals of every meal you consume. Armed with this knowledge, you'll make informed choices and achieve your weight loss and wellness goals with confidence.
- Exclusive Health Assistant -
Appediet equips you with a personal AI health assistant that recommends recipes suitable for your physical condition and health needs. Massive knowledge database, answering 
health-related questions and querying the daily intake of nutrients in seconds.Like having a nutrition expert in the palm of your hands, provide scientific advice for your daily diet, so that health and deliciousness coexist.
- Tailored for Your Success -
Unlock personalized healthy programs tailored just for you. Whether you're embarking on a fasting journey, seeking a balanced diet plan, or ready to embrace gentle carb cycling, Appediet provides comprehensive guidance and support. 
- Embark on a Life-Changing Journey -
Download Appediet now and embark on a transformative adventure towards a healthier, happier you. Revolutionize the way you approach nutrition, fitness, and weight management with our powerful features and user-friendly interface.
Appediet requires access to your camera, album, HealthKit, and Health and Fitness data to provide you with a seamless user experience. Granting these permissions ensures that you can fully utilize the app's capabilities.
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
–You can subscribe to get unlimited access to all features of the Appediet.
–Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate based on the subscription plan.
–Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
–Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
–Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
–Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
–Any unused portion of the trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00079881:ios.description:
Block Puzzle - Wood Blast is a classic yet innovative, fun and addictive block puzzle game that is perfect to pass the time.
Block Puzzle - Wood Blast has two game modes:
• Classic Block Puzzle Mode: Drag different colored blocks onto the board and match as many blocks as possible. The game keeps offering blocks of various shapes until there is no room left on the board.
• Cube Adventure Mode: New Mode! New mode! New mode! Interesting world! Various levels! Pure puzzles!
It's completely free and can be played offline, no internet connection required.
Which gameplay:
• Drag and drop colored tiles onto the 8x8 panel to combine them.
• Match rows or columns to clear colored blocks.
• Choose the best position for the colored tiles based on their shape.
• Earn extra points by matching multiple lines at the same time!
• Completely free - just watch an ad to continue the challenge at the end of the game.
Enjoy this retro and innovative block puzzle game!
Which game features:
• Rich and colorful levels and various blocks.
Experience a brand new combo gameplay.
• Cool elimination animations and delightful music.
• Free classic block play and story challenge mode.
• No WiFi required, you can play online or offline.

bluejetty:00080027:ios.summary: TV Mexicana es la única app que necesitas para disfrutar de tus canales, deportes y programas favoritos con una experiencia de nueva generación. Con un diseño visual totalmente renovado en todas las secciones, más canales en vivo y herrami
bluejetty:00080027:ios.description:
TV Mexicana es la única app que necesitas para disfrutar de tus canales, deportes y programas favoritos con una experiencia de nueva generación. Con un diseño visual totalmente renovado en todas las secciones, más canales en vivo y herramientas avanzadas para que disfrutes de tu contenido en donde quieras y cuando quieras.
Descubre todo lo que te espera al descargar la app:
• Diseño fluido e intuitivo: Explora una interfaz moderna, limpia y rápida en todas las secciones de la app. Con efectos de Liquid Glass, animaciones fluidas y una organización intuitiva para que encuentres tu contenido en segundos.
• Disfruta tus canales favoritos en vivo: Más de 25 canales disponibles en la palma de tu mano a la hora que quieras. Utiliza la guía de programación mejorada para saber qué se transmite en directo.
• Modo MultiView: Disfruta de los partidos en diferentes transmisiones al mismo tiempo. Para que no te pierdas ningún segundo de cualquier partido.
• Sección de Deportes de alto rendimiento: Diseñada para los verdaderos aficionados. Sigue de cerca la Liga MX y otros torneos con calendarios completos, clasificaciones, alineaciones y estadísticas detalladas de cada partido en tiempo real.
• Actividades en Vivo (Live Activities): Sigue los marcadores y el tiempo restante de los partidos directamente en tu Pantalla de bloqueo o Dynamic Island en tiempo real, sin abrir la app.
• Seguir Viendo y Favoritos: Guarda tus canales preferidos con un toque y siente la respuesta háptica. Además, la pantalla de inicio ahora te permite retomar tus canales y programas recientes al instante.
• AirPlay y Google Cast: Lleva tu contenido a la pantalla grande. Transmite fácilmente a cualquier Apple TV, Chromecast o pantalla inteligente compatible.
• Tus eventos favoritos ¡GRATIS!: Programamos transmisiones y eventos especiales de forma constante para que los disfrutes totalmente gratis.
• Soporte y ayuda inmediata: Nuestro equipo de expertos está siempre disponible a través de la app o a nuestro correo ayuda@tvmexicana.app para resolver cualquier duda, comentario o sugerencia.
¿Qué esperas? Descarga TV Mexicana y vive la televisión digital como nunca antes.
Política de Privacidad: https://links.tvmexicana.app/politica-privacidad
Términos y Condiciones: https://links.tvmexicana.app/terminos-condiciones
Suscripción Premium: Podrás disfrutar de tus canales favoritos sin anuncios añadidos por la app y acceder a toda la información detallada de los partidos de fútbol. Los anuncios nativos de la transmisión original de la televisora se seguirán visualizando.

From the guys who brought you Mystery Science Theater 3000, RiffTrax makes movies FUNNY! Our hilarious commentaries turn some of the biggest blockbusters (and cheesiest B-movies) into comedy hits.
“The RiffTrax app syncs everything up perfectly.” - CNET
“Rifftrax app takes the guesswork out of syncing jokes to film. It’s easier than ever to sync MST3K-like commentary. The app uses your device’s microphone to listen for a movie and automatically syncs Rifftrax playback to the film. It’s simple and easy...” - Engadget
“The app can recognize movies from Netflix, iTunes, Amazon Video, DVDs, Blu-rays, your TV, computer, and other streams.” - High-Def Digest 
Using the app, you can download these "riffs" on blockbuster films like Twilight, Jurassic Park, Star Wars and more! The app listens to the movie, using your device's microphone, and automatically synchronizes the commentary to play along with perfect timing. Presto! That movie is now a comedy smash.
Check here for our list of compatible RiffTrax titles!
www.rifftrax.com/appenabled
Get into RiffTrax and start watching movies in a whole new way!

bluejetty:00064218:ios.summary: Welcome to the Tasty App – your ultimate cooking companion, featuring over 10,000 delicious recipes with video, step-by-step cooking mode, personalized recommendations, a thriving community of home chefs, and recipe shopping and seamless ch
bluejetty:00064218:ios.description:
Welcome to the Tasty App – your ultimate cooking companion, featuring over 10,000 delicious recipes with video, step-by-step cooking mode, personalized recommendations, a thriving community of home chefs, and recipe shopping and seamless checkout. Tasty brings you the best of food and recipe discovery from the internet’s favorite food brand.
Key Features:
10,000+ Recipes and Collections: Explore a vast library of mouth-watering dishes, complete with video guides, step-by-step instructions, and recommendations tailored to the current season, time of day, and special occasions.
AI Botatouille: Powered by ChatGPT API, our AI assistant helps you find recipes that match your preferences and tastes, making it easy to discover new dishes and expand your culinary horizons.
Shoppable Recipe Integration: Shop for affordable recipes and get your groceries delivered or picked up through Walmart, saving you both time and money.
Tasty Community: Connect with fellow food enthusiasts, share photos of your creations, and get inspired by the dishes others have cooked up in our vibrant and supportive community.
Tips and Ratings: Learn from Tasty Creators and the Community, with helpful tips and ratings on every recipe, ensuring your cooking experience is a success.
Personalized Cookbooks: Save your favorite recipes to your profile and organize them into custom cookbooks, making it easy to find and revisit your favorite dishes.
Ingredient Search: Find the perfect recipe based on ingredients you have on hand, with our innovative "ingredient search" feature that generates dish ideas from just 3 ingredients.
Adjustable Serving Sizes: Easily adjust serving sizes per recipe, with metric values side-by-side with US measurements, accommodating users both within and outside the US.
Connect with Creators: See recipes from and interact with your favorite Tasty Creators, learn their cooking secrets, and get inspired by their culinary expertise.
Ready to embark on a delicious cooking journey? Download the Tasty App today and unlock a world of culinary inspiration at your fingertips!
If you have any trouble with your app please email us at support@buzzfeed.com so we can help! Don’t forget to check out Tasty on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube!
Please note: This app features Nielsen’s proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen’s TV Ratings. Please see https://www.nielsen.com/us/en/legal/privacy-statement/digital-measurement/#choices for more information about Nielsen’s measurement software and learn about your choices with regard to NIELSEN’s measurement. Additionally, usage of the Tasty app is subject to our privacy policy and terms of use.

bluejetty:00119963:ios.summary:
Baixe agora o app e assista a cursos e produções originais da Casa do Saber, além de documentários, podcasts e trilhas. Melhore seus relacionamentos através de uma educação continuada e aprendizado transformador.
O Casa do Saber+ é um apli
bluejetty:00119963:ios.description:
Baixe agora o app e assista a cursos e produções originais da Casa do Saber, além de documentários, podcasts e trilhas. Melhore seus relacionamentos através de uma educação continuada e aprendizado transformador.
O Casa do Saber+ é um aplicativo de streaming educativo que reúne os maiores pensadores, professores e especialistas do Brasil em uma plataforma única de cursos online, podcasts, documentários e conteúdos de curta duração. Com foco em aprendizado contínuo e lifelong learning, a plataforma oferece uma experiência de imersão intelectual que cabe na sua rotina — onde e quando quiser.
Explore um universo de conhecimento com temas que vão desde filosofia, psicologia, psicanálise, literatura, arte, ciência, ciências sociais, até política, economia, educação, saúde mental, relacionamentos, casamento, autocuidado e autoconhecimento. Tudo isso por meio de uma linguagem acessível, com recursos de microlearning para você aprender mesmo com pouco tempo disponível.
Assista a verdadeiras MasterClasses com especialistas renomados, mergulhe em aulas livres que ampliam sua visão de mundo e ouça conteúdos que lembram as mais inspiradoras experiências vividas pela humanidade.
Ideal para quem busca expandir horizontes intelectuais, melhorar o desempenho pessoal e profissional, lidar com questões como ansiedade, fortalecer o relacionamento de casal ou aprofundar reflexões existenciais. O app se destaca como uma excelente fonte de aprendizagem e entretenimento consciente.
Temos também Clubes do Livro, para você acompanhar leituras comentadas em eventos ao vivo e fazer parte de uma comunidade que valoriza o conhecimento como ferramenta de transformação.
Todo o acervo da Casa está disponível no Plano Anual (exceto os conteúdos do programa +Psicanálise). Além disso, o Casa do Saber+ também oferece cursos grátis e eventos exclusivos para os assinantes.
Aqui no App você encontra também:
 • Assista na sua Smart TV, navegador ou Chromecast
 • Download para poder reproduzir o conteúdo offline
 • Reprodução de aulas em segundo plano
 • Emita e acesse todos os seus certificados digitais de conclusão de curso.
 • Suporte da equipe de especialistas da Casa Do Saber
Se tiver dúvidas ou sugestões, sinta-se à vontade para entrar em contato: suporte@casadosaber.com.br
Inicie agora mesmo a sua evolução pessoal com acesso a mais de 350 cursos. Baixe agora o Casa do Saber+ e comece sua jornada de crescimento com quem entende de conteúdo inteligente, acessível e relevante.
Aprender transforma. O Casa do Saber+ é pra quem sabe disso.

bluejetty:00116227:ios.description:
Discover a world where the thrill of the scratch card meets the joy of creation. Scratch Story isn't just another game; it's a portal to an evolving narrative that you control. 
Unveil the Magic, One Scratch at a Time:
Dive into a dazzling array of uniquely themed scratch-off cards. Experience the satisfying sweep of your finger revealing hidden symbols, matching your way to delightful rewards and collecting the vital resources needed for your grand design.
Craft Your Worlds, Chapter by Chapter:
Your winnings are the seeds of change! Use your thoughtfully earned in-game coins to:
Breathe Life into Deserts: Transform arid landscapes into lush oases, planting resilient flora and watching life bloom under your care.
Cleanse Ocean Depths: Remove debris from majestic underwater realms, revealing sparkling coral reefs and welcoming back diverse marine life.
Restore Serene Beaches: Clear away neglect from sandy shores, creating pristine paradises perfect for virtual relaxation and discovery.
Each restored area isn't just visually stunning; it's a testament to your dedication and a step forward in your personal Scratch Story. Witness the direct impact of your efforts as these environments flourish, offering a deeply rewarding sense of accomplishment.
Why Scratch Story is a Unique Tapestry of Fun:
Innovative Dual-Layer Gameplay: Experience the immediate excitement of scratch cards seamlessly integrated with a fulfilling world-restoration narrative.
A Rich Tapestry of Cards: Explore an ever-expanding collection of scratch card games, each with distinct themes, exciting odds, and engaging mechanics to keep you captivated.
Tangible Progression & Creation: See your efforts translate into visible, beautiful changes in your interactive worlds. This isn't just about numbers; it's about building and nurturing.
Visually Enchanting: Immerse yourself in beautifully crafted graphics and smooth animations that bring your scratch cards and restored worlds to vibrant life.

bluejetty:00175454:ios.description:
Lose weight with less guessing, more support.
Kompanion is your science-informed fasting coach + calorie & macro counter that helps you stay consistent without obsessing over manual food logs.
Intermittent fasting is about when you eat, but weight loss is often about what and how much you eat too. That’s why Kompanion combines a flexible fasting timer with a smart nutrition toolkit, so your plan actually fits real life.
ALL YOU NEED FOR EFFORTLESS WEIGHT LOSS 
SCAN YOUR MEAL, SKIP THE TYPING
Tired of manual logging? The advanced meal scan feature changes the game.
Simply point your camera at your plate. Our technology recognizes the food and uses depth sensors to estimate portion sizes accurately.
Get a detailed breakdown of your calories, protein, carbs, and fats in seconds.
Forget searching through endless databases. No manual entry. Snap a photo, and let Kompanion do the math.
SMART FASTING PLANS
Personalized plans that adapt to your biology and lifestyle:
Beginner Friendly: 12:12 (Circadian Rhythm) or 14:10.
The Gold Standard: 16:8, the favorite of millions for a healthy glow and fat burn.
Advanced Results: 18:6, 20:4 (OMAD), and extended fasts (24h-36h) for deep autophagy and anti-aging.
Custom Plans: Build a schedule that fits your unique life.
TRACK WHAT HAPPENS INSIDE
Don't just watch the clock; watch your progress!
Body Stages: Learn exactly when your body enters Ketosis, Autophagy, or Insulin decline.
Mood & Energy Journal: Track how you feel. We’ll graph your trends to find your "sweet spot" for peak performance.
Weight & Water Tracker: Monitor your hydration and weight loss milestones in one place.
LEARN & STAY MOTIVATED
Learning Center: Expert-backed articles on the science of fasting, cardiovascular health, and metabolism.
Hour-by-Hour Motivation: Real-time updates on the metabolic changes happening in your body while you fast.
WHY CHOOSE KOMPANION?
Unlike basic trackers, we bridge the gap between When to Eat and What to Eat. By combining IF with AI calorie counting, you get a 360-degree view of your health.
With Kompanion, you will experience:
-Efficient Fat Burn & Weight Loss 
-Accelerated Metabolism 
-Enhanced Mental Clarity 
-Improved Digestion & Heart Health
- Anti-Aging Benefits through Autophagy
Connect with Apple Health so you can keep track of your health data in the Kompanion.
Download Kompanion to get started for free and get full access to all the features, premium content, and your personalized fasting plan with Kompanion Plus.
Disclaimer
The information provided in this application should not be considered as professional medical guidance. Before making any health-related decisions, please seek consultation with a healthcare professional.

Con App Itaú Chile, tu billetera estará siempre al alcance de tu mano, brindándote acceso rápido a tus finanzas personales y a herramientas esenciales. ¡Descarga la App hoy mismo para experimentar una gestión financiera más sencilla y efectiva!

bluejetty:00068475:ios.description:
Pond - Your Digital Sanctuary
A mindful app blocker for screen time balance and digital wellbeing
You already know the feeling. Another evening lost to scrolling. Reaching for your phone during dinner. The exhaustion of being always on.
Your phone promised connection. Instead, it scattered your attention into a thousand pieces.
Pond is different.
A gentle app blocker and screen time tracker that helps you reclaim your time. Not through guilt or gamification, but through quiet intention and mindful awareness.
Three Things That Matter:
Daily Balance Score
One number that shows the quality of your digital day. Are you creating or consuming? Connecting or scrolling? Resting or stimulating? Not to judge—to help you notice. Track your digital wellbeing and build healthier phone habits.
Mindful Blocking
Set focus sessions for work, meditation, meals, or sleep. Block distracting apps and social media automatically. Your scattered attention becomes whole again. Just you and what you chose to do.
Your Lotus Garden
Each moment of presence blooms a lotus in your pond. Not points or streaks—just quiet beauty that grows with your practice. A visual reminder of time well spent and focus reclaimed.
What You Can Do:
• Block distracting apps during focus time
• Set daily limits on social media and screen time
• Schedule recurring sessions (work, sleep, meals, study)
• Track your balance and phone usage without judgment
• Take mindful breaks with breathing prompts
• See weekly patterns in your digital life
This Isn't Another Productivity App
Pond won't buzz you to work harder. Won't shame you for a bad day. Won't turn presence into competition.
Just a quiet space. A gentle reminder. A place to return to stillness.
Perfect for those seeking digital detox, building healthier phone habits, improving focus, or simply using their phone more intentionally.
Pond — a calmer way to use your phone.
Your Privacy Matters
Everything stays on your device. No tracking. No social comparison. No data collection.
Terms & Conditions
https://go.pixo.co/pond-terms

bluejetty:00171976:ios.name: NBC Connecticut News & Weather
bluejetty:00171976:ios.summary: The NBC Connecticut app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, school closings, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored for commun
bluejetty:00171976:ios.description:
The NBC Connecticut app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, school closings, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored for communities across Connecticut.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC Connecticut in one app. Follow stories across Connecticut, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, traffic, transit, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC Connecticut app?
If you live or work in Connecticut, the NBC Connecticut app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC Connecticut app?
Follow Connecticut local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC Connecticut journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in Hartford, New Haven, statewide Connecticut contests and local races
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC Connecticut anchors
Stay ahead of the weather with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, school closings, air quality and UV index
* Access NBC Connecticut First Alert Weather live Doppler radar to track rain, snow, severe storms, flooding and extreme weather
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live NBC Connecticut newscasts and special coverage on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from NBC Connecticut Investigates and consumer guidance from NBC Connecticut Responds
Personalize your NBC Connecticut experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC Connecticut app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters in Hartford, New Haven, Bridgeport, Stamford, Waterbury, Norwalk and communities throughout Connecticut who need real-time weather tracking, traffic and local news updates.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election and weather alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, breaking news, election updates or community notices you choose.
Can I watch live newscasts inside the app?
Yes. You can stream NBC Connecticut News 24/7, live NBC Connecticut newscasts, press conferences and special breaking coverage from anywhere.
NBC Connecticut provides local news, First Alert Weather forecasts, live radar, severe storm alerts, traffic and 24/7 streaming for Hartford, New Haven and Connecticut.

bluejetty:00044795:ios.description:
It’s APP-ening: Ordering The Filet Mignon of Chicken™ has never been easier! 
Download our superfan-APProved Huey Magoo’s app today to unlock great features such as in-app ordering, exclusive deals and the latest on everything related to your favorite chicken tenders. 
App Features Include: 
Online Ordering
That’s right, you can now get to enjoying your tendies even faster with our order ahead feature. To skip the line, simply tap on the “Order Now” button on the app’s home screen, select the Huey Magoo’s location nearest to you, pick & customize your go-to items and quickly pay through the app. Before you know it, you will be APP-ily enjoying America’s favorite chicken tenders.
Superfan tip: Extra Huey Magoo’s dips are always a great idea. 
Catering 
Spill the sweet tea, is it even a party if there’s no chicken tenders? Leave the cooking to the pros and bring a smile to everyone in your group by ordering everyone’s favorite tenders, sides, sweets & drinks for your next gathering. 
Push Notifications
Are you even a superfan if you are not subscribed to our push notifications? Stay in the know of all #MagoosNews and our juicy deals by opting-in to our push notifications.
Only the Top 3% is Good Enough for Huey Magoo’s
At Huey Magoo’s we only serve real tenders made from the tenderloin. It’s The Filet Mignon of Chicken™ and the best 3% of the chicken. We’re talking no hormones, no antibiotics ever and no mountains of breading to hide bad chicken. So get app-y and treat yourself to The Filet Mignon of Chicken™ today!
For a full list of locations, please visit our website at HueyMagoos.com or follow us on social media to be in the know of when we are coming to your neighborhood!

bluejetty:00073152:ios.description:
The new Scotsman newspaper app brings you a full colour digital replica of Scotland’s national newspaper every supplement and Scotland on Sunday, all presented in pristine detail and designed to be enjoyed on your smartphone or tablet device.
Updated early each morning, seven days a week, the app gives you the opportunity to read the full edition of the paper and its supplements over breakfast, or download them for offline reading later.
When viewing a paper or supplement, you can pinch and zoom to enlarge the pages and articles, swipe through or jump to the next or other pages, use the search functionality to find specific articles, and view full pages either in single page portrait or double page spread landscape mode.
Download the The Scotsman newspaper app now and discover up-to-the-minute latest news from Scotland via scotsman.com, Updated throughout the day and including photos, videos, improved digital content which can all be shared on social media. We have live news notifications sent direct to your device.
The app features:
• The latest live news and daily digital edition newspaper
• Live updates with interactive article elements
• New easy-to-use navigation
• Read essential content offline when it suits you
• Responsive design complimenting the print edition
• 30 day archive of the newspaper
The Scotsman newspaper app brings you the very best in news, sport, entertainment, other features and more from across Scotland and the world, with full daily editions exactly as the printed version.
This gives access to both the digital content and the paper editions within the app .Payment for this subscription will be charged to your iTunes account upon purchase. The subscription will auto-renew within 24 hours of the current subscription expiring. Auto-renewing subscriptions can be managed via Account Settings allowing them to be turned off. No cancellations of the current subscription are allowed during the active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.jpimedia.co.uk/privacy-policy/
T&C: https://www.jpimedia.co.uk/website-terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00122217:ios.name: Tracker for Vintage Star Wars
bluejetty:00122217:ios.summary:
Tracker for Vintage Star Wars is a portfolio and price guide app for managing your vintage Star Wars collection.
Portfolio functionality keeps you organized and in control of your collection. Upload your own images for each item and record
bluejetty:00122217:ios.description:
Tracker for Vintage Star Wars is a portfolio and price guide app for managing your vintage Star Wars collection.
Portfolio functionality keeps you organized and in control of your collection. Upload your own images for each item and record important details such as condition, when you got it and how much you paid for it.
The actively maintained digital price guides allow a unique view of the market. Enriched prices are harvested weekly from various collector markets, and cover hundreds of items such as loose figures, mint on card figures (MOC), vehicles, playsets, POTF coins and much more!
Build up your portfolio of collectibles and get instant on-demand valuations based on current market prices including a weekly email valuation!
Main highlights are features:
* Record items in your portfolios and tag with rich detail such as licensee, price paid, descriptions, sale currency and condition. Include multiple images to fully describe each piece
* Graded collectors are covered allowing you to track AFA/UKG/CAS graded items
* Create portfolios to cover all aspects of your collection, or one list for everything - it's your choice and there are no limits
* Define your own private catalogue extensions to track anything and everything you have in your collection
* Track your loose figures, MOC figures, vehicles, playsets and much more
* Useful statistics are provided such as overall spend and number of items in your collection
* Easy and quick price searches for hundreds of vintage items, and thousands of variants.
* Enriched statistics, percentile bands, and scatter graphs along with raw data allow you to analyse prices in powerful ways. Never over-pay and never under-sell!
* Graded item prices are enriched with the grading company and overall grade for precise searches
* Run on-demand valuations for your collection based on actual market data and real world market prices. No longer do you need to rely on biased commentators, or out-dated print price guides
* Print display labels for your items and scan the barcode using your smart phone camera to pull up the portfolio item record from your collection
* Opt-in market update emails are sent weekly, and include a valuation of your portfolio in response to the latest market prices
* Powerful currency conversion engine to provide pricing from sales data around the world into your chosen "home" currency
Tracker for Vintage Star Wars requires a subscription which comes with a free trial for new members. You can easily cancel at any time, online, 24 hours a day. Use the tracker as little or as much as you like!
We love to chat vintage Star Wars, so feel free to get in touch about anything!

bluejetty:00144311:ios.description:
التطبيق الرسمي لمجلس الضمان الصحي
"Daman" application is the new and official application of the Health Insurance Council for providing e-health insurance services to individuals, citizens and residents of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
The Daman application aims to enable individuals to obtain their insurance information for themselves and their family members.
The Daman application enables beneficiaries to manage inquiries and complaints against insurance companies and health service providers to ensure that the beneficiary receives medical services.
The most important services provided by the Daman application:
1. View the insurance information for you and your family members.
2. Add the insurance card to the wallet card.
3. View the list and map of the approved medical network.
4. View the insurance rights.
5. View the schedule of benefits.
6. Submit and manage inquiries and complaints.
7. Communication with the Secretary General.

bluejetty:00155223:ios.name: Live Speech to Text: iScribe
bluejetty:00155223:ios.summary: Read every word the moment it's said — who's speaking, in big, clear type — and walk away with the transcript, a summary and a translation. Built for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, and for anyone who records meetings, lectures and appoint
bluejetty:00155223:ios.description:
Read every word the moment it's said — who's speaking, in big, clear type — and walk away with the transcript, a summary and a translation. Built for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, and for anyone who records meetings, lectures and appointments. Free to start.
Doctor's appointments, family dinners, lectures, the TV at home: open iScribe, tap once, and read along. No asking anyone to repeat themselves.
KNOW WHO SAID WHAT
• Each speaker gets a color and a label, so group conversations and dinners make sense
• Works in live captions and in recorded transcripts
HEAR THE ROOM YOUR WAY
Choose a Listening mode for where the sound is coming from:
• Auto — adapts to your microphone and hearing aids
• Hearing Aid — uses the microphone in your Bluetooth hearing aids or earbuds
• TV & Media — TVs, laptops, videos and speech across the room
KNOW WHEN IT'S ABOUT YOU
• Name alerts: your phone buzzes when your name is said
• Custom words: add medications, colleagues and places the app keeps getting wrong
MADE TO BE READ
• Atkinson Hyperlegible typeface, seven text sizes, bold weights
• Low Vision and High Contrast themes
• Flip the screen so the person opposite can read too
• Jump back to live captions with one tap
NO SIGNAL, NO PROBLEM
• Offline mode transcribes on your device with downloadable language packs
• Switches over on its own if your connection drops mid-conversation
MEETINGS, LECTURES AND APPOINTMENTS, KEPT
• Record any session or import an audio file (m4a, mp3, wav)
• Get the full transcript plus a summary with key points, decisions and action items
• Translate transcripts and summaries into 53 languages
• Export as PDF or text, or share the recording
CAPTIONS IN 53 LANGUAGES
• Auto Detect follows bilingual rooms as the language changes
YOUR WORDS, ON EVERY DEVICE
• Transcripts sync with iCloud; Sign in with Apple keeps your profile and plan on every device
• Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad
FREE AND PRO
Free includes 3 sessions a day across Live Transcribe, Record and Upload. Pro makes them unlimited and backs up your recordings to iCloud.
PRIVACY
Captions, transcripts, summaries and translations are created by speech-recognition and AI services that never keep your audio. Offline mode sends nothing anywhere.
Download iScribe and read every word — on your own terms.
Subscription Info: Weekly and annual plans available. Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Cancel anytime in iTunes Store settings.
Questions? support@harshvatechnologies.com
Help: https://livetranscribe.pro/contact-us/
Terms: https://livetranscribe.pro/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy: https://livetranscribe.pro/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00023170:ios.name: Style Studio by Smule
bluejetty:00023170:ios.summary: Ready to transform your Smule singing performances into full productions? With Style Studio, you can unlock your creative potential with one-of-a-kind audio and video Styles to use in Smule. Show off your creativity and set your performance
bluejetty:00023170:ios.description:
Ready to transform your Smule singing performances into full productions? With Style Studio, you can unlock your creative potential with one-of-a-kind audio and video Styles to use in Smule. Show off your creativity and set your performances apart. Style Studio is the companion app to Smule, the social karaoke singing app. In Style Studio, you can create Styles that work as templates, made up of fun audio and visual effects that enhance any Smule recording. 
Music and singing is at the center of Styles and so you’ll notice that songs are pre-segmented—chorus, bridge, verse, etc, and you apply effects to those segments to create your Style. When you create a Style, you’re building your own unique look and sound that can be applied to any song while you record in Smule. If your audience loves the Styles you’ve added, they can use them for their own karaoke performances, too! 
Create your Style based on your own preferences and publish to use it on your next Smule recording. Want to change something or try again? Continue to make new Styles as often as you want and publish them to be seen and shared with the global singing community! Each time your Style is shared, your creative vision is brought to life and inspires others to connect with you and your performance.
FEATURES
Add unique effects to each song segment: intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge, and outro or apply one effect to multiple segments—you’re the producer!
Change the tone of songs instantly with audio options like grunge, super pop, indie, opera, and more!
Use layouts and transitions to highlight epic moments in your performance.
Blur, blend, and add contrast with different lens choices. 
Create bursts of energy through fireworks, streaks of light, and flashing neon symbols.
Transform the look and sound of any recording in Smule by creating with Styles, that work as templates of fun audio and visual effects that enhance any Smule recording. 
Download the free Style Studio app now to create your first Style and share your creativity with the world! Not sure what Styles will look like? Download the Smule app and watch a few performances to see what it’s all about. You can sing to your favorite hits and meet friends through the power of music and creativity. 
Jump into the Style Studio and customize the vibe you want for a couple or all of your performances. You’ll have a pre-loaded performance to play with or can use one of your own Smule performances to help you find what works for you. Once you’ve created a Style, you can use it in Smule while you record your solo, duet, or group performance with added, epic effects. Download the Style Studio to create your first Style and use Smule to see it in action on your performances.

Taking just 5 minutes each day to record your stream of consciousness will help y
bluejetty:00163923:ios.description:
Morning Pages is the daily writing practice from The Artist's Way, made for your phone. Three pages every morning, completely private. Just you and the page.
Taking just 5 minutes each day to record your stream of consciousness will help you understand yourself better, and open up parts of your mind you never even knew existed.
Featuring a simple, beautiful, ad-free interface, the app helps you build a daily writing practice and shows you what your writing reveals: the moods, emotions, and topics in your pages, surfaced over time. Track your progress and earn badges along the way.
Everything you write is stored securely on your device.
Morning Pages can be used as a mindfulness journal, as a warm-up for writing, or as a way to chart the ebb and flow of your emotions over time.
Features:
Beautiful, uncluttered writing interface > stay focused on your writing
Emotional insights > gain a deeper understanding of yourself
Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac > write where you are
Text styles and dark mode > pick a look that suits how you write
Handwriting Scan > effortlessly turn your handwritten notes into digital text
Pages search > find any past entry quickly
Password protection > keep your writing private
Customisable settings > choose a daily word target that works for you
Daily reminders > maintain a Morning Pages freewriting practice
Home and Lock Screen widgets > see your writing streak and today's quote at a glance
Siri and Shortcuts > start today's page, or ask how your streak is going
Achievement badges > get motivated to develop a routine
Basic app usage is - and always will be - free, with extended features unlocked when you subscribe to the Morning Pro plan (7 day free trial included!):
Extended text insights > get to know yourself even better.
Morning Cloud > sync your writing across your devices and morningpages.app in your browser.
Handwriting Scan > seamlessly digitize your handwritten journal entries.
Life can pass you by if you don't pay attention to what's going on around and inside you. Whatever your personal circumstances, Morning Pages can help you connect to your thoughts and feelings, let go of negative emotions, and reveal the rich world within.
Install Morning Pages today and begin a beautiful relationship with the most important person in the world: you.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Morning Pages offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
$7.99 per month
$39.99 per year (that's a 58% saving!)
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iCloud Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iCloud Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iCloud Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
Read our terms and conditions here:
https://morningpages.app/terms
Read our privacy policy here:
https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/66628557

bluejetty:00129404:ios.description:
Welcome to HEADSUP, the real IO game on your smartphone! Relax, the rules are simple. Just eat everything around and grow your snake in size! Join the party and have fun! Take part in a real action against giant monsters in this crazy and fun .IO game! Get into the arena against customized snakes and defeat them all like in a real battle royale! Play and get on top of the leaderboard! Are you ready?
Eat and grow
Get through a field of sugar or yummies and eat to make your HEAD grow up! Destroy enemies and a pleasant surprise awaits you - additional sweets will fall out of them! But beware of giant monsters on your way! If you miss a moment and can't dodge in time, you'll just be eaten whole! 
Collect boosters
In addition to tasty treats, many boosters will be waiting for you in the arena. Speed up, use a food magnet, and become invincible! make your task to win the battle royale match much easier Collect all the boosters to get various bonuses and take down all enemies!
Climb to the top of the leaderboard
Defeat all opponents and climb to the top of the rating. Finish the race in the first place! Feel the taste of victory and be faster than your opponent!
Beautiful 3D skins!
Choose your favorite character and show that you are the fastest snake on the map and the most beautiful one! Win everyone with the style!
Play anytime, anywhere.
Take the game with you on a trip and get incredible emotions from HEADSUP even on the road!
Game Features:
- Eat snacks to grow your snake
- Collect various power-ups to get the upper hand
- Climb to the top of the leaderboard
- Unlock all skins for your snake
- Easy control
- Beautiful minimalistic 3D graphics
- User-friendly interfaces
- HAVE FUN!
Fly into a crazy party with yummy treats and giant HEADS. Use various bonuses, to survive giant snakes and smash enemies to climb to the top of the leaderboard! Play anywhere and open all screens. And the most important - have fun in this snake battle royale! What are you waiting for? Download and play!

• Click to call or email Customer Service

• Retrieve your forgot username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX Health®

بإمكانك اللعب بكل سهولة وبساطة مع لعبة كملنا بلوت و جاكارو، كما يمكنك التمتع بأكثر من ذلك مع تجربة فريدة من خلال العديد من المزايا التي نقدمها
bluejetty:00169671:ios.description:
تحتوي كمِّلنا على أقوى لعبة بلوت و جاكارو على الإطلاق، وهي من أشهر ألعاب الورق في العالم العربي.
بإمكانك اللعب بكل سهولة وبساطة مع لعبة كملنا بلوت و جاكارو، كما يمكنك التمتع بأكثر من ذلك مع تجربة فريدة من خلال العديد من المزايا التي نقدمها لك.
تُتيح لك كملنا فرصة لعب البلوت و جاكارو بكل سهولة مع لاعبين من جميع أنحاء العالم، والدخول في منافسة معهم
بشكل واقعي وسريع. اللعب في كملنا يتيح لك مزايا كثيرة، من ضمنها :
- تواجد اللاعبين في كل الأوقات :
تتيح لك لعبة بلوت و جاكارو في كملنا الفرصة للتنافس مع العديد من اللاعبين في أي وقت، حيث يتواجد آلاف المستخدمين خلال الـ 24 ساعة باليوم.
تجربة لعب سلسة وسريعة :
تتميز تجربة المستخدم في كملنا بكونها سلسة وسريعة، حيث يمكنك اللعب مباشرة من خلال زر "العب الآن" بدون خطوات أخرى، مايجعل وقتك في التطبيق أكثر متعة
- إضافة الأصدقاء واللعب معهم :
يمكنك إضافة أصدقاءك في كملنا ودعوتهم إلى جلستك الخاصة والإستمتاع باللعب والدردشة في تجربة استثنائية وممتعة
المنافسة مع أفضل وأقوى اللاعبين :
 مجتمع كملنا يحتوي على نسبة كبيرة جدًا من اللاعبين المحترفين ذو المستويات العالية مايزيد من حدّة التنافس ويرفع مستوى التحدي
 - ذكاء اصطناعي مميز :
تماما كما هو الحال مع تجربة اللعب مع لاعبين أذكياء، فالنظام مصمم لينافس بذكاء للقيام بالحركات اللازمة للفوز باللعبة.
- اللعب المشترك على جميع المنصات:
فرصة مناسبة للتنافس مع أصدقائك بأي شكل كان، حيث تتيح لك اللعبة فرصة مشاركة اللعب بين منصات تطبيقات الهاتف وموقع اللعبة.
 دعم فني سريع جدا:
إرضاء اللاعبين هو هدفنا لذلك نقدم لكم دعم فني خلال الـ 24 ساعة، كما نستمع إلى اقتراحاتكم لتطوير اللعب لمنح تجربة أفضل للاعبين.
ومن المزايا الخاصة التي تميز لعبة البلوت في كملنا:
ـ إمكانية القطع والقيد:
لعبة البلوت في كملنا هي اللعبة الأكثر واقعية والتي تعطيك إمكانية القطع والتقييد أثناء اللعب، تماما كما في البلوت الحقيقي.
تمتع بالمزايا الإضافية عند الاشتراك والحصول على كامل الإضافات التالية بشكل مستمر :
• إنشاء وإدارة جلسات اللعب.
• اللعب الحر و اتاحة القطع والقيد أثناء اللعب.
• خاصية السوا.
• ارسال التعابير.
• الحصول على تذكرتين يوميا لكأس كملنا.
• تجربة خالية من الإعلانات.
• إضافة الأصدقاء.
• الدردشة الخاصة مع الاصدقاء.
• إمكانية تغيير اسم المستخدم.
تفاصيل الاشتراكات:
اشتراك كملنا (12.99 ر.س) لمدة اسبوع يتجدد تلقائيا
اشتراك كملنا (34.99 ر.س) لمدة شهر يتجدد تلقائيا
اشتراك كملنا (289.99 ر.س) لمدة سنة يتجدد تلقائيا
الاشتراكات تتجدد تلقائيا بعد نهاية المدة المختارة, لايقاف التجديد و الاشتراك ,يمكن للمشترك ايقاف الاشتراك من حساب الآيتونز باتباع الخطوات المذكورة في الرابط التالي:
https://support.apple.com/ar-ae/HT202039
“ملاحظة هامة: قد يتجدد اشتراكك تلقائيا اذا لم تلغِ الاشتراك قبل أن يحين تاريخ تجديده بمدة 24 ساعة”
رابط الشروط والاحكام و سياسة الخصوصية:
https://www.kammelna.com/Home/Terms
لا تنسوا أن تقيمّونا وتخبرونا عن آرائكم على البريد الإلكتروني kammelna.support@remal.com -

bluejetty:00179039:ios.name: Subscribe to My Adventure
bluejetty:00179039:ios.description:
///// Introduction /////
Subscribe to My Adventure is an RPG that simulates a real-life social platform. 
Players take on the role of a rookie streamer trying to gain followers and subscriptions through various adventures — all while striving to become a famous influencer. 
Along the way, you'll encounter modern online phenomena such as mob mentality, witch hunts, and echo chambers. As the story unfolds, the fate of the kingdom will gradually be revealed.
///// Features /////
・Realistic social platform simulation: 
The story unfolds through a virtual social network that mimics real-life social media. Chat with characters, post stories, and share private messages just like you would online. 
・Diverse adventure routines: 
Experiment with different move combinations to tackle challenges — sometimes, being entertaining can win over the audience more easily than defeating your foes! 
・Branching storylines: 
As public opinion shifts, you can align yourself with different factions, leading to unique outcomes and alternate endings. 
・Online personas and social reflection: 
The game encapsulates the behavior and identity of real-world online communities, with characters whose experiences mirror those of modern society. 
・Picture book–inspired art style: 
Embark on adventures in a beautifully illustrated world brought to life with a unique, storybook aesthetic.
///// Language Support /////
・English 
・繁體中文 
・简体中文
///// Achievements /////
・2019 Kyoto BitSummit 7 Spirits | Official Selection 
・2020 Taipei Game Show | Best Narration Nominee 
・2020 Taipei Game Show | Best Mobile Game Winner 
・2020 IMGA Global | Nominee
////////////////////
Content Warning: 
This game aims to portray authentic interactions within online communities. 
As a result, it may include harsh language or situations that could cause emotional stress for some players.
This game contains in-game offers to purchase digital goods or premium items with real-world currency (or with virtual coins or other in-game currencies purchasable with real-world currency), where players do not know in advance which specific digital goods or premium items they will receive (e.g., loot boxes, item packs, mystery rewards).
Term of Use: https://gamtropy.com/term-of-use-en/ 
Privacy Policy: https://gamtropy.com/privacy-policy-en/ 
© 2020 Gamtropy Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.

Make informed food choices with AI-powered nutrition insights
