bluejetty:00095331:ios.description:
Nori - Smart Food Scanner
Make informed food choices with AI-powered nutrition insights
Nori is a premium nutrition app that transforms how you shop for food. Simply scan any product barcode to instantly unlock comprehensive health insights, personalized recommendations, and expert guidance tailored to your dietary needs.
Key Features:
Instant Product Analysis
Scan any barcode to get detailed nutrition scores, ingredient breakdowns, and health insights powered by advanced AI analysis.
Objective Scoring System
Every product receives a 0-100 score based on:
Nutrition Quality - Macros, vitamins, and beneficial compounds
Safety - Additives, chemicals, and potentially harmful ingredients
Processing Level - From whole foods to ultra-processed
Personalized Fit Scores
Get recommendations tailored to your:
Dietary preferences (Vegan, Keto, Gluten-Free, and more)
Health goals (Weight loss, muscle gain, heart health, etc.)
Allergens and food sensitivities
AI Food Expert
Chat with your personal nutrition expert for:
Product-specific questions
Meal planning advice
Healthy snack recommendations
Nutrition tips tailored to your goals
Smart Alternatives
Discover healthier options with our intelligent recommendation engine that suggests better alternatives in the same category.
Additional Features:
Browse top-rated products by category
Save favorites for quick reference
Track recently viewed items
Search thousands of products
Beautiful, intuitive interface
Premium Access
Nori is a premium-only app with no free trial. Your subscription unlocks full access to all features including unlimited scans, AI expert chat, personalized recommendations, and comprehensive product analysis.
Why Premium?
We believe in providing unbiased, ad-free nutrition guidance. Your subscription ensures we work for you - not food companies - delivering honest, science-based insights without compromise.
Perfect For:
Health-conscious shoppers
Parents seeking healthier options for their families
Anyone with dietary restrictions or allergies
Fitness enthusiasts optimizing their nutrition
People managing health conditions through diet
Download Nori today and transform your relationship with food. Make every shopping trip count with intelligent, personalized nutrition guidance at your fingertips.
Note: Nori provides nutritional information and should not replace professional medical advice. Always consult healthcare providers for specific dietary needs.
Subscription required to use - 3 day free trial available.
To access our terms of service, please use this link - https://kinetic-apps.notion.site/Terms-of-Use-2131a161b0c98092b410cbeb01968ddb?

bluejetty:00027471:android.description:
※ The first, greatest network game in the universe. Go on rides for free with friends! 
※ No more building rides and facilities! Just ride and enjoy them together!
※ Recommended for those who enjoy rides and love theme parks.
※ A fun game to go on rides without long waits and tiresome moving around at no cost. 
★ Game Overview ★
Theme Park Rider Online is a game where you can enjoy various thrilling and exciting rides for free with your friends from all around the world. If you are ready to leave reality and escape to a fantasyland full of adventures and mysteries, explore this free face-paced mobile game, “Theme Park Rider Online!” Go! Go! Go! 
★ Game Features ★
1. Popular rides such as rollercoasters, merry-go-rounds, bumper cars, gyro drops, flume rides, and many more are all gathered here. The best free game to enjoy everything at once.
2. 5 different mysterious theme parks including magic castle, ice kingdom, haunted island, the Wild West, and race town invite all of you. 
3. There are not only rides! Various attractions are waiting for you: Giant Zone to transform into a giant, Zero Gravity Zone to experience zero gravity in the universe, and Dance Zone to dance with joy. Come and enjoy them! 
4. Make your own cute, unique characters with more than 100 styling items such as a panda, Frankenstein, scream mask and hat, RC car, Optimus Prime car transformation item, Santa costumes for limited season only, and many others. 
5. Anyone from those with acrophobia, the weak and the elderly who have a weak heart, short children, and to women afraid of scary things can all enjoy. No time to be bored. Have fun in Dream Land with your friends! 
★ Introducing Theme Land Rides ★
1. Magic Kingdom Attraction : Sky Adventure, Stunt Coaster, Twist Rider, Magic Swing, Manic Karts(Bumper Car)
2. Frozen Land Attraction : Frozen Coaster, Winter Carousel, Viking
3. Horror Land Attraction : Dynamic Ghost Train, Jet Scream, Panic Star
4. Western Land Attraction : Sand Blast, The Kraken, Hurricane Bat, Mine Booster
5. Racing Land Attraction : Mushroom Fly, Ferris wheel, Psyclone, Wild Drop Top

bluejetty:00126329:ios.description:
O Omelete agora tem app.
Mais de 20 anos falando de cinema, séries, animes, games e HQ — agora no seu bolso, com um lugar pra organizar o que você quer ver, o que já viu e o que vale recomendar pros amigos.
NOTÍCIAS E CRÍTICAS
Tudo o que sai no Omelete, na hora que sai. Filtre por filmes, séries e TV, animes, coreanos, games, HQ e livros ou música e leia só o que interessa. Salve pra depois e volte quando der.
VÍDEOS E PODCASTS
Assista aos vídeos do canal e ouça os podcasts sem sair do app. O player continua tocando enquanto você faz outras coisas.

Sinopse, elenco, trailers, temporada por temporada e — o mais importante — onde assistir. Dá pra avaliar, escrever sua crítica e ver o que a comunidade achou antes de apertar o play.

Favoritos, assistir depois, playlists e rankings do seu jeito. Tudo salvo na sua conta, disponível em qualquer aparelho.
PEDIR UMA DICA
Sabe aquela meia hora rolando o catálogo sem escolher nada? Diz se quer filme ou série, o gênero e o streaming que você assina. A gente escolhe por você.
RECOMENDE PROS AMIGOS
Mande um filme ou série direto pra alguém, receba as indicações de quem você segue e acompanhe o que a galera anda vendo.
BOLÕES E QUIZZES
Bolão do Oscar, quiz nerd e outras disputas que aparecem por aqui de tempos em tempos. Vale palpite e vale prêmio.
ASSINATURAS NUM SÓ LUGAR
Assine streamings pelo Omelete, acompanhe quanto você gasta por mês e veja quanto tempo realmente usa cada serviço.

bluejetty:00185038:ios.summary: Take the loot you pirate! One Piece Bounty Rush is a 3D anime battle arena treasure looting game set in the popular manga pirate world of One Piece! Join Luffy, the famous Straw Hat Pirate and all your favorite characters from the One Piece
bluejetty:00185038:ios.description:
Take the loot you pirate! One Piece Bounty Rush is a 3D anime battle arena treasure looting game set in the popular manga pirate world of One Piece! Join Luffy, the famous Straw Hat Pirate and all your favorite characters from the One Piece universe in 4 vs 4 real-time pvp battles to rush and loot the treasure of berry coins for victory!
4 vs 4 MULTIPLAYER TREASURE LOOTING ACTION
• Exciting capture the flag-style anime pirate action
• 2 teams of 4 players battle in real-time to loot the most treasure
• Rush to grab more Berry coins to reach victory
CREATE THE ULTIMATE PIRATE CREW
• Battle rival teams using popular One Piece anime characters from Luffy to Zolo
• Mix & match characters to form the strongest treasure looting team!
• Collect Character Fragments during battle to unlock more characters!
DEEP SEA GAMEPLAY AND LEVEL UP SYSTEM
• Strategize character class selections (Attacker, Defender, Runner) to collect the most treasure
• Upgrade your character’s grade level and skills through League and Solo battles
• Equip characters with Medals to give them battle changing Traits!
EXPERIENCE THE ONE PIECE UNIVERSE
• The One Piece manga world reimagined as the battlefield in beautiful 3D
• Battle at iconic locations from the anime including the seafaring Baratie restaurant and the Alabasta desert kingdom.
• Every match comes complete with items from the One Piece universe to give your team the upper hand.
Are you pirates ready to loot some treasure? Grab your crew and join the quest to become the Pirate King in One Piece Bounty Rush!

bluejetty:00080925:ios.description:
Santa Biblia NTV - Biblia Nueva Traducción Viviente.
Ya llego a App La Santa Biblia NTV Nueva Traducción Viviente es el libro inspirado por Dios y escrito por los hombres que el eligió para cumplir su propósito, en ella vemos el carácter de Dios.
Lee y aprende la palabra del Señor con Nuestra APP que contiene las versiones de Santa Biblia ,Revisada y cotejada con los textos en hebreo, arameo y griego-Con notas explicativas y pasajes correlacionados con los libros canónicos de La Iglesia de Jesucristo de los Santos de los Últimos Días-Publicado por La Iglesia de Jesucristo de los Santos de los Últimos Días .
La Nueva Traducción Viviente es una colección de escritos antiguos que contienen registros de los tratos y las instrucciones de Dios para con Sus hijos. La palabra Biblia es de origen griego y significa “los libros”. Aunque a menudo pensamos que la Biblia es como un solo libro, en realidad es una biblioteca divina encuadernada en un solo volumen.
Biblia Nueva Traducción NTV es una aplicación que te permite navegar a través de toda la sabiduría de la Palabra de Dios en un lenguaje simple y claro con sólo unos pocos clicks.
La biblia está dividida en antiguo y nuevo testamento, usted puede seleccionar el libro que usted desea y comenzar a leer los capítulos de la biblia, al lado de cada libro está el número de capítulos correspondiente.
BENEFICIOS de Biblia Nueva Traducción NTV:
- Acceso a los libros de Santa Biblia (NTV)
- Puedes Agradar el Texto a tu agrado
- Dispone de modo noche para una mejor lectura de la Biblia.
- Puedes copiar los textos de la app y compartirlos
- Acceso a la Biblia completa Biblia NTV Traducción Viviente - para leer aun sin conexión! 
- Aplicación bíblica fácil, inteligente y bien diseñada fuera de línea
- Interfaz amigable al usuario y de rápido acceso a los libros, capítulos y versículos.
En Biblia Nueva Traducción NTV encontrarás recursos bíblicos tan interesantes como:
- Estudio de la Biblia donde encontrarás en Antiguo Testamento y el Nuevo testamento.
- Cómo interpretar la Biblia: Aprenda a usar la Biblia como se merece y a interpretarla bien siguiendo todas las fichas que se muestran.
- Mundo Bíblico: Es el estudio de la historia de la nación de Israel: los patriarcas, el éxodo, la monarquía, el cisma, el exilio y el destierro.
- Como estudiar la Biblia: te enseña por dónde empezar a leerla, la frecuencia con que debes hacerlo, la cantidad que debes leer por cada vez o cómo utilizarla.
- Bosquejos para Predicas: disfruta de contenidos con reflexiones poderosas acerca de las Santas Escrituras y recursos variados para elaborar tus presentaciones, sermones y predicas en tu iglesia o en tu reunión de celula o en el hogar.
- Bosquejos de sermones para predicaciones cristianas. Predica y estudia la palabra de Dios con la ayuda de estos magníficos bosquejos que ponemos a tu disposición.
- Temas Bíblicos: dividido en una serie de artículos que van desde el aborto hasta la vida nueva, pasando por temas tan variados como el alcohol, la amistad, la depresión.
- Diccionario Teológico: Totalmente offline para que usted pueda consultar cuando desee todas las definiciones acerca de la teología.
- Estudios Bíblicos
- Temas y devocionales Cristianos
- Evangelio del día
… y muchos más recursos Bíblicos
¡Lleve la Santa Biblia Nueva Traducción NTV a todas partes! Los mejores consejos para sobrellevar los problemas más complicados de la vida se encuentran en sus páginas. Las escrituras son muy útiles y ayudan a muchas familias a ser felices.
La Aplicación Santa Biblia (NTV) Nueva Traducción Viviente se considera una herramienta eficiente para el estudio de la palabra de Dios, el autor intelectual es Dios.
¡ Descarga ahora Biblia Nueva Traducción NTV ¡

bluejetty:00091661:ios.summary: Discover seamless parking like never before with the all-new MyPark 2.0 App – completely redesigned for a modern, intuitive experience that puts convenience at your fingertips. Powered by our patented MyPark device, which physically reserve
bluejetty:00091661:ios.description:
Discover seamless parking like never before with the all-new MyPark 2.0 App – completely redesigned for a modern, intuitive experience that puts convenience at your fingertips. Powered by our patented MyPark device, which physically reserves your spot with automated gate control, MyPark transforms everyday parking into a smarter, more rewarding journey. Whether you're zipping into a spot or unlocking exclusive deals from nearby businesses, with sleek visuals, effortless payments via Apple Pay and Google Pay, and real-time promotions tailored just for you, parking has never been this effortless or exciting.
Effortless Parking Management: Secure your spot in three simple steps: 1. Select your spot (with location and section pre-selected based on your position). 2. Tap 'LET ME IN' to lower the gate on the MyPark device. 3. Park and go! The device automatically tracks your time, raises the gate when you leave, ends your session, and sends a receipt – no need to worry about adding time or extensions.
Exclusive MyPark Deals: Unlock targeted coupons, discounts, and messages from local merchants upon arrival, driving you straight to nearby hotspots and enhancing your overall experience.
Modern Design & Security: Enjoy a fresh, user-friendly interface with dark mode support, multi-language options (English/Spanish), and top-tier security compliant with GDPR for peace of mind.
Advanced Features for All: From AI-driven recommendations to easy integration with web apps, plus robust analytics for partners – all backed by AWS for reliable, scalable performance.
Do you know a parking lot or garage that needs MyPark? Send an email with information about the location to info@usemypark.com and we’ll get in touch with them. 
If you like our app, please leave a review. It helps us to invest more in making the app better and expanding to new markets. 
If you encounter a bug or other problem, please email support@usemypark.com and we’ll be happy to help. We are not able to answer comments in the app store.

bluejetty:00022428:ios.description:
Never miss taking a medication again. NudgeHero is the most reliable med reminder and pill tracker for iPhone & iPad, specifically engineered for those who find standard notifications too easy to ignore. 
HOW IS NUDGEHERO DIFFERENT?
While other apps stop at a single ping, NudgeHero stays with you, using a sophisticated multi-channel escalation system with text messages and automated voice calls. This ensures you and your family stay on track with every medication, vitamin, and supplement.
Whether you are managing a complex post-op recovery, chronic conditions, or simply keeping your family’s wellness in check, NudgeHero provides the peace of mind.
----- CORE FREE FEATURES ------
SMART MEDICATION TRACKER
Maintain a digital medicine cabinet with precise logging for dosages, frequencies, and administration instructions. This reduces the risk of double-dosing or missed intervals with a real-time intake history that serves as a digital diary for your healthcare provider.
DEPENDABLE REMINDERS & ADAPTIVE SCHEDULING
Receive high-priority alerts tailored to your specific daily routine and biological clock. Eliminate "notification fatigue" by setting reminders that only trigger when you are actually able to take your meds, ensuring 100% adherence.
INTELLIGENT ESCALATING ALERTS
Our proprietary system allows for scheduling alerts of increased frequency and intensity until you confirm your dose. Ideal for heavy sleepers or busy professionals.
AS-NEEDED (PRN) MANAGEMENT
Track "as-needed" medications for pain, anxiety, or allergies while enforcing safe minimum intervals. Prevent accidental overuse and safely manage medication windows.
COMPLEX & CYCLICAL SCHEDULES
Support for every-other-day, specific weekdays, or rotating medication intervals. Rest assured knowing we include professional-grade flexibility that handles the most complicated pharmaceutical regimens.
COMPREHENSIVE SHARED CARE REPORTS
Export detailed adherence PDF reports to share with doctors, caregivers, or family members via email or secure messaging. Improve clinical outcomes by providing your doctor with 100% accurate data on your medication consistency.
GLOBAL TIME ZONE ADAPTATION
NudgeHero automatically shifts your schedule based on your current GPS location when traveling. This allows you to stay protected while flying across time zones.
PRIVACY-FIRST ARCHITECTURE
Your sensitive health data remains strictly confidential. We never sell or share your health information with third parties or advertisers. Your health is your business.
►►►UPGRADE TO PREMIUM 
NudgeHero Premium includes the industry's most robust notification suite:
• MULTI-CHANNEL REDUNDANCY: Go beyond app pings. Receive SMS text reminders, automated phone calls, and email alerts to ensure you never miss a dose!
• FAMILY GUARDIAN MODE: Act as a "Supporter" for family members, children or elderly parents. If they miss a dose and fail to respond to the escalation, you receive an immediate alert to intervene. NudgeHero supporters view real-time adherence data for supported individuals and can easily reach-out via the app to nudge a loved one to action.
• DEPENDENT MEDICATION SCHEDULES: Manage medications for multiple family members, particularly children who do not have a phone. Track everyone’s schedule on your device and rest assured that medications are taken as prescribed, including as-needed (PRN) medications which are easy to overdose.
Don't leave your wellness to memory. NudgeHero is your dedicated health partner. Join thousands of users who have traded "forgetting" for "flourishing."
Download NudgeHero now and experience the security of the world's most persistent health companion.
________
Contact: https://nudgehero.com/feedback
NudgeHero does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your healthcare provider for questions regarding your medications or a medical condition.

bluejetty:00015412:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00015412:ios.description:
The perfect app for kids 2-8 years olds and cat lovers!
Little Kitten is every child's dream pet - a cheeky, funny and adorable little friend. Take a ride on the airplane, shoot some hoops, play hide & seek and bed trampoline or get creative with paw painting - you can always have a great time with your kitten pal! Explore the kitten's world and discover cute animations, laugh with and care for your adorable, realistic pet.
The unique game-design encourages children to explore the room with minimal use of icons or menus. The 7 mini-games offer a wide variety of interactions and are designed so they appeal to a wide age range. The philosophy is not about winning, losing or competition, it's about having fun in a child-friendly environment and learning without even realizing it! Great Mini-Games with purpose!:
1) Kitten Hide&Seek - encourages focus and attention.
2) Paw Painting - creativity unleashed! Mix red, yellow, blue to get every imaginable colour - your child will learn realistic paint mixing, then come up with your own masterpiece using a paw print or a standard brush.
3) Mouse & Cheese - Memorize where the zones are to sneak mouse past little kitten over to the cheese. Or just have some laughs seeing what happens when little kitten catches the mouse!
4) Bed Trampoline - Discover all little kitten's hidden tricks and moves!
5) Animal Puzzle - Educational 'mix and match' funny animal combinations to earn biscuits that you can then feed to your little kitten.
6) Feeding - Each time you play a mini-game you receive cat food snacks, children love feeding the little kitten and watching it licking its lips and purr after a good feed! 
7) Cat-in-the-box - Educational 'hand-eye coordination' mini-game 
8) Balloon Popping - can you discovered all the different shapes?!
Not using any text menus, the game can be easily navigated by young children. Parents have the option to limit screen time for their kids: after a chosen time, the kitten gets tired and goes to sleep.
Little Kitten is a high-tech app - using the latest 3d animation technology to create the visuals, it also uses cutting edge programming to maximize the user experience on your apple device. Enjoy the premium quality content in this original app brought to you by Squeakosaurus. 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try before you subscribe! Download the app to start your 1-week free trial with full access.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase after the free trial period ends.
• Subscriptions are available as monthly or annual plans and unlock unlimited play across all the Little Kitten bundled apps!
• Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your device Account Settings — no cancellation fee.
• Restore purchases on a new device using Restore in the app (parent gate required).
• Subscribers enjoy unlimited access, with optional parent play-time limits available in Settings.
• Members of your Apple Family may share this subscription when Family Sharing is enabled.
• Questions? Contact us at support@squeakosaurus.com
Privacy Policy
Little Kitten is designed with children and families in mind. We are committed to protecting your privacy and your child’s privacy, and we follow applicable children’s privacy laws including COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule).
Privacy policy: https://squeakosaurus.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://squeakosaurus.com/terms-of-use

We are a German based studio and the creators of the Little Kitten brand. We develop high-quality apps for children aged 2-8 years. We are parents ourselves and place great importance on creating child-friendly products that enrich our children's lives and promote learning. We work with selected highly skilled artists from around the world to produce outstanding products, because kids deserve the best!

bluejetty:00074059:ios.description:
Command is a browser designed for making sense of the internet.
The browser comes with a web highlighter, internet journal, and integrations to major notes apps.
WEB HIGHLIGHTER
Read the internet like a book with Command’s web highlighter. Markup pages to help read webpages.
INTERNET JOURNALS
Capture the information you come across into Command Journals. Save things like memes, webpages, and more for easy access.
READING LIST
Save articles to read and annotate at a later time without filling up your bookmarks. Articles can even be added from outside the app!
INTEGRATIONS
Command integrates with major notes apps like Notion, Readwise, and OneNote so that you can remember what you read and send the things you collect to your knowledge base.
STAY FOCUSED
With highlighting, ad blocking, and no notifications, Command is designed to keep you focused while you read.
BE SECURE
With no third party servers your data stays with you. Command uses iCloud to sync – not 3rd party servers.
We use Biometric locks to keep your private tabs secure.
No sign up necessary to use Command.

Transform any space into a vibrant, immersive environment with RGB LED Light Remote Control, the ultimate app for personalized lighting control. 
Whether you’re setting the mood for a relaxing evening, hosting a lively party, or syncing your lights to your favorite music, this app puts the power of dynamic illumination in your hands.
* Why Choose RGB LED Light Remote Control? 
Designed for both simplicity and sophistication, this app bridges the gap between advanced lighting control and user-friendly design. 
Whether you’re a tech enthusiast or just looking to enhance your space, RGB LED Light Remote Control offers intuitive controls alongside powerful features. 
Set the stage for unforgettable moments - dim the lights for a cozy movie night, pulse them to the beat of a dance playlist, or create a calming gradient for meditation. The possibilities are endless. 
* Key Features:
- Music Sync - Let your lights groove to the rhythm of your favorite tracks. The app analyzes audio in real-time, syncing colors and effects to the beat for a fully immersive experience. 
- Gradient Mode - Enjoy seamless, hypnotic color transitions that flow effortlessly from one shade to another, creating a mesmerizing visual effect. 
- Strobe Mod - Add a pulsating, energetic vibe to your space. Perfect for parties, workouts, or whenever you want to inject some excitement into your environment. 
- Beat-Driven Flashing - Take music synchronization further with dynamic flashes that respond to every bass drop and high note, turning your room into a live light show. 
- Color Customization - Craft a one-of-a-kind atmosphere by choosing from millions of hues. Match your lighting to your decor, mood, or even the time of day for a truly personalized experience. 
- Adjustable Brightness - Tailor your illumination to perfection. From soft, ambient glows to bright, energizing light, you have full control over intensity. 
Download RGB LED Light Remote Control today and redefine the way you light up your world.

- Play daily events and compete against other players
- Put your skills to the test with daily and career challenges
- Enjoy special three-card bonus payouts
- Get free chips with multiple bonuses daily
- Keep track of your performance with hand analysis and win rates
While all of your friends at the casino are off playing craps, blackjack, Texas hold'em poker, bingo, slots or even solitaire, rest assured that you will be ready to hit the jackpot during your next trip to Vegas!

bluejetty:00026972:ios.description:
Meet your Oahu tour guide. Discover GPS audio tours that turn your drive or walk into a guided adventure with stories, directions, and local insights.
Imagine walking through Waikiki or driving along Oahu’s North Shore when your phone starts telling you exactly what you’re looking at — a historic site, a scenic overlook, a story you would’ve missed — that’s how Shaka Guide works.
Explore Oahu with Shaka Guide, a 4.9-star GPS audio tour app trusted by thousands of travelers and made in Hawaii.
Our GPS audio tours play automatically as you drive or walk, guiding you with stories, directions, and local insights, completely offline.
WHY SHAKA OAHU
• GPS audio tours that play based on your location
• Works 100% offline — no cell service needed
• Built-in maps with preplanned routes and navigation
• Driving and walking tours across the island
• Explore at your own pace — no schedules or groups
• Stories, Hawaiian music, and local travel tips
It’s like having a tour guide in your car. No crowds or time limits.
HOW IT WORKS
Download a tour, start exploring, and go.
• Audio plays automatically along your route
• Get directions, stories, and recommendations in real time
• Stop where you want, skip what you don’t, or explore over multiple days
No rushing. No rigid plans. Just a better way to explore Oahu.
EXPLORE OAHU TOURS
GRAND CIRCLE ISLAND TOUR
6 hours • 23 stops

• Haleiwa
• Shark’s Cove
EAST OAHU SHORELINE DRIVE
6 hours • 19 stops

• Diamond Head

• Ho’omaluhia Botanical Garden
HONOLULU RAINFOREST TOUR
3 hours • 11 stops

• Manoa Falls
• Chinatown
• Lyon Arboretum
NORTH SHORE LOOP
6 hours • 24 stops
• Dole Plantation
• Kawela Bay

• Kahuku food trucks
WAIKIKI WALKING TOUR
1 hour
• Waikiki Beach
• International Marketplace
• Royal Hawaiian Hotel
HISTORIC DOWNTOWN HONOLULU
1 hour
• Iolani Palace
• Kawaiaha’o Church
• Honolulu Hale
SAVE WITH THE ISLAND BUNDLE
Get all 6 tours for over 50% off.
TRUSTED BY TRAVELERS
What travelers say:
“Best way to explore Oahu at our own pace.”
“It felt like having a tour guide with us the whole time.”
“We discovered so many places we would’ve missed.”
PLAN LESS. EXPERIENCE MORE.
Skip the research. Travel smarter. Discover more along the way.
IMPORTANT NOTES
• Download tours on Wi-Fi before your trip
• Continued GPS use may drain battery — bring a charger
• Wi-Fi-only iPads are not supported

bluejetty:00175404:ios.description:
Forget about having to look for new phone ringtones once and for all! 
Our ringtone maker allows you to create any ringtone you like. 
Pick an existing audio or video file to cut yourself a unique ringtone on the go. 
With Garage Ringtones, you get an easy-to-use and intuitive ringtone maker packed with useful features:
Set your new ringtones from existing files;
Customize your notification sounds;
Cut your favorite tunes and audio files to get 100% custom ringtones in no time;
Set unique ringtones for any contacts you desire to know who’s calling you without looking at the screen. 
And the cherry on the pie? Garage Ringtones is making ringtone selection easier for you! We have a dedicated TikTok channel where we handpick the juiciest and most popular songs for you to download and use as ringtones. 
Our TikTok channel is brimming with content. From recent hits to cult classics, Garage Ringtones’ collection of songs is always there for you!
Garage Ringtones uses GarageBand to export edited songs or audio files to ringtones. Don’t worry - the process is very straightforward and won’t take longer than a minute or two. Garage Ringtones features an in-app video with step-by-step guidelines on exporting your favorite tunes without breaking a sweat!
The app also supports ‘fade in’ and ‘fade out’ features and allows you to browse your edit history. 
With Garage Ringtones, you get the one ringtone maker to rule them all! User-friendly, with a brief and detailed tutorial, the possibility to use any TikTok audio as custom ringtones, and bonus access to our TikTok channel with all the top hits from both modern music artists and famous classical performers.

ℹ️ Simply Plural is an app designed for plurals/systems who want to keep track of their members and optionally share those details with their friends. The app also includes functionality to vote per member on decisions within the system.

📈 See your front history in a handy graph that shows every person who fronted.

🛡️ We designed the app privacy-first and any data that is not explicitly set to shared by you will not be shared with anyone.

🦽 The app is built with accessibility in mind and comes with high contrast mode and dark mode for both dark and bright mode. In addition, you can scale up and down the font size. If you have any accessibility concerns we are very interested in listening.

🤝 In addition, we added the possibility to share who's front and to allow specific people or systems of your choosing to be notified of front changes, to more easily communicate who is front.

❓ Should you need support with using this app or you are experiencing issues, do let us know on our Discord, we'd be happy to help.

Our Discord: https://discord.gg/hcWGEJVFQb

Finally, we hope you enjoy this app :)

bluejetty:00161507:ios.description:
Kanfit is your personal trainer and nutrition coach — in one app.
Most fitness apps make you do the work. Kanfit does it with you. It builds a training plan around your goals, tracks every meal from a single photo, and adapts as you get stronger — all powered by intelligence that runs right on your device.
Track meals with a photo
Point your camera at your plate and Kanfit instantly recognizes the food, estimates calories, and breaks down protein, carbs, and fat. Scan a nutrition label, adjust servings, fine-tune the details, and log it in seconds. No more searching endless databases or guessing portions.
Nutrition that keeps up with you
Set daily calorie and macro targets and watch them update with every meal. Search a full food database, save your favorites, create custom foods, and review any day on a clean calendar. Hitting your goals has never been this simple.
A workout plan built for you
Answer a few questions about your goals, fitness level, equipment, schedule, and any injuries — and Kanfit generates a personalized plan from day one. It chooses the right exercises, learns what you like, and adjusts over time, just like a real coach.
A complete exercise library
Explore hundreds of exercises with clear instructions and form guidance. Don't like a move or missing the equipment? Swap it instantly for a smarter alternative that fits you.
Guided workouts, start to finish
Follow each session step by step with built-in timers, set tracking, and live heart rate when you connect a compatible sensor. Live Activities keep your workout on the Lock Screen so you stay in the zone.
Record every run and ride
Track outdoor runs, walks, and rides with GPS, or pair directly with Bluetooth gym machines — treadmills, bikes, and rowers — for accurate live stats. Every session ends with a detailed summary of distance, pace, calories, and heart rate.
Adaptive running plans
From your first 5K to a full marathon, Kanfit builds a progressive running plan and adjusts it to your performance, week after week.
See your progress clearly
A clean dashboard tracks your week at a glance — personal records, weight trend, BMI, activity streaks, and more. Real numbers that show how far you've come.
Train with friends
Share your progress, follow your friends, and stay motivated together with a social feed built right into Kanfit.
Works with your world
Sync with Apple Health, add home screen widgets, and keep everything in one place.

bluejetty:00121977:ios.description:
Welcome to the Sandbox Coloring Universe and be ready to become a lover of the coloring of tiny pixel art.
Four facts about Sandbox:
• Children feel how light, sweet and funny Sandbox is and that it's made just for them. It’s like cartoons, but they can participate in the performance, not only watch.
• Parents know it’s a great way for the whole family to spend time together. No Ads. Only safe art.
• Specialists know Sandbox is a great opportunity to work on your children’s or parents’ drawing and motor skills.
• Teachers know Sandbox is a great way to teach their kids or students basic number recognition and how to use a legend.
Features available for all:
• Search whatever you want, fruits, lips, gadgets, cats or maybe easy art. Handy search feature filters all content for you.
• Magic Round Button helps you to find similar art. Just try it and you'll love it.
• Collections give you an opportunity to organize all your art in the app.
• Free Drawing Mode lets you practice drawing pixel art. The best art will be featured.
• Turning your photos from the gallery into pixel art. No words needed.
• Hints highlight the most interesting art especially for you. 
The Sandbox membership gives you an access to all the tiny pixel art in the application. 
Try the 7 day trial period and if you enjoy Sandbox, do nothing and your membership automatically continues for as long as you choose to remain a member. The base subscription fee will be 2.99$/week after the 7 day trial period or 7.99$/month or 39.99$/year. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. An account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings on the device.
Terms of Service: https://sandbox.love/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://sandbox.love/privacy.html
Best regards, Sandbox Team [with love]

bluejetty:00096652:ios.summary:
Now we can fly…
The 3d game is about a stickman on a plane who destroys enemy crowds of armed stickmen who are in funny destructible buildings and equipment. They are extremely easy to destroy when you bomb them with air flying bomb bombs
bluejetty:00096652:ios.description:
Now we can fly…
The 3d game is about a stickman on a plane who destroys enemy crowds of armed stickmen who are in funny destructible buildings and equipment. They are extremely easy to destroy when you bomb them with air flying bomb bombs or an air cannon.
Soar through vast skies and unleash chaos below with easy to master controls. Whether you are piloting a nimble fighter jet or a powerful bomber, taking aim and causing destruction bombing has never been this fun and straightforward sim airplanes games.
Watch the world below react in real time war as you drop sky bombs or jets bombing and launch missile pilot. Thanks to the realistic games destruction physics, every building crumbles, and every explosion feels satisfyingly impactful sim.
You can always improve your plane, add a gun or take on board a variety of aerofly sky jets bombs that will amusingly destroy army buildings and aeroplane equipment of enemy stickmen. It is possible to purchase various aircraft with improved characteristics and even a fighter carpet.
Conquer enemy airports without coming under fire from enemy anti aeroplane bomber aircraft guns! Take off from yours into war battle on a special missile mission, shoot a lot and carry out sky carpet ww2 bombing, then land on the newly conquered airport of enemy stickmans pilot.
From sleek aerofly to roaring aerofly, choose your favorite bomber missile airplane and customize it to match your style. Equipped with everything from crazy payloads to conventional explosives, no two sorties will feel the same.
Various warriors opponents await you, like stick men pilot with machine missile guns, with machine guns and grenade launchers, they are located in dugouts and in trenches. There are many opponents in various aeroplane buildings on which you can accurately drop a bomb or shoot from an aircraft cannon. Jeeps, trucks, tanks, boats, crazy ww2 artillery and of course crazy bosses that challenge you.
This is a real challenge as combat helicopters, jet and drones will guard the warriors enemy airport. don't landing forget the sim stickman bazooka will chase you and try to destroy and protect your base.
Make your enemies flying into the air, blow up their bases and crush their buildings with your super airplane and powerful cannon!
The games has simple and intuitive controls. Find a weak point in the enemy structure, aim, shoot him with an aircraft cannon, making funny loops in the air! Or just landing smash it with the powerful bombs war attack!
In addition to the opportunity to show your courage and bravery, the game has:
Destruction:
 • Enjoy realistic destruction and move physics. Vivid move graphics that bring the thrill of flight and destruction to life with realistic destruction physics.
Game play choice:
 • Play the game in Company or Endless attack carpet.
Upgrades:
 • Increase Speed, turn radius, Weapons effectiveness and lots more.
Intuitive control:
 • Intuitive controls making flying and bomb a breeze for everyone.:
Dangerous enemies:
 • In this move game, the stickman warriors will attack you. Crowds of evil stickmen who want to destroy you in flight. Be careful!
Powerful arsenal:
 • There are a lot of awesomely cool aerofly available for your character. Each of them has its own unique type of ammunition. There is even a jets bomb! 
Graphics:
 • Excellent and bright graphics perfectly combined with the destructive power of your aircrafts guns and bombs!
Play without internet! 
This game can be played without the internet!
Update in progress. Write us your suggestions to improve the gameplay, we read all your comments.
Download The Planes now!

AI Antique Identifier - Discover the Secrets of Your Antiques!
Unlock the hidden history of your antiques with the AI Antique Identifier app!
Our innovative app uses advanced AI technology to analyze and identify your treasured items, providing you with detailed insights and information about their origins, value, and more.
Key Features:
Instant Image Recognition
Simply take a photo of your antique or upload an existing image, and our AI will quickly analyze it to provide accurate identification and relevant information.
Detailed Analysis
Receive a thorough report on your antique, including its history, estimated value, and tips for preservation. Whether it's furniture, pottery, jewelry, or artwork, we cover it all!
Smarter, More Accurate Results
Our upgraded AI understands your items in greater depth and surfaces more related pieces, giving you richer context and better value estimates on every find.
Ask the Expert
Have a follow-up question? Chat directly with our AI antique expert for deeper insights, second opinions, and answers tailored to your specific item.
Join the Community
Show off your best finds and see what other collectors are discovering. Create your collector profile, share the items you've identified, and climb the leaderboard as you grow your collection.
Save Your Antiques to the Collection
Keep track of your searches and analyses with our history manager, making it easy to revisit past inquiries and rediscover your favorite pieces.
Why Choose AI Antique Identifier?
Whether you're a seasoned collector or just starting your journey into the world of antiques, our app is designed to empower you with knowledge. Discover the stories behind your cherished items and ensure they are valued and preserved for generations to come!
Download AI Antique Identifier today and embark on your adventure in the fascinating world of antiques!

bluejetty:00014968:ios.description:
From the creators of “Prepare for Impact”, in the context of an international aviation safety project (http://hcilab.uniud.it/aviation/), this first-of-its kind, feature-packed app immerses you in the world of air safety through lots of engaging, interactive 3D experiences:
Safety Coach - Choose your personal coach between Kate and Luke, our AI-based, expert flight attendants. They will always be willing to explain you any aspect of passenger safety you are interested in, and guide you with personalized feedback as you try out safety procedures first-hand.
Games Room - Have fun with different aviation safety games, made to meet different tastes. They range from simulations that put you in charge of coordinating aircraft evacuations (AirEvac: Land and AirEvac: Sea) to fast-paced first-person action (aircraft Door Ninja) and more casual and humorous games (Plane Escape and Launch Vest).
Your Fleet - Build your own fleet, choosing among real aircraft operated by airlines today. You can personalize the livery of each aircraft, the features of your home base airport, inspect your airliners, and even send them to transport passengers and travel miles around the world.
Note that, as always, our apps are completely free and all their features can be unlocked by just playing (no interrupting ads, and no in-app purchases at all).

bluejetty:00073055:ios.name: Nudge: Daily Reminders
bluejetty:00073055:ios.summary: Nudge is a simple daily schedule and alarm app for all the small things you keep meaning to do. Take your medicine. Drink some water. Roll the trash out. Stand up and stretch. Pick up the kids. Walk the dog. Call your mom and tell her you l
bluejetty:00073055:ios.description:
Nudge is a simple daily schedule and alarm app for all the small things you keep meaning to do. Take your medicine. Drink some water. Roll the trash out. Stand up and stretch. Pick up the kids. Walk the dog. Call your mom and tell her you love her (dad too, he is waiting).
A Nudge alarm takes about ten seconds to set up, and then it just shows up when you need it, like a friend who happens to be very good with time. Nudge is not trying to replace your calendar. Your calendar is for meetings and dentist appointments. Nudge is for the stuff you do over and over, the things that never make it onto a calendar and still manage to slip your mind.
Pick a time, choose the days, pick a sound, then give it a name, a color and an icon so you know what it is at a glance. That is the whole setup. Nothing to learn, nothing to maintain.
HOW PEOPLE USE NUDGE
• Medicine, vitamins and refills, on time and on the right days
• Water breaks and stretch breaks during long stretches at a desk
• Trash and recycling night, so the truck outside is never a surprise
• School pickup, practice, lessons and carpool
• Feeding the dog, walking the dog, the cat's medicine
• Walk, meditate, journal, whatever you promised yourself back in January
• Calling the people you love more often than you currently do
FEATURES
• Create custom alarms in seconds
• Repeat on any day, or any mix of days
• Optional 5-minute warning bell so you can finish what you are doing first
• Choose from a library of sounds
• Name your nudges and give them colors and icons
• Home screen widget with today's schedule at a glance
• Ask Siri to create a nudge without opening the app
• Light, dark, or match your system appearance
• Mute everything for a quiet day without deleting a single alarm
• Works on iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac
NUDGE PRO
Pro removes all ads, syncs your nudges across iPhone, iPad and Mac with iCloud, and unlocks more icons and sounds. The free version keeps doing everything it always did.
Got a nudge idea we should have thought of? Send it to us from inside the app. We read all of it.

bluejetty:00066133:ios.summary: Simulate a D20, D12, D10, D8, D6, D4, or D2 dice roll at any moments notice. After making a roll, add or subtract a modifier and quickly share a screenshot of the result with a single tap - perfect for texting your D&D group. Pick out your
bluejetty:00066133:ios.description:
Simulate a D20, D12, D10, D8, D6, D4, or D2 dice roll at any moments notice. After making a roll, add or subtract a modifier and quickly share a screenshot of the result with a single tap - perfect for texting your D&D group. Pick out your favorite dice skin and get rolling!
Features:
- Throw a single dice or multiple dice of any combination. Roll up to 150 of any dice type!
- Remove or reroll specific dice after any roll.
- Save and sort dice presets for your most frequently rolled dice. A preset can include any number of dice, modifier, or specific dice skin.
- View a breakdown of all previous rolls made during your current session. Each roll in your history can be quickly rerolled, saved as a preset, or copied in a text based format.
- Share a screenshot of your results with a single tap. Copy it to your clipboard or upload it directly to another app like Messages, Slack, or Discord.
- Enable "Auto Copy Result" in the settings panel to automatically copy each result to your clipboard in a text based format - great for texting your D&D group!
- Supports advantage, disadvantage, and percentage rolls.
- Add a skill modifier +/- after each roll.
- Choose between a dark or light UI.
- Enable "Quick Roll" mode in the settings panel to skip throw physics if you're in a hurry.
- Option to disable sounds and/or haptic feedback.
- Choose from 45 dice skins.
- Choose between 3 graphic quality settings.
Advertisements:
After choosing a new dice skin, a video ad will automatically play, which you can immediately skip. This is the only time you will be presented with an ad inside the app. You can also pay a small, one-time fee to remove all ads. This allows us to keep supporting and creating cool new features for the app. Thank you!

Yokara brings you a karaoke and recording experience like a professional studio, helping you break through your limits.

- Duet with your idols: Sing duets with the singers you love.

- Gifts: Interact with others and send each other attractive gifts.
- Huge music library: Enjoy many genres, including bolero, sentimental music, ballads, and more, updated every day.

- Groups: Connect with friends, family, and the singing community in private groups to chat, share recordings, and interact easily.
- Music clans: Join a clan to meet people with similar musical interests, sing scored karaoke, and receive gifts from friends.
- Recording leaderboard: Take on challenges, shine like a music star, and compete on the recording rankings.
And many more special features are waiting for you on Yokara!
EXCITING MUSIC PROGRAMS AND EVENTS
- Music events: Yokara hosts music events every day, with many attractive rewards.
- Learn and compete with Yokara: Yokara organizes singing classes and guides on using audio adjustment features to help improve your voice and prepare for music competitions.

bluejetty:00089590:ios.description:
Makeup Artist puts video tutorials, structured courses, and AI skin analysis in one place, matched to your actual skin.
Makeup Videos
Browse tutorials by technique: eye looks, contouring, lip shapes, brow work, foundation, blush, and highlight application. Each video shows the steps from the right angle at the right speed. No skipping past the parts that matter. Save the ones you use most.
Video Courses
Work through courses that build from basics to more advanced techniques. Lessons cover foundation matching, eyeshadow blending, cut creases, contour placement, and color theory. Each lesson leads to the next so skills build on each other.
AI Skin Analysis
Take a photo of your skin to get personalized suggestions: color recommendations, technique adjustments, and product direction based on what the analysis sees. No manual quiz. The suggestions update if your skin changes.
Live Makeup Guidance
Get step-by-step coaching while you apply. The live feature tells you what to do next - useful for techniques that are hard to pause and rewind for. Works for everyday looks and more involved occasion makeup.
Beauty Articles
Read short articles on trends, technique explanations, and product questions. Updated regularly - something to read between sessions or when you want context on why a technique works.
Whether you are learning the basics or refining specific techniques, Makeup Artist gives you the tutorials, courses, skin analysis, and live guidance to keep making progress.

bluejetty:00065490:ios.description:
“Hey eezy, what’s the plan today?”
eezy is your smart personal assistant, tailoring recommendations to you and your current mood. Using ground-breaking artificial intelligence, eezy plans out your entire day, recommending activities based on your personality, how you’re feeling, and where you are.
eezy’s sentient A.I. is constantly learning from you, and matches you with the perfect restaurant, café, theatre, bar, pub, club, movie, sports match, concert, or hidden gem, depending on your mood!
Discover the vibrancy of your city, whether it’s for a birthday brunch with your mum, an afternoon exploring the city by yourself, a crazy night on the town with your friends, or an experience you’ll never forget with that special someone – do it with eezy!
TAILORED TO YOU
Tired of going to the same old places that your friends like? eezy recommends unique and exciting activities for you based on your mood and personality, so you’ll always find something YOU want to do.
ALWAYS LEARNING
eezy’s sentient Artificial Intelligence is constantly improving its personalised recommendations for you, providing you with the best possible options to make your evening perfect, every evening!
BE SPONTANEOUS
Make plans in advance or see where eezy can take you right now. You can create your own custom plans, or simply let eezy take the reins! Just tell eezy your preferences, and let your new social BFF do all the planning.
DISCOVER YOUR CITY
Explore all that your city has to offer – open your mind to new places and activities! eezy is in 35+ major cities around the world, so you can find unique places to visit on your travels too!
SHARE THE FUN
Do your friends find it difficult to decide on plans? Let eezy help you. Instantly reserve tables at restaurants and bars, or book cinema and concert tickets with eezy, then share the details of your bookings with your friends with just a tap. Say goodbye to indecision and hello to your new best friend!
The eezy app is 100% free to use, and free of any ads.
So, what are you waiting for? Download eezy today.
Where will your mood take you next?

bluejetty:00175970:ios.description:
Welcome to Beauty Salon, an entertaining game for kids in which every girl can feel like a real beauty expert!
Little beauties just love experimenting with their appearance and become more and more beautiful day by day. In our educational game about the beauty parlor your kids will be able to learn everything that the real girl should know: sew clothes and pick up stylish looks, do pretty hairstyles and elegant manicures, engage in beauty and be the most unpredictable! No third-party advertising.
• kids dressing up games for little girls
• acquaintance with hairdresser's tools and creating of trendy hairstyles
• mini game for sewing your own clothes
• manicure service and design
~~~ Features of beauty salon games ~~~
~ 5 exciting kids games
Our app contains a large selection of mini-games to teach your child the basics of fashion and beauty. Learn everything that girls like so much: sewing, creating, coloring, picking up, etc. Play educational games for kids with pleasure!
~ Dress-up game and creation of modish looks for little fashionistas
Let your child feel like a real fashionista. Choose items of clothing and try to find an unforgettable outfit. A wide variety of T-shirts, shorts, dresses, shoes and accessories are waiting for you. Let your child try different combinations and put together her own closet.
~ Nail Service Salon
In our children's games for kids, your baby can learn not only how to properly care for nails, but also how to create a colorful manicure. First, use special products (cream, oil, nail clippers, etc.) to treat the cuticle, nail plate and skin of the hands, and then take on the nail polish. Choose a color you like and cover all your nails. Then apply the fun stickers and voila! Your game model's hands are beautiful and well-groomed!
~ Children's hairdressing salon
Every girl from childhood dreams of beautiful and fashionable hairstyles. And what if you learn to do them yourself? Choose the model you want to transform and start the game. Wash her head with shampoo and dry it with a hair dryer. Use curlers to get beautiful curls, and then spritz the hairstyle with fragrant perfume.
~ Mini-game about the clothes sewing
Choose the template of the dress you want to create and get to work. Cut out the patterns and assemble the product according to them. Add colors on the fabric and decorate the outfit with accessories. Kids can try to create a whole fashion collection!
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. Large wardrobe with clothes.
2. Making your own clothes.
3. Manicure.
4. Makeup.
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html
And Terms of use https://jmhdevelopers.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00041022:ios.description:
Solve puzzles and brain teasers in the detective game! In this one your goal is to find objects needed to become a hero!
You’re a detective investigating mystical cases, and you get a call from a woman who is concerned about the behavior of her son's fiancée. She suspects that her future daughter-in-law is in touch with dark forces. At their house, you notice that the fiancée is not exactly who she seems to be at first sight. You take up the case and discover the truth that makes your blood freeze. Still, you’ll have to find whoever is responsible for all the paranormal activities. Look for the items that will help you advance your investigation, solve tough puzzles, and find the culprit!
· FIND OUT WHY A HELLHOUND IS HAUNTING A MARRIED COUPLE IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles and Domini Games after you finish the main story! More collectibles await you in these unique chapters, where you can find the difference and unlock all new branches of the interactive story!
· FIND ALL THE COLLECTIBLES TO LEARN MORE ABOUT DETECTIVE WORK!
Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles to help you in your point & click quest! Are you ready to go on an exciting adventure and collect all the hidden objects while playing quest?
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, VIDEOS, AND CONCEPT ART!
Our detective games have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy! More clues await you! Choose your story and find items!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HOPS AND MINI GAMES AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Replay your favorite Domini Games quest to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
· USE A STRATEGY GUIDE THAT WILL HELP YOU REVEAL THE TRUTH!
Stuck on any level? No problem - our built-in walkthrough will always help you! Conduct your own investigation and find the object!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00124102:ios.summary: Are you a JDM fanatic or Honda lover? A speed demon? Well then get ready to put the pedal to the metal in P2R Power Rev Racing! Power Rev Racing pits you against other drag racers online and offline in a blazing street race challenge! Choos
bluejetty:00124102:ios.description:
Are you a JDM fanatic or Honda lover? A speed demon? Well then get ready to put the pedal to the metal in P2R Power Rev Racing! Power Rev Racing pits you against other drag racers online and offline in a blazing street race challenge! Choose one of over 50 authentic JDM cars and hit the streets in this highly addictive drag racing game! Swipe your finger up on the screen to manually shift gears - the fastest reflexes win big! Start your engine and get ready to race!
Car Customization
Win big in JDM racing, save up some coins, then modify your machine! Engine swaps, exhaust mods, and upgraded turbos are all at your fingertips - ready for you to put the wrench to work. Transform your car from a rice burner to a real racecar! Put your fastest JDM car on the dyno, then take it out on the asphalt for the ultimate test in a drag racing challenge! Tuning cars and car customization are the name of the game in Power Rev! 
Multiple Drag Race Games 
Feel the engine rev in multiple game modes! Compete in challenge mode to win big race payouts! You have 24 hours to win drag battles and to build out the ultimate JDM car. Here you can drag race 1v1 against the computer or online for a real challenge. Earn your racing stripes in career mode by smoking your opponents in 55 high stakes street races. Win them all to unlock a special boost for each JDM car! Just looking for a casual race? Race against the computer in Quick Race mode for the chance to pick up some dough!
Battle Online! 
Race online in head to head matches against the fastest and most talented drivers! You can drag race online against speed demons or even against the world in a racing room! Surge to the top of the leaderboard by flying down the 1/2 mile track! No wifi? No problem! You can tear up the asphalt offline in career mode or against the computer! Are you ready to rev? Download one of the best JDM racing games on the App Store today!
How to Play:
* Join a race - 3 different drag race games to choose from 
* Get ready to rev - you have a rolling start, then the race begins with three honks
* Watch the tachometer and listen to your engine! 
* Swipe up on the screen to upshift! A perfect shift at the right time puts you ahead!
* The first one across the finish line wins it all!
* Climb the leaderboard!
* Win coins and diamonds to trick out your garage!
Features:
* Drag battle online and offline in an exciting street race
* Simple and addictive one-tap manual shift gameplay
* Authentic JDM racing - choose over 50 JDM classics from rice burners to the finest Japanese drag racers inspired by real Honda cars
* Endless car customization - tuning cars makes you win more!
* Dyno your racecar and put your modifications to the test!
* Drag race games online and offline - login with and join for drag battles
Additional Info:
* P2R Power Rev Racing is a free to play drag racing game 
* Race JDM cars, experience tuning cars and car customization, and online drag racing 
* Battle your friends, or race against a random drag racer

bluejetty:00041613:ios.description:
Cardo Connect is the official companion app for managing and customizing your Cardo communication system. 
Pair your supported Cardo unit and control the features that matter most - intercom, audio, and firmware - in one clean, fast interface. 
Complete setup and configuration, manage Bluetooth and Dynamic Mesh Communication (DMC) intercom, and control music, calls, and FM radio from your phone. 
Personalize your sound with audio presets and other tuning options, use automatic day/night mode for better visibility, and access embedded pocket guides for quick help. 
A built-in Quick Access control center puts your most‑used functions on a single screen, making it easy to check device status and make quick adjustments before or during a ride. 
Cardo Connect focuses exclusively on operating your communicator, without routing, mapping, or social features - so your system works exactly the way you need it to. 
Just try it out for yourself! 
Supported Devices 
PACKTALK PRO, PACKTALK EDGE, PACKTALK NEO, PACKTALK CUSTOM, FREECOM 4X/2X, SPIRIT & SPIRIT HD, PACKTALK BOLD, PACKTALK SLIM, and many more - including co‑branded units and legacy models (with firmware upgrade). 
About Cardo: 
Cardo Systems is in the business of communication and community, offering cutting-edge devices for a variety of powersports and outdoor enthusiasts. Since pioneering the world’s first Bluetooth-based wireless intercom headset in 2004, Cardo has been responsible for many of the industry’s innovations, pushing technological boundaries and enhancing user safety. Today, Cardo products are sold in over 100 countries. Cardo is proud to be the world’s leading communication device for groups in motion.

• Human growth and development

• Counseling and helpful relationships

bluejetty:00179848:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate "Paper-to-Digital" creative companion.
Unlike simple tracing apps, PainterAR creates a complete loop from "Paper Sketch" to "Digital Art". Whether you are a beginner building confidence or a comic enthusiast pursuing professional results, you will find the perfect solution here.
【KEY FEATURES】
1. AR Drawing: Perfect Proportions
Technology makes observation intuitive.
• Stand Mode:
Stable projection with zero latency. The ideal way for beginners to master hand-eye coordination.
• Advanced AR Anchor Mode:
Lock your virtual art to the paper by snapping a custom anchor (e.g., a doodle or card). Move your phone freely to check details without drift—ideal for easels or detailed desk work.
• Smart Plane Detection:
Instantly detects surfaces without markers. Start creating anywhere, anytime.
2. Digital Inking & Coloring
Classic digital art workflow made easy.
• Import & Inking:
One-tap import of pencil sketches as a reference layer.
• Pro Brush Library:
30+ selected brushes (pencils, ink pens, markers, etc.) for any style.
3. Infinite Layers System
Modify without fear.
• Professional Layering:
Manage line art, base colors, and shadows on separate layers to keep even complex works organized.
• Non-Destructive Workflow:
Change color schemes anytime without ruining your original line art.
4. Curated Inspiration Library
Quality over quantity.
• Exclusive Originals:
Explore themes from "Fantasy Props" to "Cat Girl" and "Mystic Elf Theatre".
• Progressive Courses:
From beginner "Playful Shape Friends" to advanced "Fan Art". Every lesson blends storytelling with skills, helping you create stylish art immediately.
【WHO IS IT FOR?】
• Comic Fans: Master the "Sketch -> Import -> Color" workflow.
• Beginners: Use AR to fix proportions and build confidence.
• Pros: Visual aid for anatomy and perspective.
【AWARDS】
▶ Microsoft “Imagine Cup” – Top 3
▶ 13th “Challenge Cup” – 1st Place
▶ 2nd “Internet+” Innovation Competition – 1st Place
▶ 4th College Innovation Competition – 1st Place

bluejetty:00069429:ios.name: Quit Smoking Gradually: Alive
bluejetty:00069429:ios.summary:
Quit smoking at your own pace. Alive helps you make it happen.
Tired of cigarettes controlling your life? Alive helps you take back control without the pressure of quitting cold turkey. With a personalized plan and a simple smoking tracker
bluejetty:00069429:ios.description:
Quit smoking at your own pace. Alive helps you make it happen.
Tired of cigarettes controlling your life? Alive helps you take back control without the pressure of quitting cold turkey. With a personalized plan and a simple smoking tracker, you can gradually quit smoking, ease withdrawals, and reduce anxiety without pressure.
Unlike other apps, Alive doesn’t expect you to be smoke-free on day one. Whether you’re considering quitting, struggling with it, or adjusting to life without cigarettes, Alive supports you every step of the way.
You’re in charge. Track your progress, take it slow, pause anytime, and come back when you’re ready. No pressure, no guilt. And when you’re ready to stop smoking for good, Alive supports you with tracking tools, guidance, and gentle reminders—especially when things get tough.
Ready to break free? Alive has your back—every step of the way. Download now and begin your journey to a smoke-free life today!
Why Choose Alive to Quit Smoking?
Alive isn’t just about breaking free from cigarettes—it’s about celebrating every win along the way. The app helps your body gradually adapt to less nicotine, easing dependence and minimizing withdrawal, making your smoke-free journey smoother.
Here’s How Alive Helps:
• Track Stats & Milestones: See detailed statistics on how far you've come in real time, from cigarettes avoided to money saved. Track exactly how much you’re gaining by cutting back.
• Track Cigarette Reduction: Record your smoking patterns, progress, and reduction using our cigarette log and smoking tracker as you gradually work to stop smoking.
• Save Money: Cutting back helps your health and wallet. Track the money you’re saving with every cigarette you choose to skip.
• Monitor Withdrawals: Receive support through encouraging notifications and smart reminders, along with practical tips to manage anxiety and stay strong through cravings as you cut back.
How Does Alive Work?
1. Start by entering your smoking habits.
2. Log each cigarette with the smoking tracker. Sometimes, the waiting timer will gently ask you to pause a few minutes, helping you delay urges and build discipline.
3. Follow your personalized plan in weekly phases, gradually increasing time between cigarettes to help your body adapt to less nicotine while tracking withdrawals.
4. Track your progress & milestones. At the end of each week, you can choose to advance or stay in the current phase, giving you control to quit at your own pace.
Additionally, our Quit Smoking Savings Calculator helps you track how much money you save as you gradually reduce smoking, so you feel good in your body and your bank account.
Support After Quitting
Quitting is just the beginning. Alive stays with you every step of the way. Use the smoking tracker and cigarette log to reflect on how far you’ve come. Dive into our app for quit smoking tips, daily encouragement, and practical motivation to help you stay strong, stay smoke-free, and live the life you deserve.
Download Alive now and start your journey to quit smoking today.
Subscription & Pricing Policy
Alive is free for the first week. Choose a subscription plan that fits your budget—it’s an investment in your health with big rewards.
Consult your doctor—this app is a helpful tool, not a medical treatment. Ultimately, the final step is yours: that last cigarette and your commitment. Remember: one step is always easier than a giant leap.
Pricing varies by subscription plan. Check https://quitsmoking-app.com/ for details.
Website: https://quitsmoking-app.com/
https://dejardefumaralive.com/
Terms & Conditions: https://dejardefumaralive.com/terminos-y-condiciones/
Privacy Policy: https://dejardefumaralive.com/politica-de-privacidad/

bluejetty:00121552:ios.summary:

"[
bluejetty:00121552:ios.description:
Will you be Le Havre's next Titan of Industry?
====================
"10/10: This game will undoubtedly go down as a perennial favourite." - iPadBoardGames.org
"4/4: [A] great digital translation of this famous game." - iOS Board Games
"[E]xcellent ... as elegant an adaptation as I can imagine. If you like Agricola and/or Caylus, I strongly recommend Le Havre." - The Dish
"5/5: Very compelling and rewarding." - GameZebo
"4.5/5: if you're a fan of board games, you [...] owe it to yourself to pick this one up." - TouchArcade
====================
In this universal adaptation of the popular board game (winner of a 2009 International Gamers Award, among others), you can compete with up to 5 people — or against a computer's AI — to construct buildings and ships to support your shipping empire. An in-depth tutorial and hint system help you develop the strategy you will need to dominate the harbor.
Collect resources to build and use new buildings, while paying your workers and saving up for ships. Buildings are a good investment, but ships provide necessary income. Deciding where to put your resources early on may determine your fate later in the game, so choose wisely!
With no setup time required, no pieces to lose, and no arguments about the rules, the future of board games is here and Le Havre gives you exactly what you want — to play! 
Features
========
Universal app
Supports 3 modes of play: 
- Solo play; solitaire or against varying degrees of AI difficulty
- “Pass and play” with 2 to 5 local human players with or without AI
- Turn-based multiplayer using Game Center 
Full tutorial and in-game hints 
Eye catching design and interactive game pieces using art from the original board game
Create your own playlists from your iPod
Note: you must have iOS 5.0+ on your device in order to play online!
About
=====
Uwe Rosenberg is an award-winning German game designer. He is well known for the development of innovative card game mechanisms. He also designed Agricola, a game that dethroned Puerto Rico as the highest rated game on BoardGameGeek.com. Le Havre is a successor to that game, and the second in Rosenberg's series of economic-themed building games.
Sage Board Games is an independent software developer, focusing on bringing award winning and classic board games to mobile devices. With a veritable “who’s who” of Euro games already licensed, Sage Board Games is poised to become the premier source of board games for iPad, iPhone and iPod Touch.
Visit us: sageboardgames.com 
Like us: facebook.com/sageboardgames
Follow us: twitter.com/sageboardgames
Please send us your feedback and requests, and rate the game once you’ve bought it.

"[E]xcellent ... as elegant an adaptation as I can imagine. If you like Agricola and/or Caylus, I strongly recommend Le Havre." - The Dish

"5/5: Very compelling and rewarding." - GameZebo

"4.5/5: if you're a fan of board games, you [...] owe it to yourself to pick this one up." - TouchArcade
====================

In this universal adaptation of the popular board game (winner of a 2009 International Gamers Award, among others), you can compete with up to 5 people — or against a computer's AI — to construct buildings and ships to support your shipping empire. An in-depth tutorial and hint system help you develop the strategy you will need to dominate the harbor.

Collect resources to build and use new buildings, while paying your workers and saving up for ships. Buildings are a good investment, but ships provide necessary income. Deciding where to put your resources early on may determine your fate later in the game, so choose wisely!

With no setup time required, no pieces to lose, and no arguments about the rules, the future of board games is here and Le Havre gives you exactly what you want — to play! 


Features
========
Universal app
Supports 3 modes of play: 
- Solo play; solitaire or against varying degrees of AI difficulty
- “Pass and play” with 2 to 5 local human players with or without AI
- Turn-based multiplayer using Game Center 
Full tutorial and in-game hints 
Eye catching design and interactive game pieces using art from the original board game
Create your own playlists from your iPod

Note: you must have iOS 5.0+ on your device in order to play online!


About
=====
Uwe Rosenberg is an award-winning German game designer. He is well known for the development of innovative card game mechanisms. He also designed Agricola, a game that dethroned Puerto Rico as the highest rated game on BoardGameGeek.com. Le Havre is a successor to that game, and the second in Rosenberg's series of economic-themed building games.

Sage Board Games is an independent software developer, focusing on bringing award winning and classic board games to mobile devices. With a veritable “who’s who” of Euro games already licensed, Sage Board Games is poised to become the premier source of board games for iPad, iPhone and iPod Touch.

Follow us: twitter.com/sageboardgames

bluejetty:00177859:ios.description:
Pay once, play forever!
Circulous is an episodic mystery narrative puzzle game. In this first-person game, you take on the persona of Amanda Trouser. You have just been let go from your job. After packing your things, you wonder what you are going to do with the rest of your life. How will you afford your apartment? On the subway ride home you see an add for a job opening at Circulous…it’s almost as if the ad was put there just for you! You apply, and you end up hired!
That is only the beginning of the story. Your work at Circulous is exciting, but soon you realize there may be more to this company than you’ve ever imagined. Corporate espionage, conspiracy theories and moral dilemmas lead you through challenging puzzles that will test your wits, your allegiances, and what you think you know about…everything.
Engagement
This puzzle game pulls you in and makes it as immersive as possible. Scenes use parallax movement to make it feel like you are in Amanda’s world.
The opening scene (in which you are fired) uses story and humor to quickly place you in Amanda’s shoes.
Each scene is an animated environment that invites you to explore and notice things that may or may not be important to the story or puzzles.
The use of your phone (or iPad) is an intuitive way to keep you in the game but also make it feel as if you are truly using your device alongside the game and not just a gimmick. The OS feels like a true OS and makes the immersive nature of the game much more enjoyable.

bluejetty:00082188:ios.description:
Maldives Resort Tycoon: Welcome to your very own slice of paradise! 
In this casual tycoon simulation game, you’re the mastermind behind a bustling beachfront hotel in the stunning Maldives. 
Your guests? Affluent travelers arriving by luxurious yachts, seeking the ultimate getaway. 
- As the hotel’s visionary, you’ll oversee every detail.
From the warm welcome at the reception to the comfort of the sun loungers, every guest’s experience is in your hands. 
Your mission is to provide impeccable service, ensuring each visitor leaves with memories as radiant as the Maldivian sun. 
- The journey of a tycoon is never idle. 
You’ll meticulously clean rooms after each guest’s departure, leaving no pillow unfluffed, no surface untouched. 
Your dedication to cleanliness and order sets the standard for luxury hospitality. 
- But your role doesn’t end there.
With the money collected, you’ll embark on a grand project of upgrades and customization. 
Transform standard rooms into opulent suites with a tap of your finger. 
Choose from a palette of colors to paint a picture of relaxation and elegance.
- The expansion is endless. 
Add new rooms to accommodate the growing number of guests, hire additional workers to keep operations smooth, and enlist masseurs to provide the ultimate relaxation. 
Your receptionists will be the face of your brand, greeting guests with the promise of an unforgettable stay. 
- As you progress, you’ll unlock lavish amenities. 
A sparkling pool for a refreshing dip, massage rooms for a touch of tranquility, and marine entertainment to delight the adventurous spirit. 
Each addition enhances the customer loop, inviting them to indulge in the full spectrum of your resort’s offerings.
- The game’s environment is a feast for the senses. Juicy and colorful, it’s a world where luxury meets relaxation. 
Every room is a testament to your commitment to comfort and style. 
The theme is not just seen but felt, enveloping guests in an atmosphere of sophistication and serenity. 
In this idle arcade hybrid-casual game, you’re not just playing; you’re creating, decorating, and evolving. 
Your decisions shape the resort’s future, from the swiftness of service to the grandeur of the grounds. 
Control resources with strategic finesse, and watch as your empire flourishes. 
So, are you ready to step into the role of a lifetime? 
To craft an oasis that stands as a beacon of luxury in the vast blue of the Maldives? 
Embrace the challenge and become the ultimate resort tycoon. Your paradise awaits…
