bluejetty:00061911:ios.description:
Less learning. More music.
Professional notation without the lengthly learning process.
Whether you are capturing a musical idea, preparing lesson material or a lead sheet, or completing a large score, iWriteMusic helps you turn inspiration into finished notation efficiently.
7 reasons to choose iWriteMusic.
1. Easy to master.
Essential controls are organized clearly, so even if notation apps are new to you, you can get started without relying on a thick manual or a long series of tutorial videos.
2. Enter notes faster, your way.
With OneFlick, you can combine choices such as pitch and note value into a single gesture.
Traditional Entry lets you choose the notation item and its position separately. Use either method to match the task and the way you prefer to work.
3. Create polished, professional scores.
Flexible page-layout tools help you prepare music for practice, lessons, rehearsals, performance, and distribution. Create individual parts from a score and print directly with AirPrint.
4. Use the notation your music requires.
Create multi-track, multi-voice scores with lyrics, chord symbols, percussion, drum notation, and multi-bar rests. Add key, time, clef, and tempo changes within a piece, along with grace notes, articulations, dynamics, and full or partial transposition.
5. Keep scores and parts organized.
Manage scores and their individual parts together, and use folders to organize a growing collection of compositions and teaching materials.
6. Listen, check, and practice.
Play your score while you work. Use the mixer, solo, mute, instrument selection, loop playback, and swing playback to check your music or support daily practice.
7. Export and share for any purpose.
Export PDF, image, Standard MIDI, MusicXML, and audio files (WAV). Share editable iWriteMusic files and continue working on another device.
For composers, arrangers, songwriters, music teachers, students, singers, and instrumentalists. Use iWriteMusic for musical sketches, lead sheets, chord charts, lesson materials, choral and ensemble scores, chamber music, band music, orchestral scores, and individual parts.
iWriteMusic is free to download. Some features require one-time in-app purchases.

Snap a photo of your dry weed, and our app, powered by cutting-edge computer vision algorithms, reveals its strain name, THC level, and whether it's sativa or indica. bluejetty:00174745:ios.description:
Enjoy every adventure safely with the best technology for outdoor navigation.
Developed with the help of experienced hikers and bikers, Terra Map can meet all your needs.
►► FEATURES:
• Optimized for use on both iPhone and iPad
• Incredibly accurate and easy-to-read worldwide maps
• Maps download for offline usage
• Weather forecasts for any point on the map (Terra Map PRO users only)
• Live Sharing-Terra Map community
• Satellite imagery
• Icons and text customization for better map readability
• Easy sharing for markers and routes in various formats
• Geo-referenced photos
• Optimized battery usage for up to 14 hours of continuous track recording
• Ability to store an unlimited amount of data by activating PRO mode via inApp purchase
• Elevation and speed profile 
► MAPS
Terra Map allows you to download maps of the entire world for free with contour lines, trails, shelters and everything you need for your next hike. Once downloaded, the maps can be used even without an internet connection.
► LOADING AND SHARING MARKERS AND ROUTES
You can easily export and import tracks and markers created with Terra Map or with other third-party applications/navigators. Manage any route available on the internet or shared by a friend (GPX or KMZ formats).
► WEATHER FORECASTS
Select any point on the map in the world and get the weather forecast for the next 7 days (only for Terra Map PRO users).
► ELEVATION AND SPEED 
Elevation profile and speed graphs will be available for each recorded track.
► OPTIMIZED BATTERY USAGE
Designed to work for an entire day, Terra Map also includes a battery monitoring system that, in case of active recording, will automatically stop the track to prevent the device from running out of power.
NOTE: The effective battery duration depends by the battery condition, by the temperature and the device usage.
► LIVE SHARING
Enable Live Sharing to share your data with the Terra Map community and see all active users around you. You can chat with them and send (and receive) your markers/tracks without leaving the app.
► TYPE OF PURCHASES
Subscription: Payment will be made through your account (Apple ID). The annual subscription will be automatically renewed unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the expiration date. The user can manage their subscription and turn off automatic renewal in the account Settings section after purchase.
Unlimited: You can download and update maps forever.
Terra Map is available in a free version with some limitations.
Terms and conditions: https://www.terramap.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.terramap.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00026912:ios.description:
CPT® QuickRef from the American Medical Association
The CPT QuickRef app puts all the coding and billing tools that you need in the palm of your hand. Developed by the American Medical Association (AMA), this on-the-go reference guide quickly helps you determine the appropriate Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) codes to use for accurate billing. (This app provides suggested codes. Final code selection remains the responsibility of the individual user.)
CPT QuickRef is the only official mobile app from the AMA – the source of the CPT codeset, and experts to provide authoritative information about CPT codes and proper use. E/M codes are the most frequently used codes and arguably the most difficult to assign. The E/M Wizard (included in the free trial and with any single or multiyear Coding & Billing Pack purchase) will help physicians and qualified health care professionals select the right code according to AMA and CMS coding guidelines
The app includes a 14-day trial of full access, after which in-app purchase or activation is required. Choose a single year Coding and Billing Pack, 
• The latest information — Receive automatic when new relative value units (RVUs) and proprietary laboratory analysis (PLA) codes are released or when technical corrections are made to 2027 CPT codes
• Favorites — Select the codes you use most and save them to your favorites list
• Facility and non-facility RVUs — Use federal data on facility and non-facility work and practice expense values
• GPCIs — Set your region’s geographic practice cost index to calculate accurate Medicare payment for each procedure
• Global days — Reference the number of global days CMS assigns to a given procedure
• Color illustrations — Better understand complex procedures with 200+ procedural illustrations
• Clear references to CPT® Assistant articles — View article titles and tap for direct access with the CPT Assistant Archive add-on
• Over 4,400 Vignettes – understand exactly what procedures each code represents with typical patient and service descriptions

bluejetty:00031043:ios.description:

This is a new proposal from MediBang.
The app's beautiful canvas is waiting for you to create art. Today, try MediBang Paletta and watch your improvement skyrocket!

Key Highlights:
・User-Friendly Interface: Work effortlessly with an intuitive interface.
・World-Class Brushes: Enjoy meticulously crafted brushes for the iPad experience.
・Auto-Save: Never worry about losing a sketch again.
・Nuanced Layering: Exercise precise control over your art.

・Stabilization Tool: Create your smoothest lines ever.
・Creative Effects: Add intricate details with cool effect and stamp brushes.
・Pen Pressure Settings: Responsive and adjustable settings to suit you.
・Unique Brushes: Explore dozens of brushes designed exclusively for MediBang Paletta's brush engine.
Effortless Layers and Colors
・Clipping Masks: Edit without compromising your initial art.
・Layer Groups: Keep your work neat and tidy.
・Blending Modes: Nearly 20 blending modes to adjust your art as you desire.
Professional Finishing Touches
・Artistic Filters: Add captivating effects to give your work a professional look.
・Blur Tool: Achieve softness, movement, and depth.
・Easy Edits: Refine your work's proportions using the Transformation Tool.
Intuitive and Lightweight
・Artist-First Design: Enjoy an app designed with giving you the best artistic experience in mind.
・Simplicity is Key: Focus on your creativity with a simple, lightweight interface that transforms your screen into a studio.
・Efficient Storage: Save your work in MediBang Paletta export it to the Files app.
・No Lag: Bid farewell to brush lag and slow loading times forever.
Share Your Masterpieces
・Pro Export: Import or export your art in various formats, including Adobe® Photoshop® PSD files.
・Seamless Saving and Backups: Save your art locally in MediBang Paletta and find your files backed up to the app itself in the event of a crash.

・OS: iOS 18 or later
・Recommended Devices: iPhone13 or later / iPad 9th generation or later / iPad Air 5th generation or later / iPad mini 6th generation or later / iPad Pro 5th generation or later
*App performance may vary depending on the device condition

bluejetty:00091968:ios.name: Skiwise - For Nordic Skiers
bluejetty:00091968:ios.summary:
Skiwise allows Nordic Skiers to connect with a vast network of fellow skiers to share trail conditions, trail details and more. It's an essential tool for optimizing your workouts and connecting you with your local ski community.
We solve
bluejetty:00091968:ios.description:
Skiwise allows Nordic Skiers to connect with a vast network of fellow skiers to share trail conditions, trail details and more. It's an essential tool for optimizing your workouts and connecting you with your local ski community.
We solve the problem skiers face every winter where they get gear up to go skiing only to arrive at a trail system to find that it hasn't been groomed recently. We fix this problem by crowdsourcing trail reports directly from your mobile device.
Skiwise accomplishes this goal through it's 3 primary features:
Crowdsourced Trail Reports -
View, edit and create trail reports directly from your phone. We feature the ability to subscribe to trails you frequently ski at and be notified when new trail reports are submitted for that trail.
Optimized Trail System Discovery -
Discover trails based on location, rating, city and more! View past trail reports and details on the trail system including number of kilometers and ski pass information.
Nearby Trail Map -
Find out what trails are closest to you! Going to a new city for the weekend? Browse the local trail systems in that area as-well. There's no limit to the capabilities Skiwise offers.
Skiwise is dedicated to improving your skiing experience. And these features are just the tip of the iceberg! With future plans to incorporate race signups, race results, group communication and more, Skiwise is growing fast and has no plans of slowing down.

bluejetty:00068758:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a smart metal detector!
The Metal Detector Pro! app uses your device's built-in magnetic sensor to detect nearby metal objects and magnetic fields in real time.
Ideal for:
• Finding hidden metal objects.
• Detecting magnetic interference.
• DIY and engineering projects.
• Educational experiments.
• Fun exploration of your surroundings.
Features:
• Simple and modern interface.
• Real-time magnetic field detection.
• Smooth animated meter.
• Audio alerts with support for multiple sound options.
• Vibration alerts.
• Flashlight control for use in dark or low-light environments.
• Customizable reference settings to match your device.
• Support for your preferred UI language.
• Supports dark and light themes.
• Camera mode to record metal detection events for easy later review (still images and video).
• Graph monitoring mode showing minimum, average, and maximum values for easy later review.
• Compatible with iPhone and iPad.
Important:
This app requires a device with a built-in magnetometer sensor. Accuracy may vary depending on the device and surrounding environment.

bluejetty:00132563:ios.description:
Focus, Relax, Meditate and Sleep, with Music Made for Your Brain. 
Brain.fm is science-backed music that enhances focus, improves sleep, and more. We use sound to change your brainwave patterns, so you can drop into deep focus or fall asleep faster, every time. Now with ADHD mode! 
IMPROVE FOCUS, RELAX, MEDITATION, SLEEP
Do you struggle to focus at work or studying? Do you have trouble winding down or falling asleep at night? Brain.fm will help you:
• Focus faster and get into flow. 
• Beat procrastination.
• Stay in flow longer.
• Fall asleep and stay asleep.
• Meditate more effectively.
• Reduce stress and anxiety.
10X YOUR FOCUS
• Boost activity in brain regions controlling attention
• Increase focus by up to 10x
• Reduce tension/anxiety by 2x compared to other relaxing music.
• Improve brain signatures of deep sleep 
Funded by the National Science Foundation (USA)
Brain.fm affects your brain differently than any other music! Our patented tech works via brainwave entrainment, and has been tested extensively with funding from the US government. Our music process includes both humans and AI, for the best-sounding AI music around.
BRAIN.FM FEATURES
• Personalized music for your brain type.
• Tons of genres from LoFi beats to Classical. We even have Nature soundscapes!
• Stimulation level is adjustable, with a boost option for ADHD brains. 
• Download music for offline use / airplane mode.
• Pomodoro mode for productivity sprints.
IDEAL BACKGROUND MUSIC
• Focus modes optimized for deep work, learning, creativity, and more!
• Relax modes made to help you recharge during the day or unwind in the evening.
• Meditation modes including both guided and unguided meditations. 
• Sleep modes including guided sleep and energizing wakeup.
ADHD MODE FOR ADHD BRAINS
Some brains need extra stimulation to focus best. That’s why people with ADHD fidget when they’re trying to pay attention. Brain.fm provides this kind of stimulation through music. There’s even a boost option specifically for ADHD. Think of brain.fm as a fidget spinner for your brain!
BETTER THAN BINAURAL BEATS
Binaural beats and isochronic tones also use brainwave entrainment, but brain.fm does it better. We use patented A.I. on top of human-composed music to help you find your flow faster than binaural beats or other brainwave entrainment audio. 
REVIEWS
"It’s an instant ability to focus in a way I’ve never experienced before."
- Brit Morin, Founder of Brit + Co, featured on Entrepreneur
"I started using brain.fm while working and was shocked by how much it improved my focus"
- VICE
FREE TRIAL WITH FULL ACCESS for 14 days, followed by a subscription (see in-app purchases for pricing information). Prices listed are for U.S. customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Terms of use - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00174986:ios.description:
Welcome to NEW STATE MOBILE, the Battle Royale mobile game developed by KRAFTON.
Dive into expansive Battlegrounds, search for strategically placed weapons, vehicles, and consumables, and fight for survival in an ever-shrinking play area. 
Experience the action-packed thrills and gameplay as you fight to become the last one standing!
▣ Game Features ▣
▶ Ultra-realistic Graphics that Exceed the Limits of Mobile Gaming
- With the "global illumination" technology, NEW STATE MOBILE surpasses what was previously possible in mobile gaming graphics
- A massive, open-world battleground with a level of realism achievable only by KRAFTON
- NEW STATE MOBILE defines the next-generation mobile graphics
- The ultimate battle royale experience in the palm of your hands
- Metal(API) enables stable service with improved performance and optimization
▣ Subscribe ▣
1. Pricing and duration
You can subscribe to "VIP Membership" or "VIP Royale Membership" by going to LOBBY → PURCHASE → SUBSCRIBE.
Each option costs $3.99 and $13.99 a month respectively.
2. Subscription Item Info
Subscription types consist of "VIP Membership" and "VIP Royale Membership".
1) Membership types cannot be changed after purchase
2) After subscribing, the subscription automatically renews each month. 
However, if the subscription is canceled within the valid billing period, then monthly benefits and rewards will not extend past that period.
3) Login Date renewal time
 - Daily Reward: UTC 00:00
 - Weekly Reward: Every Monday at UTC 00:00
4) When subscribing to "VIP Royale Membership", you receive the following: Each Month 1 Premium Pass Plus Ticket, 2000 NC, 1 Preset (30 Days); Each Week 1000 BP, 1 Chicken Medal Random Box (M), 1 Troi 200% BP Card, 1 Erangel 200% BP Card, 1 Akinta 200% BP Card, 1 Lagna 200% BP Card; Each Day 1 Chicken Medal. In addition, you receive 2x rewards from Daily Roulette and appear with a VIP badge on friends' lists.
5) When subscribing to "VIP Membership", you receive the following: Each Month 1 Premium Pass Ticket; Each Week 500 BP, 1 Troi 150% BP Card,  1 Erangel 150% BP Card, 1 Akinta 150% BP Card, 1 Lagna 150% BP Card; Each Day 1 Chicken Medal.
6) Daily and weekly rewards cannot be obtained without logging in, and unobtained rewards are lost. 
If you have difficulty obtaining rewards after logging in, please contact customer support.
7) Instructions for canceling your subscription are in the Subscription Cancellation Guide on the official New State Mobile website.
3. Automatic subscription renewal
A subscription from Apple automatically renews, and the payment will be automatically charged to your iTunes account. 
To cancel your subscription, you can go to the iTunes/Apple Account Setting page on your mobile device and stop the auto renewal. 
A payment for the renewed subscription will be charged to your iTunes account within 24 hours after the prior subscription period ends.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
After the purchase is confirmed, the subscription price will be charged to your iTunes account.
You can check the feasibility and cost of renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.
4. Subscription Cancellation Guide
(On iOS devices) Open the Settings app → (On Mac or Windows PC) Open App Store or iTunes → Click your Apple account and/or click Account Settings, and go to Subscription(s) → Click Manage and cancel the subscription for New State Mobile

bluejetty:00165164:ios.description:
Transform your health and wellness routine with Heart Rate Monitor, your ultimate companion for understanding your body’s signals. Measure your heart rate accurately, log vital metrics, and gain actionable insights instantly from your iPhone or iPad. Designed with precision and simplicity in mind, Heart Rate Monitor empowers you to lead a healthier, more balanced, and fulfilling life.
KEY FEATURES
• Instantly measure your heart rate using your iPhone’s camera and flashlight.
• Log and monitor your blood pressure and oxygen saturation effortlessly.
• Receive personalized daily wellness assessments and actionable lifestyle recommendations.
• Manage stress and emotional well-being with mental health insights and tools.
• Build sustainable habits with our intuitive Habit Tracker.
• Enhance emotional balance through guided self-love and mindfulness programs.
• Visualize your progress with detailed charts, graphs, and comprehensive reports.
• Add custom tags and notes to your measurements for seamless organization.
• Sync effortlessly with Apple Health to unify all your health data in one place.
WHY CHOOSE HEART RATE MONITOR?
• Advanced algorithms ensure precise heart rate readings.
• A holistic approach to managing your physical, emotional, and mental health.
• User-friendly interface with light and dark mode options for your convenience.
• Privacy-focused design to safeguard your personal data.
HOW TO USE
• Place your fingertip gently on the camera and flashlight.
• Ensure your finger is warm and completely covers the lens.
• Stay calm, still, and silent during the measurement process for the best accuracy.
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PRICING
Get started with a 3-day free trial!
• Weekly plan: $5.99 per week
• Yearly plan: $39.99 per year
Unlock premium features, including advanced analytics, detailed reports, and personalized health insights. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions through your Apple ID settings.
DISCLAIMERS
Heart Rate Monitor is intended for informational and educational purposes only. It is not designed for medical use or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your doctor for any health concerns.
PRIVACY POLICY
Learn how we handle your data securely and responsibly:
https://heartratemonitorapp.com/privacy-policy
TERMS OF USE
Review the terms and conditions for using our app:
https://heartratemonitorapp.com/terms-of-use
SUPPORT
Need help or have questions? Contact us anytime:
https://heartratemonitorapp.com/contact-us
Start your journey to better health today with Heart Rate Monitor. Download now and take control of your well-being!

bluejetty:00035637:ios.description:
"FINAL FANTASY IV" has finally come to the Apple Arcade!
The title first debuted in 1991 as the fourth installment in the FINAL FANTASY series. Wildly popular thanks to its unique characters and dramatic storylines, it went on to be ported to many different platforms.
FINAL FANTASY IV was the first title to introduce the Active Time Battle (ATB) system, which has become synonymous with the series. It also saw the introduction of the Augment system, which enabled the transfer of abilities from other characters and gave players an edge in battles.
This iconic title is packed with other amazing features.
- Voice acting for event scenes
Key events unfold with spoken dialogue.
- Deeply emotional portrayals
Characters go through visibly apparent emotional changes.
- A brand new mapping feature
Players start with a completely blank dungeons map, adding an element of the unknown to the mix!
- Jukebox
Players can listen to the game's music anytime they want.
----------------------------------
iOS Version Features
- High resolution graphics and retouched cutscenes.
- Smooth, intuitive touch-panel controls specifically tailored to improve the gaming experience.
-Select difficulty from Normal to Hard to adjust the balance of the game.
- New save functions, including autosave, allow for players to quit the game at any time without fear of losing their progress.

Step into the MasterChef Kitchen! It’s time to match, blast, and rise to the top in the ultimate culinary puzzle challenge inspired by the world-famous TV show!
MasterChef: Cook & Match brings you thrilling match-3 gameplay with a flavorful twist. Pure puzzle action, exciting events, and a dash of MasterChef drama!
What’s on the menu?
• Match-3 Mayhem:
Tackle hundreds of dynamic match-3 levels packed with satisfying combos, tricky obstacles, and clever challenges.
• Strategic Power-Ups:

Compete in limited-time tournaments and leaderboards. Can you claim the title of MasterChef and outmatch your rivals?

Immerse yourself in a beautifully designed kitchen world full of rich visuals, elegant UI, and familiar MasterChef flair.

MasterChef: Cook & Match is free to play, with optional in-app purchases available.
Join the challenge today and prove you've got what it takes to be the best — without ever lighting a stove.
Learn more: https://www.qiiwi.com/masterchef/
Like us: https://www.facebook.com/masterchefcookandmatch

bluejetty:00014751:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00014751:ios.description:
Reads your email out loud, lets you reply and manage mail by voice commands.
Ideal for visually impaired users, driving, or anytime you'd like to check email hands free & eyes free. 
Premium Edition is free for 7 days. Then you are automatically switched to Basic Edition.
(Note for CarPlay users: see our other app 'Speaking Email CP')
— WHY DO I WANT IT? —
FOR DRIVERS
Get more time in your day when you check your email on the move.
Most people spend 1-2 hours in their inbox. With the help of Speaking Email during your daily drive to work, you can easily cut this time in half. Get more done, stay on top and keep a clean inbox.
Voice commands and simple gestures designed to be safe to use while driving give you the ability to archive, flag or even reply on the move.
(Note for CarPlay users: see also our other app "Speaking Email CP")
FOR ACCESSIBILITY
Makes email easy to use for those with visual impairment, blindness, dyslexia, stroke, motor dysfunction. Designed to be used without needing to see or touch the screen, Speaking Email works as a fully voice operated email app. 
Note: a sighted assistant or VoiceOver is required to sign into your email account and configure the many preferences to your liking. The rest is all voice controlled!
— HOW DOES IT WORK? —
Speaking Email reads your latest emails out loud from your inbox, one by one. Swipe left and right to play your inbox like a jukebox.
Whip through your inbox, clear clutter, flag important items and make inbox zero a reality - all while on the go. 
You can interact with your email using full screen taps, swipes and voice commands.
Voice recognition needs a trigger. You choose when to pause for a command - on full screen tap, every 30 seconds, at the start/end of emails.
— FEATURES —
- Smart content detection skips over disclaimers, reply headers, and email signatures to speak only the content without the clutter
- Multilingual mode automatically detects the email language and switches voices to match, using Apple text-to-speech voices
- Makes use of the latest Apple speech recognition technology lets you dictate your reply, which is read back to you before sending
- Our simple Ignore Sender command puts you in control, allowing you to avoid hearing emails from the sender in future
- Connects securely to all email servers, including Gmail (using Google Sign In), Microsoft 365 (aka Office 365 - using Microsoft Sign In supporting Intune, MFA and OAUTH), Exchange (via ActiveSync), IMAP, POP, iCloud (using app password), Outlook/Hotmail (using Microsoft Sign In), Yahoo (using Yahoo Sign In), AOL (using AOL Sign In) 
- Voice commands and buttons include:
Next 
Back 
Archive/Done 
Flag
Trash 
Reply
Forward
Ignore (thumbs down)
Important (thumbs up) 
Block Sender
Rewind 
Fast Forward
Compose
Search
Voice
Slower
Faster
People
When
- Many preferences to set up your experience how you like
— QUESTIONS —
Reach us at feedback@speaking.email
See our FAQ: http://www.speaking.email/faq
Feature tour: http://www.speaking.email
— RECOGNITION —
- Gizmodo
- "Highly Recommended" by Marc Saltzman in USA Today
- TV3 News (NZ), Sky News 
- The Australian, Herald Sun, Daily Telegraph
- NZ Herald, National Business Review
- Featured by Apple in Best New Apps
- Voted Most Fundable App by Context.IO
- Finalist in NZ Hi Tech Awards
— QUOTES —
“This is a nifty app, and one that will make driving a little safer for inbox addicts”—NBR
“My eyesight isn’t as it was years ago, and your Speaking Email makes it so much easier for me to keep in touch with folks” — Willis Hargrave 
“I absolutely love the app and being an outside sales rep in the car 4-6 hours a day find it incredibly helpful. It is literally freeing up and hour or 2 of time for me every day I am on the road by having a lot less time at the desk doing email. THANKS!!!” — Scott Middleton
https://speaking.email/page/privacy
https://speaking.email/page/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00081706:ios.description:
Looking for endless entertainment without needing an internet connection? No internet games offers a variety of offline games you can enjoy anytime, anywhere. Whether you're stacking blocks, merging numbers, or piloting a helicopter, these games provide endless fun.
Why Choose No internet games?
Play Without Internet: Enjoy all games offline, without needing Wi-Fi or data. Perfect for flights, travel, or areas with no service.
Play without distractions—online or offline.
Offline Split-Screen Multiplayer: Compete with friends in exciting 2-player split-screen games like Perfect Cut and Soccer Game, all on one device.
Free and Premium Games: Access three free games and explore additional premium titles for even more entertainment. Choose what you want to play without hidden costs.
Game Highlights
3D Woodoku: A relaxing puzzle game where you place blocks on the grid to clear rows and columns.
Free Flow: Connect matching dots without crossing lines in this fun and challenging puzzle game.
Helicopter Destroy: Take control of a helicopter and demolish buildings while trying to drop all the enemies—an action-packed new addition!
Sort Liquids: Pour and sort colorful liquids into matching containers in this satisfying puzzle game.
Stacks: Test your reflexes by stacking blocks as high as possible in this fast-paced arcade game.
Perfect Cut: Compete with a friend to cut objects as close to 50% as possible in this unique 2-player game.
Soccer Game: Enjoy disc-based soccer action in offline split-screen mode. Compete with friends to see who can score the most goals!
Collect Cubes: Use a shovel-like tool to gather cubes and reveal hidden pixel art masterpieces.
Word Guess: Challenge your vocabulary skills with this fun word game. Guess the word with as few tries as possible.
Snakes: A classic, competitive arcade game you can play anywhere.
Perfect for Every Situation
Whether you're at home, traveling, or in an area without service, No internet games is your ultimate offline entertainment app. Play without needing Wi-Fi or mobile data, making it perfect for airplane mode, no-service zones, or when you want to save on your data plan.
Games for Airplane Mode: Ideal for flights or situations where Wi-Fi isn’t available.
Games Without Wi-Fi: Enjoy anytime, anywhere, even in areas with no connection.
Why Download No internet games?

bluejetty:00188121:ios.name: Tutorials for iOS programming
bluejetty:00188121:ios.summary:
WHAT IS XCODE AND SWIFT TUTORIALS? 
WHAT IS XCODE AND SWIFT TUTORIALS brings you simple, funny, interactive learning app for Xcode and Swift. 
The app teaches you about each of the features of Xcode and show you how to use them in detail.
bluejetty:00188121:ios.description:
WHAT IS XCODE AND SWIFT TUTORIALS? 
WHAT IS XCODE AND SWIFT TUTORIALS brings you simple, funny, interactive learning app for Xcode and Swift. 
The app teaches you about each of the features of Xcode and show you how to use them in detail. With candid, jargon-free advice and step-by-step guidance, you’ll get everything from the core aspects of working to advanced techniques for refined workflows and professional results. It's like having your own personal tutor teaching you the newest version of Xcode. You'll learn how to express yourself and create great Apps quickly and directly! It’s the first and only app to bring the whole process together in such a clear, concise, and interactive way. 
There is no faster, more straight-to-the-point, or more fun way to learn Xcode than with this app. 
In addition to the Interactive-Mode, app supports the Inspector-Mode, it converts the app to be 20 hours video tutorials, a great added value! 
WHAT IS IN XCODE AND SWIFT TUTORIALS? 
XCODE AND SWIFT TUTORIALS includes 1146 self-paced lessons that allow you to progress at your own speed(tip:The first lesson teach you how to use the app): 
- Get familiar with the Xcode + Swift + Objective-C 
- Discover all the things you can do with the UIControls 
- Explore the use of UIView, UIViewController 
- Find out how to make a fantastic animation 
- Learn how to get the app version, device font list 
- Steps for creating POST/GET HTTP Request 
- Cool things to do with UITableViews 
- Details how to save your data in the device 
- Shortcuts, tricks, and tips that let you work smarter and faster 
- A whole chapter on how to work with music, movie, animation 
- UITapGestureRecognizer Single Tap, Double Tap, Long Press 
- Instructions for using simulator 
- Debugging your app 
- Details how to Work with SQLIte and NSKeyedArchiver 
- Explore the use of property list file 
- The newest and coolest features of Xcode
- Plus, there are so many other things throughout the app that you’ll be bursting with new ideas! Have fun discovering! 
WHO IS INTERACTIVE TUTORIALS FOR XCODE FOR? 
Ever wonder how that Great Apps was created, or how they created that cool mobile games? Or maybe you just want to know how to do some really awesome stuff in Xcode. Well, then, this app is for you! 
Whether you’re a programmer, designer, or even an artist, there’s something here for you.

Interactive Tutorials for Photoshop, Illustrator

Interactive Tutorials for Excel, Word and Powerpoint
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id1090726089

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id987231882

bluejetty:00026558:ios.description:
Fight for America is a tactical and strategic tower defense game where you must battle your way across the country in a quest for conquest, liberating state after state from its enemies and showing your patriotism at its fullest potential. 
With a focus on both tactical strategy and base defense, you must defend your own base while also attacking enemy bases in a race to conquer the city, conquer the tower and end this war. The game features a variety of different countryballs as enemies, each with its own unique strengths and weaknesses. 
You must use any kind of turret and other warfare tactics to defeat these enemies, protect the country and ultimately triumph in the fight for America's conquest. 
With challenging gameplay and a compelling patriotism storyline, Fight for America is a must-have for any fan of tower defense and strategy games that want to conquer the tower and the state. So, don't let them conquer the city, set up your base defense, tactical and strategy solutions, use the turret and many other warfare tactics, win this battle and end this war! 
Make America Free Again by re-conquering every state with your war tactics and battle strategy!
--------
Subscription terms – Fight For America
Here are the subscriptions available in our game:
- Weekly subscription for $4.99 after a 3-day free trial
- Monthly subscription for $14.99 
The offer unlocks the following features:
– Doubles the coins you receive 
– Drone to help you in combat
– no interstitial and banner ads
End of trial and subscription renewal: the payment is charged to your account after a confirmation of purchase. The subscription is renewed automatically unless you turn it off 24 hours before the end of the current period. The subscription automatically renews for the same duration as the original offer the users subscribed to (weekly or monthly). Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase. any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Canceling a trial or a subscription: if you want to cancel a subscription during its free trial, you have to cancel it through your account in the store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/ht207865
If you have any question, feel free to contact us at contact@homagames.com

Introduction: Welcome to AI COOL, your smart assistant and creative partner. This app integrates AI assistant, simultaneous interpretation, smart meeting record and other functions to help you improve work efficiency, break language barriers and stimulate creativity. AI COOL will explore the new world of intelligent future with you.
Feature highlights:
1. Smart Assistant:
AI smart assistant provides you with personalized support and suggestions at any time. Whether it is work arrangement, email processing, or creative inspiration, AI assistant will be your right-hand man.
2. Simultaneous interpretation:
Eliminate language barriers and promote cross-cultural communication. AI COOL's simultaneous interpretation function provides high-quality real-time translation, allowing you to easily communicate with people around the world and open up a new mode of cooperation and communication.
3. Smart meeting record:
Extract the essence from the noise of the meeting and easily obtain the key points and action items of the meeting. The smart meeting record function automatically generates clearly structured, concise and concise meeting minutes through voice recognition and natural language processing technology, helping your meetings to be more efficient and the results to be clearer.
Download AI COOL now to unleash your unlimited creativity and open a new chapter of intelligent life!
【Basic Service Automatic Subscription Instructions】
1. Service name: Basic Service Automatic Subscription
2. Subscription period: Continuous monthly automatic renewal (1 month), half-year automatic renewal (6 months), 1-year automatic renewal (12 months)
3. Subscription price: Continuous monthly automatic renewal 15 yuan/month, half-year automatic renewal 58 yuan/half year, 1-year automatic renewal 88 yuan/year
4. To cancel the subscription, please manually open iOS "Settings"-->Enter "iTunes Store and App Store"-->Click "Apple ID", select "View Apple ID", enter the "Account Settings" page, click "Subscription", select AI Cool Basic Service Member Unsubscription, and cancel the subscription. If the subscription is not closed at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period,
this subscription will be automatically renewed.

6. Privacy Agreement: https://www.xuanjiai.cn/app/privacy_en.html

4. bluejetty:00140687:ios.description:
Coin Identifier - Coin Finder can quickly and accurately identify coins from various countries, eras, and denominations, powered by AI Coin recognition technology.
Simply snap a photo of the coin, and our intelligent system will analyze its features, providing detailed information about its history, value, and significance. This intuitive process not only saves time but also enhances the joy of discovering the stories behind each coin.
Additionally, the Coin Identifier - Coin Finder app allows you to keep a record and store your collections directly within it, ensuring you always have an up-to-date account of your collectibles and their values. You can even organize your collections by coin series within the app.
KEY FEATURES:
●Identify Any Coins
Just snap your coin or select one from your photo library, and the Coin Identifier - Coin Finder will swiftly recognize your coin, whether it's a rare find, a foreign currency, or even an error coin.
●Detailed Coin Identify Results
Every identification offers a comprehensive look at the coin, detailing its name, origin country, issuance year, monetary value, metal makeup, and additional pertinent information.
●Accurate Coin Market Price
We use powerful AI computing models to collect market prices and provide you with the most accurate and precise market valuation.
●Record and store your collections
Maintain your coin collection by systematically adding newly identified pieces. Organize them into multiple collections as per your preference to keep everything neatly sorted and traceable at any time.
Coin Identifier - Coin Finder was created to help more people explore and learn about the coins around them.
Download the app today to enjoy a more pleasant coin journey and train yourself to be a coin expert!

bluejetty:00137505:ios.summary:
Solve the biggest mystery in the town of Riverstone surrounded by the Elmwood Forest. Find the missing girl and prove yourself to everyone.
It’s been 3 weeks since a young teen has gone missing and despite the town’s police's best efforts,
bluejetty:00137505:ios.description:
Solve the biggest mystery in the town of Riverstone surrounded by the Elmwood Forest. Find the missing girl and prove yourself to everyone.
It’s been 3 weeks since a young teen has gone missing and despite the town’s police's best efforts, they hit a dead end and declared the case of 18-year-old Zoey Leonard a runaway.
For all the interactive mystery game fanatics. Develop your own trail to unravel the secrets of the town of Riverstone! This is YOUR chance to help a detective regain his legacy, save the life of a missing girl, and uncover the orchestrator behind such a sick crime.
Investigate the case of the missing girl. Navigate through the story, interact with people, gather clues and hints, and make sense of the story. You get to decide what happens.
Can you bear the responsibility to bring Zoey home? Make tough decisions and choices that will lead you straight to her.
Access private information. Get access to all images, chats, albums, social media, voice mails, and calls.
Interrogate the suspects. Interact with the characters, make new friends, and find out the truth.
But the question is, can you trust them? Are these people really the ones who cared for Zoey or the ones behind her disappearance?
Everyone knows there is more to this story than what the news says. The fate of the missing girl lies in YOUR hands. It’s up to you now to find her because there is some truth to what the people around the town say about you. YOU are the best detective Riverstone has ever seen.
An unknown person has asked you to take up this case, and this is probably the only way to ignite your long-gone career.
FEATURES
Puzzle-cracking and code-breaking missions that will challenge your memory and problem-solving skills.
Experience the in-game realism through messenger, where you can send and receive messages to help you unfold the story events. Interrogate the ones you suspect and get an upper hand by revealing the hidden clues.
Unlock the missing girl’s diary notes to uncover her past.
Navigate through your phone and hers. Connect the dots on the suspect board for better visualization and deduction.
Stuck on a puzzle? Don’t worry, every objective is equipped with 3 useful hints that will ensure you keep moving even through the toughest tasks.
STORY
The town of Riverstone was built on the banks of a man-made harbor and is surrounded by the Elmwood Forest. This place is said to hold many mysteries but for the longest time, this town was silent until one day an 18-year-old girl went missing, without a trace, sending a wave of fear throughout. A case of disappearance that was marked a runaway in order to hide the agonizing truth, there is now only one person who can save this town and put it out of its misery, YOU.
Now, you must embark on this journey to find out what went wrong the night she went missing.
Where did Zoey go? What happened to her? Can you trust the people who claim to be the closest to her? Who can lead us to the final page of this mystery? The answer to these questions depends on your actions. You get to decide your next move.
Can you outplay the mastermind behind her disappearance? 
Download and play it right now! Take part in this thrilling criminal investigation and crack down on clues to reach the truth in this interactive mystery story game! An Elmwood Trail is and will forever remain free, so share it with your friends and join in on all the episodes together!

listings.name: An Elmwood Trail
listings.description:
Solve the biggest mystery in the town of Riverstone surrounded by the Elmwood Forest. Find the missing girl and prove yourself to everyone.

It’s been 3 weeks since a young teen has gone missing and despite the town’s police's best efforts, they hit a dead end and declared the case of 18-year-old Zoey Leonard a runaway.

For all the interactive mystery game fanatics. Develop your own trail to unravel the secrets of the town of Riverstone! This is YOUR chance to help a detective regain his legacy, save the life of a missing girl, and uncover the orchestrator behind such a sick crime.

Investigate the case of the missing girl. Navigate through the story, interact with people, gather clues and hints, and make sense of the story. You get to decide what happens.
Can you bear the responsibility to bring Zoey home? Make tough decisions and choices that will lead you straight to her.
Access private information. Get access to all images, chats, albums, social media, voice mails, and calls.
Interrogate the suspects. Interact with the characters, make new friends, and find out the truth.

But the question is, can you trust them? Are these people really the ones who cared for Zoey or the ones behind her disappearance?

Everyone knows there is more to this story than what the news says. The fate of the missing girl lies in YOUR hands. It’s up to you now to find her because there is some truth to what the people around the town say about you. YOU are the best detective Riverstone has ever seen.
An unknown person has asked you to take up this case, and this is probably the only way to ignite your long-gone career.

FEATURES

Puzzle-cracking and code-breaking missions that will challenge your memory and problem-solving skills.
Experience the in-game realism through messenger, where you can send and receive messages to help you unfold the story events. Interrogate the ones you suspect and get an upper hand by revealing the hidden clues.
Unlock the missing girl’s diary notes to uncover her past.
Navigate through your phone and hers. Connect the dots on the suspect board for better visualization and deduction.
Stuck on a puzzle? Don’t worry, every objective is equipped with 3 useful hints that will ensure you keep moving even through the toughest tasks.


STORY
The town of Riverstone was built on the banks of a man-made harbor and is surrounded by the Elmwood Forest. This place is said to hold many mysteries but for the longest time, this town was silent until one day an 18-year-old girl went missing, without a trace, sending a wave of fear throughout. A case of disappearance that was marked a runaway in order to hide the agonizing truth, there is now only one person who can save this town and put it out of its misery, YOU.

Now, you must embark on this journey to find out what went wrong the night she went missing.
Where did Zoey go? What happened to her? Can you trust the people who claim to be the closest to her? Who can lead us to the final page of this mystery? The answer to these questions depends on your actions. You get to decide your next move.
Can you outplay the mastermind behind her disappearance? 

Download and play it right now! Take part in this thrilling criminal investigation and crack down on clues to reach the truth in this interactive mystery story game! An Elmwood Trail is and will forever remain free, so share it with your friends and join in on all the episodes together!

bluejetty:00100560:ios.description:
Turn just 3 minutes into a healthier life.
MeeHealth creates a simple daily routine of three 45‑second actions—stretching, light exercise, and stress relief—guided by your own AI health companion. Build a healthy habit you can actually keep, even on the busiest days.
MeeHealth is a bite‑sized daily health and wellness app that helps you take care of your body and mind in only 3 minutes a day.
Your personal AI health twin learns about your lifestyle and designs a quick routine that fits your real life—not an impossible workout plan you’ll abandon after a week.
Why MeeHealth works
3‑minute routine, zero pressure
Start with three 45‑second actions that are easy to do anywhere: simple stretching, gentle exercise, breathing, posture resets, and small stress‑relief breaks. Tiny steps, big impact over time.
AI health companion that knows you
Your AI health twin acts like a friendly coach and companion, not a drill sergeant. It adapts your routine based on time of day, how you feel, and your health goals, helping you stay consistent without guilt.
Daily habit made simple
Build a realistic daily habit instead of chasing extreme workout challenges. MeeHealth focuses on consistent micro‑actions so you can slowly improve your health, energy, and mood in a sustainable way.
Streaks that motivate, not shame
Track your daily progress with gentle streaks that encourage you to come back, but never punish you for missing a day. When life gets busy, your AI companion simply adjusts your routine so you can restart with confidence.
Key features
- Personalized 3‑minute daily routine based on your lifestyle and goals
- Mix of stretching, light exercise, posture checks, and micro workout moves
- Short stress relief actions to calm your mind during a busy day
- AI health twin that acts as your friendly coach and companion
- Simple habit tracking with streaks you can actually maintain
- Smart suggestions that adapt to your time, energy, and location
- Gentle reminders that help you stay on track without pressure
- Clear progress overview so you can track your daily wins and feel proud
Who MeeHealth is for
MeeHealth is designed for people who:
- Feel too busy for long workouts but still want to stay healthy
- Sit for long hours and need quick stretching and movement breaks
- Want to reduce daily stress and tension in a simple, guided way
- Struggle to keep up with intense fitness apps or complex programs
- Prefer a warm, encouraging AI companion over a strict trainer
If you have ever thought, “I know I should move more, but I don’t know where to start,” MeeHealth gives you a gentle, guided starting point that fits into any day.
How your AI health companion helps
Your AI health twin learns from your check‑ins, preferences, and routine completion patterns. Over time, it becomes a smarter coach that can:
Suggest easier actions on stressful or low‑energy days
Offer slightly more challenging moves when you feel ready
Balance stretching, mobility, and light workout actions
Help you build a daily routine that supports both body and mind
This isn’t just another workout app. It is a small, supportive space where your AI companion helps you take one simple step at a time toward a healthier life.
Start your 3‑minute habit today
You don’t need an hour at the gym to improve your health.
You need a tiny decision you can repeat every day.
Open MeeHealth, follow your 3‑minute daily routine, and let your AI health companion coach you through stretching, light exercise, and stress relief.
Track your progress, build a realistic habit, and turn three minutes into the healthiest part of your day.

bluejetty:00017449:ios.name: Wolf Online 2
bluejetty:00017449:ios.summary:
Wolf Online 2, the best animal action mobile game full of realistic graphics and the excitement of animal hunting!
The sequel of “Wolf Online,” a popular animal mobile game that reached more than 10 million downloads, “Wolf Online 2” is a
bluejetty:00017449:ios.description:
Wolf Online 2, the best animal action mobile game full of realistic graphics and the excitement of animal hunting!
The sequel of “Wolf Online,” a popular animal mobile game that reached more than 10 million downloads, “Wolf Online 2” is a real-time online game.
 Players can become a wolf and hunt animals living in various regions such as deserts, jungles, grasslands, and glaciers, compete with other wolves, and survive from the fights with stronger predators in the wilderness ruled by the “Law of the Jungle.”
[Features of Game]
 1. Strategic Hunting and Battles
· Players can not only run, bite, and attack other animals but can also jump up to bite and hang on them along, make a surprise attack by hiding behind rocks or bushes, and run into preys to make them fall. They can also hunt animals using terrain features.
· Above all, players can summon their colleagues or locate them through "Summon" or "Find a Friend" function.Players can also find the type, location, and direction of preys by smelling them and approach them secretly by crawling.
·Depending on the nature and types of prey, you will need to change how you hunt as well as collaborate with other wolves. Know how to deal with various types of animals who run fast, can attack strongly, or move around in herds and packs.
2. Enhanced Graphics and Artificial Intelligence
· You can enjoy hunting in wilderness that has become more realistic with background effects and realistic 3D graphics that fit the characteristics of each region such as deserts, swamps, grasslands, forests, and icy areas.
· Animals respond intellectually according to various environmental conditions such as their strength, players’ behaviors, and the existence of herds and packs. 
3. Create Your Own Unique Character!
· You can choose not only the gender but also the characteristics of a wolf that meet your inclinations from 3 wolf species (Mountain, Snow, and Wild). 
· Customize face, body, legs, tail, and skin color to create your own, unique wolf character!
4. Realistic Animal Simulator
· You can play various daily life actions such as drinking water if you are thirsty, sit down and rest if you are stressed, dig the ground, and discharge waste if you are full. 
· Herbivores move around in herds and baby animals never leave their moms. Predators are fierce and ferocious when they are hungry, but usually are not even if you pass right next to them.
5. Guild/Ranking and Cloud Storage System
· Enjoy battles by creating and joining a guild that fits your goal. A guild can have its own guild mark. 
· You can also check your hunting skill by each wolf species or through the overall ranking and load your game information at any time through the cloud system.
[About Habitats] 
· Mountain Wolf: Living in rough and dangerous mountainous areas and forests, the Mountain Wolf has the most balanced abilities among the three species.
· Snow Wolf: Living in white areas covered in cold ice and snow, the Snow Wolf has the fastest speed and the best agility to hunt preys.
· Wild Wolf: Settled in a wild and barren land that still preserves the traces and souls of ancient beasts, the Wild Wolf is the most brutal and aggressive out of all three species.
· Entrance of Wolf Habitat: You must avoid the gatekeeper’s attacks and disruptions pass through the gate to invade into another wolf species’ habitat.
· Guardian Habitat: The most powerful, violent, and biggest dragons live in these areas which were created to guard three wild wolf species Mountain, Snow, and Wild. 
· Large-scale Movement of Animals: Animals that run around all the time such as water buffalos and zebras are running the wilderness in groups.
· Guild Hideout: A place to interact with other guild members to hunt preys together by summoning various animals
Jurassic Land(You can hunt dinosaurs.)
- Compsognathus Dinosaur
- Velociraptor Dinosaur
- Dimetrodon Dinosaur
- Parasaurolophus Dinosaur
- Triceratops Dinosaur

Have you tried using other free or paid booking systems and they didn’t meet your expectations? Try BedBooking now! We guarantee you that you won’t regret it!

• Access to the complete functionality of BedBooking

bluejetty:00024397:ios.summary: Reversi is a strategy board game for two players, played on an 8×8 uncheckered board. Players take turns placing disks on the board with their assigned color facing up. Any of the opponent's disks that are in a straight line and bounded by
bluejetty:00024397:ios.description:
Reversi is a strategy board game for two players, played on an 8×8 uncheckered board. Players take turns placing disks on the board with their assigned color facing up. Any of the opponent's disks that are in a straight line and bounded by the disk just placed and another disk of the current player's color are flipped to the current player's color. The object of the game is to have the majority of disks displaying your color when the last playable empty square is filled.
Perfect for enjoying with family and friends, you can also challenge yourself against AI with five levels of difficulty. Be warned, overcoming the highest difficulty AI is a true challenge!
This game is extremely well-known in Japan as "Othello." While players who enjoy Othello might appreciate the strategic challenges of our Reversi app, please note that our product is independently developed and has no official connection to the Othello trademark.
Features:
Undo function
Board editor
Custom board sets and piece sets
Supports standard 8x8 as well as 6x6 and 10x10 board sizes.
Save/load unfinished game
AIs with five levels of difficulty
Custom background themes, avatars, and sounds
Timer-based games
You'll also gain experience points by winning against the AI (+1 for Easy, +3 for Medium, +5 for Hard, and +7 for Expert).
Download Reversi now and immerse yourself in a world of strategic gameplay, captivating graphics, and tactical challenges!

bluejetty:00072778:ios.description:
Welcome to the Aquapark Idle game, the ultimate idle tycoon game where you can build and manage your own water park empire. Start small with just one employee by expanding your waterpark limits with thrilling water slides, wave pools, and more. As an idle tycoon game, you can passively earn income and even reinvest to further expand your empire.
Decorate your aquapark with eye-catching photo zones, lush landscaping, and stunning water glides to create a unique and inviting atmosphere of an idle aqua park. Take care of your guests’ needs by hiring new personnel who will keep an eye on their happiness and comfort. Challenge yourself trying to avoid long queues with angry people - it’s your chance to upgrade all your management skills. Make your aquapark business work the way you want it to! Dive into the game now and build, expand, and manage your own water park empire. Create unforgettable experiences for your guests and watch the entire business grow while you’re relaxing!
Join Aquapark Idle and become the most successful businessman in this exciting combination of the idle and strategy genres!

bluejetty:00170788:ios.summary:

Raise AI companions, share moments, and build routines for focus, self-care, and connection.
Friends turns everyday
bluejetty:00170788:ios.description:
Friends is a social AI companion app with cute virtual pets you grow over time – alone or together with real-life friends.
Raise AI companions, share moments, and build routines for focus, self-care, and connection.
Friends turns everyday life into something more personal, social, and fun. Your AI companions learn from you, adapt to your routine, and evolve based on your interactions over time.
Social AI Companions That Evolve With You
Friends is social by design. Raise companions on your own or together with someone you care about — share progress, moments, and playful interactions along the way.
Every action shapes their personality, unlocks new behaviors, and creates small surprises over time.
Choose Your AI Companion
Each companion supports a different part of your day:
Pengu – A Shared AI Companion for Two People
Pengu is a shared AI companion you raise together with a partner or close friend. Two people shape Pengu’s personality through conversations, choices, and shared interactions over time. Designed for couples, close friends, and siblings who want to build something together.
Mellow – AI Study Buddy & Focus Companion
Mellow is your calm AI study and focus companion.
Mellow helps you stay on track with studying, homework, and daily tasks – adding gentle structure, reminders, and encouragement without pressure.
Bao – AI Self-Care & Habit Companion
Bao is your self-care AI companion for healthy habits and well-being.
The more consistent you are, the more Bao develops – designed to make self-care feel motivating, rewarding, and easier to stick with.
Raise Companions Together
Raise companions with friends, send reactions and gifts, celebrate milestones, and enjoy a shared digital space that grows with your relationships.
Often compared to a new generation of Tamagotchi-style experiences, Friends goes further by combining AI characters, real utility, and shared experiences with people you care about.
Customize and Create
- Personalize your companions and their world:
- Outfits and accessories
- Wallpapers and themed rooms
- Visual upgrades that reflect personality and progress
Friends Widgets
Stay connected from your home screen.
Check in on Pengu, Bao, or Mellow, interact with them, and see what they are up to with a quick glance.
Built on AI That Learns Over Time
Friends is powered by AI designed to make companions feel more personal the longer you use them.
Your companions learn from how you interact, adapt to your habits, and respond differently over time — remembering past moments and reacting to progress.
Your AI Friends, Your Way
Download Friends and see how Pengu, Mellow, and Bao grow with you over time.
Social AI companions designed to support you, connect you, and make everyday life more fun.
Subscription Information
- Friends is free to download and use, and that will never change for our main features. If you want more from the experience, you can subscribe to our optional product Friends Plus.
- We currently offer Pengu Pass. Prices may vary by country and are subject to change without notice. Prices are clearly displayed in the app.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings in the App Store.
- If offered, and you choose a free trial, any unused portion of the trial will be forfeited upon subscription.
- If you choose not to subscribe, you can continue using Friends for free.
Privacy & Terms
Your personal data is securely stored on Friends. Please review our policies:
Privacy Policy: https://web.penguapp.co/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://web.penguapp.co/terms

bluejetty:00160595:ios.name: Wood Nuts: Nuts & Bolts
bluejetty:00160595:ios.summary: Welcome to Wood Nuts: Nuts & Bolts, where your problem-solving abilities will be challenged through engaging and intriguing wooden puzzles. Join the journey to discover the art of turning screws to place each nail and colorful wooden plank
bluejetty:00160595:ios.description:
Welcome to Wood Nuts: Nuts & Bolts, where your problem-solving abilities will be challenged through engaging and intriguing wooden puzzles. Join the journey to discover the art of turning screws to place each nail and colorful wooden plank in its rightful position.
Immerse yourself in the captivating gameplay of hundreds of wood nuts levels, from basic wood challenges to advanced puzzles. Each level brings new challenges and unique puzzles based on wood materials, while also keeping your brain trained and sharp.
Features of Wood Nuts: Nuts & Bolts:
- Enjoy the music and ASMR sound effects of wood and screws
- Hundreds of nuts and bolts puzzles updated weekly
- Many unique images are integrated into the screw pin puzzle game
- Simple yet addictive gameplay of unscrewing
Wood Nuts features strategic logic-based nuts levels. In these, time and tactics play a very important role.
How to play the Nuts & Bolts game:
- Tap to unlock different nuts and bolts
- Move the nuts & bolts to the correct positions in the empty holes to unscrew all the wooden bars
Understanding the order of movement and the falling ability of your wooden bars and screws is the key to making wise and effective decisions in this screw pin puzzle game. Over time, you will enhance your sensitivity to the timing of unscrewing, which could be the way to achieve a very quick victory in Wood Nuts: Nuts & Bolts.

iWatch PDF — PDF Viewer for Apple Watch
Your PDFs, everywhere. On iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
Create & Import PDFs
Use the built-in scanner to create PDFs from photos and camera scans. Import existing PDFs from your Files app. Simple and quick.
Cloud Sync — No Cables, No Hassle
Sign in with Apple or Google and your PDFs sync across all your devices automatically. Everything is stored securely in the cloud.
Apple Watch — Read PDFs on Your Wrist
Browse your full library right on Apple Watch. View multi-page PDFs offline, zoom in with the Digital Crown, and search for text — all without your iPhone nearby.
Organize Your Way
Create folders to keep things tidy. Add tags to group related PDFs. Star your favorites for quick access.
Follow-up Reminders
Schedule a review date for any PDF — tomorrow, next week, or pick a custom date. Get notified when it's time to revisit.

bluejetty:00180430:ios.name: beorg: To-Do List & Agenda
bluejetty:00180430:ios.summary: beorg is a to-do list, outliner and task manager that puts you in control. You can see what needs to be done on a weekly agenda from the moment you open the app. Create tasks and notes using the outliner, organize your files and manage anyt
bluejetty:00180430:ios.description:
beorg is a to-do list, outliner and task manager that puts you in control. You can see what needs to be done on a weekly agenda from the moment you open the app. Create tasks and notes using the outliner, organize your files and manage anything from simple lists to complex projects.
Your data is stored in plain text Org mode files which can be synced using iCloud, Dropbox, WebDAV or any compatible app that supports folders. Organize your files into folders, and use beorg alongside other Org mode/plain-text apps and tools.
beorg is free to use with optional extensions available as individual in-app purchases – or become a beorg Premium subscriber to unlock everything.
Use beorg to:
* Create tasks, notes and structured outlines
* See a weekly agenda of everything going on
* Organize tasks and notes across files and folders
* Be notified when you need to get something done
* Quickly capture new ideas and things to do
* Check your agenda from your Apple Watch
* Export outlines of PDF
* Sync your plain text Org mode files using iCloud, Dropbox, WebDAV, a folder in another app or Box*
Key Features:
* OUTLINER: Create and edit tasks, notes and structured documents using beorg's outliner. Quickly change dates, status, priorities and tags, rearrange items, expand and collapse sections, and focus on the part of an outline you're working on.
* AGENDA: See what's coming up with a weekly agenda on your iPhone and iPad. Events from your Org files are shown alongside those from your calendar.
* CREATE TASKS: Create tasks from throughout beorg. Assign dates, status, priorities and notes, add tasks to your inbox or choose a file, and set them to repeat on daily, weekly, monthly or yearly intervals.
* FOLDERS: Keep your Org files organized into folders. Move files between folders directly from the Files tab.
* REFILE: Move headlines to a specific place in another file. Refile individually, or select multiple headlines from the Agenda or Tasks tab and move them together. Available as an individual extension or with beorg Premium.
* SEARCH: Search all of your tasks and use a simple query syntax to get exactly what you want. An in-app purchase allows you to save searches for quick access.
* TEMPLATES: Define templates for common types of items you create.
* NOTIFICATIONS: Have your iPhone or iPad notify you of upcoming scheduled items and deadlines. Tap a notification to go straight to the task.
* APPLE WATCH: View your agenda on your wrist with the Apple Watch app and complications.
* QUICK CAPTURE: Quickly add tasks and notes without interrupting what you're doing. The beorg share extension can also add text and links from other apps.
* EXPORT PDF: Generate PDFs of your files to save, share or print.
* SCRIPTABLE: For advanced users, use the built-in Scheme scripting language to customise beorg.
To find out more, view the Users' Guide at https://beorgapp.com/manual
Some comments from users of beorg:
"I love this app and am grateful it exists!"
"Thank you for a great piece of software and for seeing all the little things I want to do before I know it myself."
"I have never used such customizable and closely resembling my workflow piece of software."
"Thank you for your exceptional work, and I look forward to seeing beorg continue to evolve and improve."
beorg Premium:
* Monthly and annual subscriptions – save money by taking out an annual subscription.
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
* Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
* Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
* You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms: https://beorg.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://beorg.app/privacy/
* Available as an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00187332:ios.summary:
India’s #1 app for doctors

Practo Pro is the new dawn in healthcare - an extremely powerful app for doctors that uses the convenience of technology (practice management software and more) to make healthcare
bluejetty:00187332:ios.description:
India’s #1 app for doctors
Modern. Professional. Powerful.
Practo Pro is the new dawn in healthcare - an extremely powerful app for doctors that uses the convenience of technology (practice management software and more) to make healthcare simpler for doctors and patients alike. Every task that was once manual and repetitive gets automated to help the doctors and healthcare professionals focus better on their patients.
This version of Practo Pro gives you access to all of our cutting-edge products.
Practo Ray: A powerful and easy-to-use Practice Management Software to simplify your practice
Practo Ray is a comprehensive practice management software, which helps doctors in automating patients appointments, creation and sharing of electronic medical records (EMR), instant billing and much more. 
Here is how you can use Ray in your everyday practice:
- View and manage your patient appointment schedule.
- Book new patient appointments or reschedule existing ones.
- Send appointment confirmation and reminders to patients through SMS and Email.
- View and manage patient health information.
- Add new patients or update existing profiles.
- Add files to existing patient records (EMR - Electronic Medical Record) using your phone’s camera - digitise patient health records and diagnostic reports. 
- Access your practice offline when phone is not connected to the Internet.
- Easily synchronize practice data between cloud storage and your mobile.
- Manage multiple practices on-the-go.
Practo Profile: One profile that controls everything
This is the online identity for you and your practice. A place to keep your practice information up-to-date and be discovered by patients looking for practitioners like you.
With the Profile you can:
- Edit and control all information related to your practice and connect with the patients you can treat, with the help of an in-built editor - update your working hours, fees, treatments offered etc. on-the-go.
- Build your credibility online through patient feedback - keep track of what your patients are saying about you and engage in a conversation with them.
Practo Reach: A reliable option to increase your online visibility through relevance
Practo Reach helps you:
- Increase your visibility by making your profile listing visible to relevant patients through online cards.
- Track the performance of your Reach card with the help of an easy-to-use dashboard.
- Connect with the patients based on the right speciality and location.
- Get guaranteed views for your Reach card.
Practo Consult: Consult online and grow your practice (only in India)
Join the digital healthcare revolution. Consult online with millions of patients and grow your practice.
- Answer queries by people seeking an expert medical opinion, showcase your expertise and reach out to new patients online.
- You can also track views, feedback and user ratings on your answers.
Practo Health Feed: Publish health articles and stay connected with your patients outside the clinic (only in India).
Write articles about topics related to your area of expertise, and get noticed by millions of health and fitness enthusiasts around the world.
What you can do:
- As an expert you can share your knowledge with millions of health & fitness enthusiasts. 
- Everything that you publish on Health Feed will inspire someone to live healthier and longer.
- It’s a unique opportunity to educate your own patients and engage with a wider audience.
- View important statistics related to your articles (number of likes, views and shares etc.)
- Read articles from other doctors to get an idea of the trending topics.
Practo Support
Get support for all Practo services from one place. You will be able to raise queries for all Practo Services - Profile, Ray, Consult, Reach and Health Feed.
----------------------------------------------
Follow Practo on Twitter: twitter.com/practo
Join Practo on Facebook: facebook.com/practo

bluejetty:00200012:ios.description:
Discover BlinkDrama – Your Vertical Drama Haven for Snap-Worthy Stories in Seconds 
BlinkDrama is the next-gen vertical streaming platform designed to turn every idle moment into a drama escape. With crisp HD quality, exclusive short-form content, and a library that fits your scroll, we deliver the fun and fulfillment you crave—one snap-worthy story at a time. 
A Mosaic of Genres, A World of Escapes 
BlinkDrama redefines variety with a genre mosaic that blends the familiar and the unexpected. Dive into modern romances that sparkle with witty banter, slice-of-life tales that feel like stolen glances into others’ hearts, and suspense thrillers that keep you guessing until the final second. Travel through time-bending adventures, cyberpunk rom-coms, cozy mysteries, and even warrior legends with a twist.
Snap-Worthy Originals, Glocal Gems 
What makes BlinkDrama unique? These aren’t just clips; they’re mini epics, crafted with tight scripts, vivid characters, and vertical-first cinematography that makes every frame pop. 
Daily Dose of Fresh, Always in Reach 
BlinkDrama’s library is a living storybook: new episodes drop daily, so there’s always a fresh tale to discover. Open the app, and you’ll find reels that surprise, dramas that resonate, and movies that transport—all in 1–10 minute bursts. Commuting? Waiting in line? Stealing a “me-time” moment?

bluejetty:00129636:ios.description:

Whether you want to smooth out your skin, remove blemishes, or slim down your waistline, Retouch has you covered. The app's advanced AI algorithms can accurately detect facial features and body contours, allowing you to make precise edits without affecting the rest of the photo.
What makes Retouch special is its simplicity. Reshaping your face and body in the pictures takes just seconds.
Impressions
- Retouch your photos using impression filters
- Select among preset unique filters
- A wide variety of choices specially created for you using AI
- Create a seamless and photorealistic edit in ONE TAP
Face Reshape
- Enlarge and brighten your eyes
- Whiten your teeth effortlessly
- Reshape your lips or nose
- Enhance your selfie to look like a world-class model on your social media
- Fix facial distortion with one tap
Skin Smoother
- Smoothen your skin
- Cure your pores
- Tan your skin
- Remove acne and blemish from your selfies
- Renew your skin removing wrinkles
Makeup
- It is so easy to find a lovely makeup filter to your taste with a few swipes
- Highlight your beauty with makeup tools
- Improved AI features let you do natural and stylish makeup
- Wide range of makeup tools including lipstick, blush, eyebrow and more
Body Edit
- Reshape your body as you imagine yourself
- Change the size of your breast
- Slim your arms and thin your belly
- Resize your leg height and thickness with just a touch
- Change your weight
- Edit the appearance of any part of your body
Wide Range of Filter Options
- Try beauty filters among 150+ choices
- Use photo filters to make perfect selfies for your appearance
- AI-supported color filters help you create your own unique beauty
Download the app today and start reshaping your photos like a pro!
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION

- If eligible for free trial and you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed. Subscriptions will start immediately after free trial ends unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the trial period.

- Privacy Policy: https://re-touch.app/privacy
