bluejetty:00162744:ios.description:
Sticky Notes is a notepad app you can use just like sticky notes.
Pin your memos to the Home Screen so you can see them anytime and edit with a single tap.
Now with checklists, bullet lists, numbered lists, and headings — organize shopping lists, to-do lists, tasks, and schedules all in one app.
We hope you'll give it a try.
■ App highlights
 - Pin memos to your Home Screen or Lock Screen for instant access anytime
 - Show a note on the Lock Screen without placing a widget
 - Manage shopping and packing lists with checklists — tick items right from the widget
 - Sort memos by purpose to manage to-dos for work or school
 - Customize the background with colors or photos to make a notepad that's truly yours
 - Choose cute fonts and freely adjust the text size
■ Organize with lists and headings
Keep shopping lists, to-do lists, and packing lists as checklists.
Checked items get a strikethrough, so you can see what's left at a glance.
 - Checklists — tap to tick off, right from your Home Screen widget
 - Bullet and dash lists — line up tasks and things to buy
 - Numbered lists — for steps, recipes, anything where order matters
 - Headings — use Title, Heading, and Subheading to break up longer notes
 - Everything looks the same on iPhone, iPad, widgets, and Apple Watch
■ Powerful customization
 - Background of your choice (color, notebook (grid, lined), photo, or pattern)
 - Switch fonts (handwriting-style and cute fonts available)
 - Adjust text size, line height, and letter spacing
 - Change text color
 - Set your own photo as the background
■ Suggested uses
 - Keep your schedule, to-dos, and tasks in plain sight on the Home Screen
 - Build a shopping list as a checklist and tick items off at the store
 - Pack for a trip with a checklist you tick as you go
 - Lay out steps or recipes as a numbered list
 - Break long notes into sections with headings
■ Handy memo features
 - Character count helps you gauge length for social posts or assists with writing
 - Undo or redo your latest input with a single tap
 - Copy the memo's contents with one tap
 - Share memos to other apps or run various actions from the share sheet
■ Show a Note Large on Your Lock Screen
Notes you only need to check for a while — like a shopping list or a packing list — are handy to show on the Lock Screen. Just glance at the screen; there’s no need to unlock.
Unlike a widget, you don’t have to set aside space in advance. Show the note from the menu when you need it, and end it once you’re done.
 - Switch by situation: a shopping list while you shop, a packing list while you travel
 - You can show several notes at the same time
 - When you edit the note, the Lock Screen updates too
 - For notes you want to keep visible all the time, a Lock Screen widget is a better fit
■ Fully optimized for iPad
 - The note screen is optimized for the iPad's larger display
 - Full support for window resizing. Side by side with another app or scaled down, the layout adapts to the width automatically
 - Works with Split View, Slide Over, Stage Manager, and windowed apps
 - Use the whole screen in portrait or landscape
 - Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets work on iPad too
 - Keep a note open next to whatever you're reading or looking up
■ Widget types
 - Memo widget
 - Memo list widget
 - Lock Screen-only widget
 - Apple Watch widget
■ Get more with Premium
Upgrade to Premium to keep the simple feel and unlock even handier extras.
Benefit 1. All ads removed
Benefit 2. Set your own photos as memo backgrounds (use wallpapers from your favorite anime or manga, family photos, anything you love)
Benefit 3. The memo list widget becomes available
*The one-time Pro plan supports Family Sharing, so when one family member buys it, everyone in the family can use Premium features.
■ Subscription
Please review the following for subscription terms:
 - Privacy Policy: https://rands-app.com/privacy-policy-en/
 - Terms of Use: https://rands-app.com/terms-en/

bluejetty:00076102:ios.description:
Street Masters is the digital implementation of the board game, intended to be played solo or pass-and-play with 1-4 fighters. 
This app includes the following features:
1. Tutorial: learn how to play the game
2. Story Mode: play through each fighter's Hero Story, customizing their decks, and then combine 1-4 of those heroes to take on Team Stories
3. Arcade Mode: choose your fighters, allies, rivals, enemy and stage to play
4. Quick Start: play a random match-up that will always choose a new combination of decks to keep the challenge fresh
THE BOARD GAME
Street Masters is a 1-4 player cooperative miniatures board game inspired by classic fighting video games. Featuring over 65 highly detailed miniatures, unique decks for fighters & enemies, custom dice, and lightning-fast gameplay, Street Masters lets players match up powerful fighters against villainous organizations in a wide array of exciting scenarios. Designed by Adam Sadler and Brady Sadler, the game offers modular and elegant gameplay set in a unique and exciting world of brutal combat.
THE STORY
Warriors from around the world, known for their legendary fighting abilities and skills, receive mysterious invitations to participate in a martial arts tournament. During the tournament, the organization surrounding it reveals their true identity — The Kingdom — and their purpose to recruit fighters to join their militia or enslave those against them. While several of these warriors made it out in time, many were never heard from again.
Five years later, a government project called "Street Masters" initiates in order to counter-act the war against The Kingdom, now having divided and seized control over the world by several of its factions. Those who join the Street Masters project must work together to take down each faction, crippling parts of The Kingdom before they're able to launch their end game.

bluejetty:00184581:ios.description:
Battle alongside friends and unleash over-the-top special attacks! A new style of real-time RPG!
Awesome real-time play that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
Team up with other players to unleash "Unison Attacks" that can call forth massive creatures to pulverize foes!
Join our community!
https://forum.a-tm.co.jp/forum/unison-league
[GAME FEATURES]
▼Intense Guild Battles!
Epic guild battles that allow for two teams of up to 10 players each to duke it out in real time!
Work together and form the strongest tactics to destroy your enemies' Crystal and reign victorious!
▼Decisive Unison Attacks!
Fuse Unison Summons with your guildies to unleash Unison Attacks that can call forth powerful entities to eliminate enemies!
Mesmerizing attack scenes that will take your breath away!
▼Quest with Friends in Real Time!
Brave the various terrains of Granvia with up to 5 friends at a time!
Collaborate tactically or opt for all-out brute force to take down the monsters you encounter along the way!
▼Communication with Others Is a Snap! Chill out in the Lobby!
Easy-to-use mid-battle chat for timely commands and adorable character animations for comical in-game lobby conversations!
▼Multitude of Features!
Battle or "Spawn" for weapons, armor and monsters!
Carefully select Gear with the best affinity to your Class to yield the greatest results!
Obtain special materials to evolve your Gear so that they realize their true potential!
Earn "Proficiency" to learn new Abilities and harness even greater might!
[Price]
Free to play (in-app purchases available)
[Supported Devices]
iPhone 5 or later, iPod Touch (5th generation or later)

*Before playing Unison League please read the End User License Agreement, which can be accessed from the in-game menu.

***WHY WAIT? START MERGING NOW!*** 
Download Fun 7 Dice today and dive into the ultimate dice-matching adventure. 
Are you ready to roll and merge your way to victory?

bluejetty:00034855:ios.name: Unscrew Puzzle: Pin Jam
bluejetty:00034855:ios.summary: Welcome to the mesmerizing challenge of Screw Puzzle: Pin Jam, a puzzle game where precision meets strategy in a world of shining colors and mechanical puzzles. Your task is to unscrew colorful bolts from stacked vibrantly hued glass pieces
bluejetty:00034855:ios.description:
Welcome to the mesmerizing challenge of Screw Puzzle: Pin Jam, a puzzle game where precision meets strategy in a world of shining colors and mechanical puzzles. Your task is to unscrew colorful bolts from stacked vibrantly hued glass pieces, sorting them into matching colored toolboxes.
Each toolbox awaits a specific color, ready to house the corresponding screws. Any mismatched screw is temporarily pinned to waiting holes, but be warned: space is limited. This calls upon your strategic foresight to plan the unscrewing sequence, ensuring all screws are removed and carefully placed into their rightful toolboxes, ultimately untangled glass pieces.
There are no time limits in Screw Puzzle: Pin Jam. Plan your moves without the rush, allowing for a fully engaging and thoughtful experience. Remember to harness the power of boosters to continue your winning streak. These boosters are easily accumulated by overcoming levels and can significantly assist in your puzzle-solving escapades.
The difficulty ramps up as you delve deeper into the game, challenging your intellect and problem-solving skills. But don't worry - the rewards are always proportionate to the cleverness of your tactics. The toolboxes you gather will aid you in your cerebral conquests and serve as building blocks for your city.
Dive into Screw Puzzle: Pin Jam, where the satisfaction of a puzzle well-solved is only the beginning. Collect toolboxes, build your metropolis, and become the ultimate unscrewing champion in this colorful, strategic odyssey.

bluejetty:00018843:ios.description:
World of Mouth connects you with the world’s best restaurants, recommended by top chefs, food writers, and sommeliers. Whether you’re traveling to a new city or exploring your hometown, discover trusted, insider picks for every meal.
LET TOP CHEFS AND FOOD WRITERS GUIDE YOU
Over 800 carefully selected food experts, including names like Ana Roš, Massimo Bottura, Pia León, Will Guidara, and Gaggan Anand, share their favorite dining spots for you to discover. Find where they eat and eat like local.
DISCOVER CULINARY HOTSPOTS AROUND THE GLOBE
World of Mouth offers restaurant recommendations in over 3,000 destinations worldwide, featuring 20,000 expert and member-written food reviews. Whether you're in New York, Tokyo, or your own neighborhood, you'll discover hidden gems and must-visit spots.
KEEP TRACK OF ALL YOUR FAVORITE RESTAURANTS
• Save restaurants to your wishlist.
• Write recommendations for your favorite spots.
• Create and share curated collections.
• Log your dining experiences with restaurant check-ins.
ALL THE RESTAURANT DETAILS YOU NEED, RIGHT AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Plan your next dining experience effortlessly: reserve tables, check opening hours, find addresses, and get directions with ease.
FIND EXACTLY WHAT YOU’RE LOOKING FOR
Discover restaurants that match your preferences, near you or around the world, from Michelin-starred spots to street food. World of Mouth helps you find places that suit your tastes, budget, and mood.
ABOUT WORLD OF MOUTH
World of Mouth was born out of a passion for connecting people with great dining experiences worldwide and at any price point. With a community of trusted experts, our guide focuses on positive recommendations – no ads, no ratings, just the places you’d recommend to a friend. World of Mouth is an independent restaurant guide, born in Helsinki and crafted by passionate food lovers, with a global network of top industry experts contributing to its reliable and authentic recommendations.

bluejetty:00070756:ios.description:
Labo Tank is a remarkable game that offers children the chance to explore creativity and stimulate their imagination. With a unique combination of tank building, driving, and racing, this app provides an exciting virtual sandbox where children can freely build and play with brick tanks.
In Labo Tank, kids can build an endless variety of pocket tanks, military vehicles, cars, and trucks by assembling colorful brick pieces like a puzzle. They can choose from classical templates or design entirely new creations using a variety of brick styles and tank parts, fostering innovation and problem-solving skills. Moreover, they can take their tank creations into levels of play, engaging in tank games, and defending their town against monsters.
Labo Tank is a fun-filled game that fosters creativity, innovation, and strategic thinking, making it an ultimate gaming experience for kids.
- Features
1. Labo Tank offers two design modes: template mode and free mode, giving children the freedom to design and create their own tanks.
2. It includes more than 50 classical tank star templates in template mode, such as King Tiger Tank, T-34 Tank, KV2 Tank, Sherman Tank, Panther Tank, Mouse Tank, Cromwell Tank, No. 4 Tank, Pershing Tank.
3. It offers various brick styles, tank parts with 10 colors, and classical tank wheels, gun barrel, and a large number of stickers.
4. It has amazing levels that are built-in with a variety of mini-games.
5. Children can share their tanks with other players and browse or download tanks created by others online.
- About Labo Lado
Labo Lado is dedicated to developing apps for kids that inspire creativity and pique curiosity. It doesn't collect any personal information or include any third-party advertising. - Need Help

bluejetty:00096949:android.summary: Block Match is a competitive block puzzle game where you build lines and squares with color blocks on a sudoku-style grid. Each match is a short race: clear blocks, earn points, and reach the target score before your rival does. The familia
bluejetty:00096949:android.description:
Block Match is a competitive block puzzle game where you build lines and squares with color blocks on a sudoku-style grid. Each match is a short race: clear blocks, earn points, and reach the target score before your rival does. The familiar logic of classic block puzzle games becomes sharper when every placement pushes your progress forward, keeping your mind engaged while giving you a quiet way to unwind.
In this block puzzle, both players score independently. You place shapes, form lines and squares, blast blocks away, and see your points rise while the opponent does the same on their side. The tension comes from keeping your board clean, choosing the right color block, and reacting before your rival gets ahead. The competition stays turn-based and structured, making each match easy to follow.
How to play:
• Drag and place color blocks onto the grid.
• Form rows, columns, or squares to clear blocks.
• Earn points with every block.
• Outsmart your rival and reach the target score first.
• Replay matches to refine your strategy.
If you enjoy free block puzzle games and logic challenges, Block Match provides steady gameplay with a clear goal every round. Matches are quick, the controls are simple, and each decision can help blast blocks and swing the score. Fans of traditional block games and thoughtful strategy will appreciate the predictable flow.
This loop preserves the clarity of familiar block puzzle games, while the head-to-head format adds a light competitive rhythm. Whether you prefer calm logic or a structured challenge, this block game offers a routine that feels balanced and consistent.
Why play Block Match:
• Clean and rewarding block puzzle mechanics.
• Short competitive rounds with clear goals.
• Smooth design and intuitive controls.
• Great for fans of free block puzzle games.
• Gentle tension inspired by block puzzle-style scoring.
• A comfortable pace for daily play.
Players familiar with classic block puzzles, planning or pattern spotting will find a steady rhythm. Each color block you place opens new options and helps you stay ahead. The game suits both casual players and dedicated solvers who like improving through repetition, supporting mental sharpness and a sense of relaxation. Every round lets you react, build momentum, and maintain control of your grid. Over time, you may feel closer to becoming a true block master.
Block Match is suitable for a relaxed break or a focused puzzle session, fitting naturally among block puzzle games made for simple, structured play. Place color blocks, plan ahead, and enjoy one of the most comfortable free block games built for regular logic exercise.

bluejetty:00079956:ios.description:
Organize & Clean Up Your Photos with Slidebox – The Ultimate Photo Cleaner & Album Organizer!
Slidebox makes managing your photos quick, easy, and satisfying. Say goodbye to clutter and hello to a neatly organized library with just a swipe! Whether you're looking to delete photos, organize albums, or compare duplicate photos, Slidebox is your go-to photo guru for fast and effortless photo cleanup.
Key Features to Declutter and Organize Your Photos:
- Delete Photos: Easily remove unwanted pics with a simple swipe, freeing up storage instantly.
- Album Organizer: Sort photos into albums with a single tap to keep your memories organized.
- Compare Similar Photos: Swipe between duplicate photos to decide which ones to keep.
- Favorite Moments: Mark your best photos as favorites for quick access.
- Undo Actions: Quickly reverse any action, so organizing your photos is stress-free.
Slidebox works directly with your Photos App, so any changes you make will sync seamlessly across your iPhone and iCloud. No hassle, no confusion – just a smooth, organized photo library.
If your camera roll needs a cleanup, Slidebox is the photo cleaner and album organizer you've been waiting for! With simple swipes and quick gestures, you can take control of your photo storage, remove duplicates, and finally enjoy an organized gallery. Download Slidebox now and experience how easy deleting, sorting, and storing photos can be.
In-App Purchases
Slidebox offers in-app purchases for users needing additional storage and features, including 10,000+ photos and album cloud storage. All charges are made through your iTunes account, with pricing varying by plan and country. The total price will be clearly displayed before you complete your purchase.
Slidebox subscriptions renew automatically, either monthly or annually, depending on your plan. Monthly subscriptions are priced at $4.99 USD, while annual subscriptions cost $49.99 USD (prices may vary outside the U.S.). To avoid renewal, turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period in your iTunes Account Settings. Slidebox does not offer free trials for these subscriptions.
If you prefer a one-time purchase option, you can unlock the full version of Slidebox permanently, which includes all future features and supports ongoing app development.
Contact: feedback-ios@slidebox.co
Terms of Use: http://slidebox.co/terms.html
Privacy Policy: http://slidebox.co/privacy.html

bluejetty:00180760:ios.developer: University of California at San Francisco
bluejetty:00180760:ios.summary:
Eureka makes it easy to join real medical studies and help solve the world’s biggest health problems—including heart disease, diabetes, cancer, mental illness, healthcare inequities and more.
It’s now easier than ever to have a big impact
bluejetty:00180760:ios.description:
Eureka makes it easy to join real medical studies and help solve the world’s biggest health problems—including heart disease, diabetes, cancer, mental illness, healthcare inequities and more.
It’s now easier than ever to have a big impact on causes you care about . All it takes to contribute to world-changing research with Eureka is a smartphone and a little bit of free time. 
Team up with millions of other study participants helping top researchers from research universities like UCSF, Harvard, and Johns Hopkins to answer questions like, “What signals from my smartphone might predict heart disease?” and “How does physical activity affect cancer risk?”
Eureka is a non-profit resource built by researchers at the University of California, San Francisco with support from the National Institutes of Health. If you have questions about signing up or your current participation, reach out to us at support@eurekaplatform.org.
For the studies that are on our app, we are not currently pulling HealthKit data but are collecting approval for future use. We use the CareKit framework in our application but do not connect to it in any other way.

bluejetty:00027063:ios.name: ClimaVinea
bluejetty:00027063:ios.summary: A comprehensive guide to the great wines of Burgundy, with detailed interactive maps of its renowned vineyards (known as climats), from Montrachet to Chambertin. Includes a guide to the top producers and a GPS function for your visits to th
bluejetty:00027063:ios.description:
A comprehensive guide to the great wines of Burgundy, with detailed interactive maps of its renowned vineyards (known as climats), from Montrachet to Chambertin. Includes a guide to the top producers and a GPS function for your visits to the vineyards. 
Features of ClimaVinea: 
• An interactive version of Sylvain Pitiot’s authoritative new maps, published in his book The Climats and Lieux-Dits of the Great Vineyards of Burgundy (3rd edition 2019). Includes the most recent scholarship on the origins of parcel names from Marie-Hélène Landrieu. 
• The Who’s Who of producers: profiles and wine lists for 140 elite estates and negociants, to help you build a cellar and make informed choices from restaurant wine lists. The list is entirely impartial (there are no ads or sales linked to this app), the selection being based on the collective judgments of the best international critics over several vintages. (Not a comprehensive list of all producers.) 
• An encyclopedic reference that will satisfy your curiosity and help you deepen your knowledge of the history, culture, and vineyards that produce great wines of Burgundy—knowledge that enhances the pleasure of exploring and drinking them. 
• A powerful search engine helps you find reliable, precise information. Whether you are a professional, connoisseur, collector, or student of wine, with ClimaVinea you can find a vineyard on the map and look up its surface area and other facts, check whether a producer makes a certain wine, discover the characteristics of an appellation, and more. 
• A GPS function guides you through the vineyards when you visit Burgundy. 
• Includes both French and English versions, with the option to switch back and forth. - A must have for anyone seriously interested in the wines of Burgundy.

bluejetty:00150126:ios.name: Park 915
bluejetty:00150126:ios.summary: The Park 915 app, powered by ParkMobile, provides a convenient way to pay for parking in El Paso, Texas, using your mobile phone. Registering is free and takes less than two minutes to join. The Park 915 app takes the stress out of parking.
bluejetty:00150126:ios.description:
The Park 915 app, powered by ParkMobile, provides a convenient way to pay for parking in El Paso, Texas, using your mobile phone. Registering is free and takes less than two minutes to join. The Park 915 app takes the stress out of parking. No more searching for coins. No worries about an out-of-service parking meter. With the Park 915 app, starting your parking session takes just a few seconds. You can use the app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, Houston, Minneapolis, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, and more.
Why Use the Park 915 app?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Track parking expenses and easily export for expense reimbursements
• Reserve parking spots ahead of time to save time and money
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the Park 915 app and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the Park 915 app
How It Works:
• Streets, Lots, and Garages: Enter the zone number on the posted signs in your area. Select the amount of time you want to park, and start your session. Extend time in the app if you are running late.
• Parking Reservations: Search for where you want to park and select the specific parking facility. Choose the date/time and complete your reservation. Follow the instructions in your confirmation to redeem at the parking facility.
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find my car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked
• Multiple payment methods available
About ParkMobile
ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider of parking payment solutions in the United States, helping over 40 million people easily find, reserve, and pay for parking from their mobile devices.
Looking for Help?
At ParkMobile, we’re serious about customer service. We process nearly 500,000 parking transactions every day and we know that every now and then, something might go wrong. If you have an issue, we will do everything we can to make it right. Our customer service is 24/7/365. If you need help, here’s how to get in touch with us:
Web: https://ParkMobile.io/
Online Help Center: https://support.ParkMobile.io/hc/en-us/requests/new
Video Tutorials: https://ParkMobile.io/tips-demos/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ParkMobile
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParkMobile/

bluejetty:00022323:ios.summary: Azkar App is your daily companion for enhancing spirituality and facilitating Islamic practices. It provides a comprehensive collection of authentic Athkar (remembrances) and supplications from the Qur’an and Sunnah, along with innovative f
bluejetty:00022323:ios.description:
Azkar App is your daily companion for enhancing spirituality and facilitating Islamic practices. It provides a comprehensive collection of authentic Athkar (remembrances) and supplications from the Qur’an and Sunnah, along with innovative features designed to meet the needs of Muslims in their daily lives.
Join millions of users and experience a complete spiritual journey with Azkar App, crafted to serve every Muslim.
Key Features
- Morning & Evening Athkar, Sleep & Wake-up Athkar, Prayer Athkar, and more: A modern and user-friendly interface with an audio player and repetition counter.
- My Athkar Section: Create and customize your own Athkar according to your needs.
- Qur’an (Reading, Tafsir, and Audio): Enjoy an eye-friendly reading experience with font and color customization, translations in multiple languages, and easy-to-understand Tafsir. You can also listen or download recitations by your favorite reciter.
- Khatmah: Set a Qur’an completion plan with daily reading reminders.
- Prayer Times, Qibla Direction, and Hijri Calendar: View the Islamic calendar, accurate prayer times, and Qibla direction, with a monthly prayer calendar that can be shared.
- Adhan & Full Adhan Alerts: Choose from a variety of Adhan voices with pre-Adhan reminders.
- Reminders Section: Create reminders for specific Athkar, supplications, or important events with customizable sound and repetition options.
- Daily Content Updates: Get Dua of the Day, Ayah of the Day, and Video of the Day with valuable tips and inspiring stories.
- Various Azkar: A variety of supplications with customizable backgrounds, ready for sharing.
- Ramadan Section: Essential Ramadan features including Prayer & Fasting Tracker, Daily Duas, Zakat Calculator, and more.
- Daily Quranic Benefits: Daily insights into Qur’anic verses for contemplation.
- Worship Trackers: Tools to track Athkar, fasting, and prayers, helping you stay consistent and improve commitment.
- Tasbih Counter: Perform electronic Dhikr with an easy-to-use digital Tasbih.
- Ruqyah (Islamic Healing): Authentic Ruqyah texts from the Qur’an and Sunnah, with an audio listening option.
- Prophet Muhammad’s (PBUH) Biography in Videos: Engaging video content about the life of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
- 99 Names of Allah.
- Surah Al-Kahf Reminder for Fridays.
- Hajj & Umrah Guide: Step-by-step instructions for performing Hajj and Umrah.
- Islamic & Ramadan WhatsApp Stickers: Updated Islamic and Ramadan sticker packs with easy export to WhatsApp.
- Istighfar (Forgiveness) Alerts: Get reminders for seeking forgiveness and making Dhikr at customizable intervals (e.g., every 10 minutes or once a day).
- Qiyam-ul-Layl (Night Prayer) Alerts.
- Live Activities & Widgets: Quick access to features like prayer times, Hijri date, various azkar, Khatmah, prayer tracker, fasting tracker, and more from the home screen and lock screen.
- Professional & Customizable Design: Choose your favorite background, and enable dark mode for a better visual experience.
- …and many more great features you’ll love!
Why Azkar App?
Azkar App is a comprehensive Islamic tool, combining authenticity with modern technology to fulfill your spiritual and daily needs.
Take this opportunity to increase your daily rewards and strengthen your connection with Allah. Download Azkar App now and embark on an uninterrupted spiritual journey filled with Dhikr and supplication.
Privacy Policy:
https://hamzaaa.com/azkar/privacy.html
Terms of Use:
https://hamzaaa.com/azkar/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00131319:ios.name: Blood Pressure Tracker SmartBP
bluejetty:00131319:ios.summary: SmartBP® is a blood pressure app that enables you to log, monitor, evaluate, and share BP reports using iOS devices and Apple Watch. In addition, SmartBP connects with Apple Health. With your health information at your fingertips, you can n
bluejetty:00131319:ios.description:
SmartBP® is a blood pressure app that enables you to log, monitor, evaluate, and share BP reports using iOS devices and Apple Watch. In addition, SmartBP connects with Apple Health. With your health information at your fingertips, you can now take a more active role in your own health. For those with prehypertension or hypertension, SmartBP can assist in monitoring progress, identifying trends, and managing all your blood pressure and heart measurements, ultimately aiming to enhance your overall heart health and blood pressure. SmartBP is a smarter way to manage your blood pressure measurements and track your progress.
Disclaimer: 
1) SmartBP al­lows you to record, track and an­a­lyze trends in your blood pres­sure. You can ei­ther man­u­al­ly en­ter your records or use a blood pres­sure mon­i­tor to sync with SmartBP through Apple Health. SmartBP alone does not mea­sure blood pres­sure. You need a sep­a­rate blood pres­sure mon­i­tor to mea­sure blood pres­sure.
2) SmartBP is NOT a substitute for a doctor or professional healthcare or advice. Any health related information provided is for informational purposes only and should not be used to replace the advice of healthcare professionals.
3) SmartBP Cloud Sync is not a replacement for backing up your health data. While we strive for the highest data security, no measures can ensure 100% protection. Regular data backups are the user's responsibility.
For information on how to use the app, visit our website 
* Video: www.smartbp.app
* FAQ: www.smartbp.app/faq 
Features- 
- Log your systolic, diastolic blood pressure, pulse rate and weight. Body mass index (BMI), pulse pressure (PP) and mean arterial pressure (MAP) is automatically calculated. You can manually enter measurements or seamlessly sync them with a supported Bluetooth BP monitors such as:
* A&D 
* Omron 
* Beurer
* Transtek
- Quickly add notes (e.g. before dinner) and measurement information (e.g. sitting, left arm) using tags. 
- Store and access all your blood pressure measurements anywhere and anytime using Apple HealthKit. Avoid manual data entry and reduce errors by automatically uploading blood pressure measurements to HealthKit by auto-syncing with SmartBP. The following Blood Pressure Monitor Apps can connect to HealthKit (check for compatibility with different models): 
* A&D 
* Omron 
* iHealth
* Withings
- Share your blood pressure information with your doctor, healthcare provider or family using email, text message (SMS), Apple HealthKit. Create blood pressure reports in PDF format with blood pressure data, charts and stats and share with your doctor or healthcare provider. 
- View 7, 14, 30 day summary grouped by daily AM/PM averages and tags. Create, share and print summary PDF reports and CSV file.
- Print PDF reports or charts directly
- Analyze your progress through clear graphs and statistics (including mean and variability). Filter data using tags to assess lifestyle changes or medication effectiveness. Compare tagged graphs side by side and observe systolic vs. diastolic blood pressure correlations.
- Track your Heart Rate trends
- Sync ECG records
- Back up your health data and access it on all your mobile devices with SmartBP Cloud. This is an optional service. We do not sell your health data.
- Sync directly between iPhone and iPad through Bluetooth or WiFi without sharing on the cloud.
- Back up blood pressure data by exporting to Dropbox, and Drive, or import from CSV files into the app.
- Protect your data with TouchID, FaceID or Pin keypad protection.
- Set medication reminders & track effectiveness.
- Intuitive color coded data to identify normal, prehypertensive, stage I and II hypertension. These limits can be modified. Categorize your records based on 2017 ACA/AHA, 2023 ESC/ESH or create your own custom categories.
- Create multiple user profiles and manage them from a single app/device.
- US and international height and weight units supported.

With Contacts Sync, you can quickly & easily sync your Google or Outlook contacts with iPhone, giving you access to your contacts wherever
bluejetty:00069945:ios.description:
••• SYNC GOOGLE, ICLOUD, & OUTLOOK!
••• #1 SYNC APP FOR 15+ YEARS!
••• TRUSTED BY 10,000,000+ USERS!
With Contacts Sync, you can quickly & easily sync your Google or Outlook contacts with iPhone, giving you access to your contacts wherever you go. This app distinguishes itself with its reliability, ease of use, speed, and with a true "2-way sync" that merges changes made to either account. This is the #1 app for syncing contacts both in terms of downloads & reviews.
Also of significance, this app syncs your Google labels or Outlook categories with your iPhone lists. For instance, you may have organized your Google contacts into groups such as "friends," "family," and "coworkers." After a sync, your iPhone and Google groups will match. With your groups configured on iPhone, you can easily send group emails or group messages.
SYNC THE FOLLOWING ACCOUNTS:
• Sync Google with iPhone
• Sync Outlook with iPhone
• Sync 2 Google accounts
SYNC ANY IPHONE ACCOUNT:
• Choose to sync all of your iPhone contacts, or choose to sync contacts from a specific iPhone account, such as iCloud, a local iPhone address book, Outlook, or a CardDAV account
SYNC TYPES:
• Choose from one of the following sync types: 2-Way Sync, 1-Way Sync, and Manual Sync
• Choose a 2-Way Sync to sync changes in both directions
• Choose a 1-Way Sync to transfer changes in one direction only
• Choose a Manual Sync to sync specific contacts only
SYNCS ALL FIELDS:
• Syncs all fields including names, phonetic names, nicknames, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, company names, job titles, departments, birthdays, anniversaries, events, notes, web page addresses, relationships, instant messaging accounts, & social profiles
• Syncs contact photos
• Syncs custom labels & custom fields
INITIAL SYNC:
• During the initial sync, the contents of matching contacts will be merged
CONFIRM CHANGES BEFORE SYNCING:
• Review each change before the sync actually begins
AUTOMATIC SYNC:
• Automatically syncs contacts in the background 24/7
APPLY FILTERS INCLUDING GROUP FILTER:
• Apply the group filter, new contact filter, and more!
DUPLICATE CONTACTS:
• Eliminate duplicate contacts from both iPhone and Google
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• Contacts Sync offers a "Premium" subscription which unlocks all of the premium features in the app, including the ability to sync an unlimited number of contacts and to auto sync in the background.
• Without an upgrade, the app will sync no more than 40 contacts
• The "Premium" subscription is priced at $1.99 USD per week, $2.99 USD per month, or $9.99 USD per year
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Terms of use: https://playaapps.zendesk.com/hc/articles/360004197333
• Privacy Policy: https://playaapps.zendesk.com/hc/articles/226767688

bluejetty:00187164:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Sydney Airport (SYD). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Sydney Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every SYD flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sydney Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy
http://flightinfoapps.com/flightinfoapps-privacy-policy

PainLess – Stretching & Flexibility App! Move, Bend, and Stretch Daily!
Improve flexibility, mobility, posture, and overall wellness with PainLess! Stretch at home, PainLess makes your daily routine easy to do wherever.
- Stretching App for Flexibility & Mobility
Use PainLess to move, bend, and stretch your body every day. Stretching improves flexibility, unlocks splits, and helps you improve mobility and move better. PainLess is your daily mobility companion.
- Daily Stretching for All Levels
PainLess is designed for everyone – from beginners to advanced. Start slow, follow easy stretch routines, and gradually improve flexibility and posture with daily short routines for better mobility.
- Pilates and Wall Pilates Workouts
Simple daily routines for all levels. Do Pilates anytime at home, no equipment needed. Follow the 28-Day Wall Pilates Challenge to build strength, improve mobility, and correct posture.
- Full Body Stretching & Mobility App
Stretch your full body – legs, back, hips, shoulders, neck, spine. Improve range of motion, reduce tightness, and increase muscle flexibility. Great for warm-ups or cool-downs. If you need improved flexibility and mobility, try PainLess: Stretching and mobility!
- Stretch at Home or Anywhere
PainLess is perfect for home use. No equipment needed. Stretch anytime – morning, evening, before bed, or after workout. Take your mobility routines wherever you go.
- Flexibility for Mobility & Posture
Daily stretching improves posture and balance. Reduce lower back pain, neck pain, and stiffness. Stay active and mobile with simple, guided stretch routines designed to improve mobility.
- Improve Splits, Backbends, and More
Working on splits or backbends? PainLess helps you bend and stretch with progress. Track your mobility and flexibility to see real improvements with regular stretching practice.
- Move, Bend, Stretch – Daily Movement That Feels Good
Stretching improves blood flow, reduces injury risk, and supports recovery. PainLess gives you daily stretch sessions to keep your body active, mobile, and flexible.
- Perfect for Athletes, Office Workers, Seniors
PainLess supports different lifestyles. Whether you sit all day, train daily, or need gentle mobility exercises, PainLess offers customized stretch options.
- Join the 28-Day Flexibility Challenge!
Stretch daily with PainLess’s 28-Day Challenge to improve flexibility, posture, and mobility. Move, bend, and stretch every day with targeted routines for splits, back, hips, hamstrings, and more. Perfect for all levels – build a daily stretching habit, track your progress, and improve mobility in just 4 weeks. Start your mobility journey today!
- Simple and Effective Stretching App
PainLess focuses on consistency. Just follow the plan. No distractions. No complexity. Just move, stretch, and bend every day to improve mobility, flexibility, and comfort.
How It Works:
1. Pick your stretching & workout program.
2. Follow step-by-step guided routines.
3. Move, bend, and stretch daily to improve mobility. Track your progress over time.
Start stretching today. Use PainLess to move, bend, and stretch your way to better flexibility, posture, and mobility. Stretch at home or anywhere with PainLess to improve mobility every day!
Become a Pro member to unlock unlimited features.

bluejetty:00061895:ios.summary: An advanced 3D model viewer for viewing all kinds of 3D models. Featuring AR viewing, custom rotation pivot and exploded assembly view. Preview mesh models including OBJ, STL, STP, DAE, PLY and Blend, supporting rendering, animation playbac
bluejetty:00061895:ios.description:
An advanced 3D model viewer for viewing all kinds of 3D models. Featuring AR viewing, custom rotation pivot and exploded assembly view. Preview mesh models including OBJ, STL, STP, DAE, PLY and Blend, supporting rendering, animation playback, 3D printing and model data inspection.
Features
1. Support AR and 3D viewing modes.
2. Customizable background and environment lighting.
3. Animation preview for GLB, GLTF, FBX and more formats.
4. Real-time shadow casting.
5. Local & cloud document management (iCloud, DropBox, etc.).
6. Set custom rotation pivot point for model viewing.
7. Exploded view function to separate assembly parts.
8. Wide format support: STP, STEP, BERP, IGES, 3DS, OBJ, GLB, GLTF, STL, SLC, 3MF, PLY, OFF, DAE, Blend, FBX, USDZ, MD2, MD3, MD5, MDL, MS3D, DXF, X
 Read packaged archives containing models, MTL files and textures: ZIP, RAR.
9. Multiple import ways: iTunes File Sharing, AirDrop, iCloud, email attachments, web download.
10. File sharing via AirDrop or Email.
11. Capture, share and save screenshots.
12. Auto rotation and full-screen viewing mode.
13. Display model metrics: dimensions, volume, surface area, vertex count and triangle count.
14. Folder management in the file browser.
If you have any suggestions or questions, please email belighten@gmail.com. Thank you for your support!

bluejetty:00182825:ios.name: Klondike Adventures: Farm Game
bluejetty:00182825:ios.summary:
Welcome to Klondike! It is not just a farm game simulator, it's a thrilling world of expeditions during the Gold Rush era, filled with mysteries and unexpected discoveries! 
Are you dreaming of an exciting adventure? Do you like traveling
bluejetty:00182825:ios.description:
Welcome to Klondike! It is not just a farm game simulator, it's a thrilling world of expeditions during the Gold Rush era, filled with mysteries and unexpected discoveries! 
Are you dreaming of an exciting adventure? Do you like traveling to odd places? Enjoy renovating abandoned spots? Or maybe you just want to take a break and play a relaxing mini-game and build your farm?
Klondike has it all! Complete tasks, build houses and factories, grow crops, and raise livestock! Help Kate and Paul build their dream farm!
Exciting adventures and themed events await you. Leave your farm and explore new areas where you can find real treasures! 
Klondike features:
- Unique gameplay: develop your farm, landscape the territory, construct buildings, produce valuable resources, fulfill orders, explore new areas, and find real treasures.
- Regular themed locations and events: exciting adventures await you in mysterious and dangerous corners of the world. If you do not want to stay on the farm, embark on a journey through the wilderness, explore enigmatic ruins, and uncover the secrets hidden in the depths of these amazing places.
- Engaging tasks: build various farm buildings, grow and harvest crops, and raise animals to provide everything your farm needs! Trade with neighbors and unlock new locations! Complete numerous tasks, meet fascinating characters, restore the farm, and unravel the secrets of the surrounding lands.
- Colorful characters: get to know their fascinating farming stories; help the heroes overcome all the challenges.
- Captivating mini-games: play fun mini-games at your farm and in other locations! Complete tasks between expeditions! Receive valuable gifts and prizes.
- Breathtaking landscapes: enjoy the stunning scenery and landscapes of various locations! Your small northern farm is filled with wonders of nature and history in every corner! You can explore the terrain for hours. The game's graphics are top-notch, and every element of the world is crafted with great love. The wild lands and the atmosphere of gold mining beckon you to embark on a journey with the main characters!
Klondike is a free farming game, but some in-game resources can be purchased with real money. Internet connection is required to play and participate in competitions.
Klondike is not just a farm game, it's a whole world that you can explore, develop, and make your own. Immerse yourself in an exciting journey, become the owner of an incredible farm, and commence your journey as a gold seeker! Travel back to the days of the Gold Rush and begin your adventure right now!

Privacy Notice: https://docs.vizor-games.com/terms/privacy-notice/en

global storms provides the latest severe weather information including:
- hurricanes, typhoons and tropical storms in the Atlantic and Pacific oceans

Information in the app is courtesy of various open government sources as indicated in each section.
There is an auto-renewing subscription option within the app to track worldwide tropical cyclones, typhoons, hurricanes and other global weather hazards, and comprehensive ocean conditions forecasts for the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
Development of global storms is funded in part by ads, which can be removed by selecting the monthly auto-renewing subscription option "Remove Ads" from the app's settings menu. Removing ads also provides access to other premium content and features.
The subscription price of 0.99 USD (in your local currency) will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and, for each renewal, within 24 hours prior to the end of the current month.
You can cancel the subscription at any time through your iTunes account settings, but you must do so at least 24 hours before the end of the current month to avoid being charged, and ads will show again at the start of the subsequent month.

bluejetty:00178893:ios.description:
نداء الحرب: حروب الأبطال
لعبة استراتيجية حربية عالمية مليئة بالتحدي والمنافسة، انضم إلى أصدقائك وشكّل التحالفات بين الدول والإمبراطوريات لمواجهة الدول المعادية والقضاء على الأعداء والكتائب المتمردة. قم ببناء مدينتك العسكرية الحديثة وجهّزها بأقوى الأسلحة والدبابات المتطورة والطائرات المقاتلة، بالإضافة إلى التكنولوجيا المتقدمة والصواريخ الباليستية. حقق الانتصار في المعارك والحروب بفضل استراتيجيتك الحربية الذكية و المميزة

دردش مع أصدقائك وسيطر على الشات! تحالف معهم وخطط للحروب والمعارك، ادخل في حرب عالمية ثالثة وأنجز المهام في لعبة تحاكي الحروب الحقيقية! ادخل في قتال عسكري ملحمي ضد أعدائك. الحرب انتقام وتحدي، كن من صقور الحرب الشامخة.

أنت قائد كتيبة جنود مخضرمين ناجين من معارك ضارية ومتعطشين للدماء، وعليك تحدي أعداءك في معارك أمام العالم أجمع وقصفهم باستمرار للصمود في عالم الحرب القاسي! القادة الأسطوريون فقط من يمكنهم قيادة فريق حربي من الجنود المخضرمين الناجين وإنشاء قاعدة دفاعية ومدينة قوية للحصول على الحرية لشعبهم وزيادة نطاق إمبراطوريتهم واكتشاف الحضارات الجديدة. قم بقيادة الطائرات المسيرة والمروحيات وسرب كامل من الطائرات القاصفة.

bluejetty:00163996:ios.name: Smart Receipt Scan: Receiptly
bluejetty:00163996:ios.summary: Smart receipt scanner and expense tracker in one easy app. Scan several receipts in one go or import photos and PDFs, and Receiptly reads the store, date, total, tax and line items for you. With Receiptly Pro, you can also connect Gmail to
bluejetty:00163996:ios.description:
Smart receipt scanner and expense tracker in one easy app. Scan several receipts in one go or import photos and PDFs, and Receiptly reads the store, date, total, tax and line items for you. With Receiptly Pro, you can also connect Gmail to import receipts from your emails, see where your money goes in spending reports, and export to PDF, Excel or CSV. Keep every receipt, invoice and warranty organized and ready for tax time, budgets, refunds and reimbursements.
RECEIPTLY: YOUR RECEIPT KEEPER FOR HOME AND BUSINESS
Track groceries and household spending, keep proof of purchase for returns and warranties, or log business costs, mileage and travel for your accountant. Receiptly works for families, freelancers, landlords and small businesses, and syncs with iCloud across your iPhone and iPad.
Features:
> Smart Scan: scan paper receipts with the camera or import photos and PDFs. On-device AI fills in the details where available, and you check them before saving.
> Quick capture: share a receipt from any app to Receiptly, or drag and drop images and PDFs on iPad.
> Expense tracker: log expenses, income and reimbursements to see what comes in and what goes out.
> Mileage tracker: log trips in miles or kilometers with your own rate, and Receiptly works out the amount.
> Warranty tracker: add a warranty end date to any product and get a reminder before it expires.
> Receipt organizer: categories, tags, pins and archive, plus search by store, item, amount or date.
> Duplicate check: get a warning before you save the same receipt twice.
> Siri and Shortcuts: scan receipts, find them and log expenses or mileage by voice, or add an expense automatically each time you pay with Apple Wallet.
> Widgets and Spotlight: see a category's receipts or warranty countdowns on your Home Screen, and find receipts in Spotlight search.
Receiptly Pro, an auto-renewable subscription, adds:
> Unlimited receipts, expenses and categories (the free version includes 10 of each).
> Reports: spending trends, categories, calendar, forecast, price watch, tax summary, and a business report with mileage.
> Export receipts, expenses and tax reports to PDF, Excel or CSV for your accountant.
> Travel currencies: set the currency and your own exchange rate on each receipt.
> Import receipts from Gmail. Emails are read on your device.
> Bulk import from CSV, save receipt images to Files, and get a spending summary from Siri.
For support and suggestions, email karm.singh@outlook.com
• Auto-renewable subscription
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically for the same period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
• Privacy Policy: https://receipttrackerapp.com/privacypolicy/
• Terms of Use: https://receipttrackerapp.com/termsofuse/

bluejetty:00045374:ios.description:
Get usage and account information on-the-go with the myCellcom app! The myCellcom app allows you to manage various account functions, including:
•View talk, text and data usage 
•View your plan and bill
•Make a payment
•Manage usage notifications
•Contact Cellcom
To use the myCellcom app, you need to have a myCellcom account set up. To register for a free myCellcom account:
•Simply go to http://my.cellcom.com select the link below the Log In button that says Click to Register, and follow the prompts to complete registration. 
–If you are registering as an Account Owner, to verify your relationship with the account, you will need to provide one of the following pieces of information: Account password or social security number (last 4 digits) or federal tax ID.
–You can also choose to sign up as a Wireless User without an account password. A Wireless User account only has access to select information. 
Important Note: The information provided is solely an estimate and may not accurately reflect your current usage. It is based on information that is received and processed by Cellcom at this time. There may be some delays in processing information.

bluejetty:00075598:ios.description:
Dive into the Ultimate Shogi Experience!
Unearth the magic of Shogi (将棋, shōgi) – Japan's treasure of strategic gameplay, revered as their version of Chess. Engage in thrilling battles on a board where every move tells a story. 'Shōgi', translating to the general's (shō 将) board game (gi 棋), is a testament to its captivating legacy.
Witness the unique charm of Shogi: the strategic genius of deploying captured pieces back onto the board, a twist that has captivated enthusiasts since its ancient inception.
Endorsed by legendary player Yoshiharu Habu, Shogi isn't just Japan's favorite pastime – it's a masterpiece of art. A symphony that harmonizes seamlessly with the traditional echoes of haiku, tanka, noh, ikebana, and the soulful Japanese tea ceremony. Its illustrious stature is carved by the age-old iemoto system, bolstered by historical shogunate backing.
Features that Elevate Your Shogi Adventure:
◆ Crafted Undo: Strategize with freedom!
◆ Game Save/Load: Your game, on your time.
◆ Skill Spectrum: Embark on journeys from beginner to maestro with 5 tailored difficulty levels.
◆ Beat the Clock: Thrill in timer-driven confrontations.
◆ Your Board, Your Rules: Customize with a robust board editor.
◆ Aural Pleasure: Dive deep with tailored sound effects.
◆ Diverse Gameplay: Westernized pieces, multiple piece sets, and board designs to choose from.
Join the ranks of Shogi connoisseurs. Immerse in an unparalleled blend of strategy, art, and tradition. Your board awaits.

bluejetty:00131786:ios.summary:
Buddhify is here to help you bring more calm, clarity and kindness to all parts of your life.
Whether you're looking to reduce stress and anxiety, or get a better night's sleep buddhify has easy-to-follow guided meditations to help you liv
bluejetty:00131786:ios.description:
Buddhify is here to help you bring more calm, clarity and kindness to all parts of your life.
Whether you're looking to reduce stress and anxiety, or get a better night's sleep buddhify has easy-to-follow guided meditations to help you live happier and healthier.
No need to find the time for a formal meditation session everyday, we'll show you how to bring mindfulness to all parts of your life with exercises for whatever you're doing and wherever you are - from travelling, taking a break at work or going to sleep. We'll help you find calm in any situation.
WHAT'S INCLUDED?
- Over 200 meditations to help overcome life's challenges including anxiety, stress, sleep, pain and difficult emotions
- Mindfulness exercises you can do wherever you are, in categories such as travelling, at work, waking up, eating, and even when you're online
- Sessions for complete beginners and those with more experience, with lengths from 3-40 minutes
- A solo timer for more seasoned meditators
- A range of experienced teachers so you can choose the voice and style that's right for you
- Kids content for the little people in your life
- Brand new buddhify Membership available as an optional in-app purchase with a range of additional features for those looking to take their meditation practice further
Buddhify integrates with Apple Health so you can track your meditation using the Mindful Minutes category within the Health app.
BUDDHIFY MEMBERSHIP
For those of you who want to deepen your practice even further, you can do that through Buddhify Membership. Becoming a Member is optional and gives you access to three amazing features: Together, Formal and the karaoke-style Transmission. Buddhify Membership is an annual subscription and payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
TERMS OF USE & PRIVACY
You can see our terms of use at https://buddhify.com/terms-of-use/ and our privacy policy at https://buddhify.com/privacy-policy/.
WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING
This app is incredible. I've been trying to get into meditation for a while now and I've found other apps or videos I've tried have been repetitive or not very good. The meditations on here are so easy to follow and the app is very user friendly. I'm always sceptical about spending money on apps but this one is so worth it. ******
I have used many meditation apps but like this one best because it offers a variety of guided meditations to use in different situations or for different purposes. They vary in the amount of time required so the app is very flexible. I also like the stats which encourage you to practice regularly. Plus I can add meditation that I do outside of the app and track that too. I highly recommend whether you are a beginner or an experienced meditator. *****
HERE TO HELP
Buddhify is made by a values-led family business and we love hearing from you. Your feedback, suggestions and comments make all the hard work feel so worthwhile and makes the app better as we continue to make buddhify as effective, accessible and beautiful as it can be. Say hello@buddhify.com

bluejetty:00184448:ios.description:
The next game from the ORIGINAL Evolution Series makers! 
C’mon, guys. It’s only real if it’s got the badge.
Zebras are proof that nature has a unique sense of humor. Horses in pajamas? Now that sounds like a great idea! Thanks gosh tigers only see in black and white. Now add mutations to that and you got a recipe for success. Combine zebras to evolve them and discover their most curious, exotic and bizarre forms!
After Cow, Platypus, Goat and Giraffe Evolution, comes the sequel that made us question if the game design team will ever come up with a new game idea. 
But wait… There’s more!
ALL-NEW IN ZEBRA EVOLUTION
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the zebras
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar zebras to combine them and create new mysterious creatures
• Use zebra poop coins to buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap the zebras to make coins pop from pooping
HIGHLIGHTS
• Many stages and zebra species to discover
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution, 2048 and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Many possible endings: find your own destiny
• Upgrades, upgrades, upgrades…! More than ever!
• No zebras were harmed in the making of this game, only developers (again)
Watch the process of evolution from a monochromatic perspective.
Download Zebra Evolution and have fun!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings. 
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

You can simplify your life through voice control from Amazon Alexa and Google Home assistants with y
bluejetty:00144850:ios.description:
TSmartLife is an elegant, easy-to-use app which provides real-time updates and notifications to elevate the Toshiba Smart Home experience.
You can simplify your life through voice control from Amazon Alexa and Google Home assistants with your natural language to operate your appliances effortlessly.
Connect and control devices such as compatible dishwashers, ovens, refrigerators, robotic vacuums and more, all through this single app.
Key features:
• Cool your house, or preheat your oven while you commute home through a full featured control interface.
• Want to know if the oven is finished baking or how much time before the dishwasher cycle is completed? Receive real-time status updates and notifications of appliance activities.
• Use natural conversation to control your appliances such as “Alexa, defrost 12 ounces of chicken”.*
• Invite family members to share control of appliances.
App Requirements:
- iOS 9.0 or later.
Access Permissions: 
The following access permission is necessary for the TSmartLife app to provide the best experience.
- Bluetooth: Find nearby devices using Bluetooth or BLE.
- Location: Detect home WLAN network and enable device connection.
*When connected to compatible Amazon Alexa and Google Home devices.
*Available devices and voice commands vary in different regions.

bluejetty:00179577:ios.description:
ProCCD is an analog digital film camera application & carousel collage maker. We have reproduced the classic appearance of digital cameras and vintage film & digital camera-inspired retro filter effects. We also create Instagram carousel posts, stories, photo & video collage templates.
#40+ Vintage Film Camera, Digital Camera & VHS Camcorder
2000S & 2014: A tribute to old button phone, featuring 2000s lofi style that adds a Y2K aesthetic to everyday moments.
INST E & INST W: Instant cameras that simulate instant camera filters along with stunning photo papers.
Booth: A vintage photo booth in your pocket that supports single shots and four-shot sequences.
MG330: Retro VHS camcorders that transport you back to the year 1980.
F100: Inspired by the classic negative film filter, the camera edits using RAW files with zero sharpening.
BIGSHOT: An instant camera with vintage pack film, restoring the pulling and peeling process.
ZR1500: A disposable camera ideal for capturing everyday moments and landscapes.
Z50 & A620: Digital camera filters with a dreamy glow effect.
New vintage cameras are added continuously!
#Seamless Carousel & Photo Collage Maker for Instagram & Tiktok
- Create swipeable, panoramic carousel posts, layouts and collages to elevate your Instagram feed.
- Add video, live photos and images to the collage.
- Explore a wide array of photo collage templates for Instagram Stories, Posts and Reels—from instant style and scrapbook styles to minimalist layouts.
- Access 600+ hand-picked stickers and frames, plus 100+ exclusive fonts to personalize your content.
- Easy design tools: remove backgrounds, apply film filters, and use a freeform canvas to combine 30+ photos in one post—break free from traditional layouts.
#Aesthetic Photo Editor & Video Editor
- Supports importing photos & video for editing with oldroll camera filters.
- Effects & Overlays: Vintage photo effects & video effects including glitter, fish eye, light leak, VCR frame, etc.
- Collages & Templates: 100+ templates & layouts to make it easy to create Instagram stories.
- Powerful Editing Tools: Adjust exposure, saturation, film grain, vignette, blur, glow, dispersion and white balance to get a film look.
- Beauty Editor: Beauty function is available for capturing & editing.
- Crop & geometry: Rotate, crop, and resize your files.
- Supports batch editing.
- Supports conversion between video and live photos.
#Profesional Pro Camera:
- Preview effects in real-time through the viewfinder; what you see is what you get.
- Adjustable ISO, shutter speed, exposure, white balance, and more.
- Flash and self-timer functionalities.
- Multiple aspect ratios and configurable resolution options.
- Support for all lens types (ultra-wide, wide, telephoto).
- Various date stamps available.
Stay tuned for more advanced features and new camera releases coming soon!
*Subscription Info:
Subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within the app.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. bluejetty:00074339:ios.description:
Official mobile application for Montreal metropolitan area’s bike share system.
It allows users to purchase one-way passes and memberships and to rent a bike. Bixi connects with the Health app and sends ride durations so your pedaling counts towards your health goals. Access your personal space to learn more about your trips and usage statistics.

bluejetty:00142958:ios.description:
말해주는 고퀄리티 단어장! 영어, 일본어, 스페인어, 중국어, 프랑스어, 독일어, 베트남어 등의 단어를 배워보세요. 언어 공부가 재밌어집니다.
듣기만 해도 저절로 외워지는 단어장 암기고래!
암기고래는 영어, 일본어, 스페인어, 중국어, 프랑스어, 독일어, 베트남어, 러시아어 총 8개 국어의 8만 단어 이상을 효과적이고, 효율적으로 암기하도록 도와주는 단어장 서비스입니다.(공유 단어장에는 더 많은 언어의 단어장을 제공하고 있습니다.)
암기고래에서 제공되는 수많은 단어장의 단어마다 직접 음성으로 설명해 주고 반복해 주기 때문에 앱을 켜 놓기만 해도 단어가 저절로 외워집니다. 로그인 없이 바로 공부할 수 있는 암기고래에서 단어 공부를 시작해 보세요.
내가 원하는 단어들로 나만의 단어장을 쉽고, 빠르게 만들어 공부할 수 있습니다.
암기고래 회화는 실생활에 필요한 문장들을 모두 공부할 수 있고, 단순히 문장을 암기하는 것이 아니라 문장을 완전히 이해하고 1초 안에 바로 자연스럽게 말할 수 있도록 해줍니다.
암기고래 동영상 강의는 외국어를 더 빠르게 활용할 수 있도록 도와줄 거예요!
[암기고래가 좋은 이유]
- 효과 만점 플래시 단어 카드! 그림으로 보여주고, 음성으로 직접 설명해주니까 머리에 쏙쏙!
- 바쁜 출퇴근길에도 편하게! 휴대폰 잠금 화면에서 단어장을 바로 학습할 수 있어요.
- 원하는 단어장은 북마크해서 언제든지 볼 수 있고, 나만의 단어장을 직접 만들 수도 있어요.
- 다양한 퀴즈로 단어를 재미있게 풀면서 암기하니까! 단어 암기가 지루하지 않아요.
- 많은 사람이 암기할 수 있도록! 혼자 보기 아까운 단어장은 사람들과 공유할 수 있어요.
- 외로운 나 홀로 공부, 지치지 않도록! 그룹에서 함께 공부할 수 있어요.
- 회화를 다양한 방법으로 공부하고, 연습해 볼 수 있어요. 하루하루 달라지는 회화 실력을 느껴보세요!
- 최고의 강사님들의 동영상 강의를 모아 볼 수 있어요.
[암기고래 A to Z]
- 암기고래에서 제공하는 단어장은 어떻게 되나요?
언어별로 추천 단어장, 기초 단어장, 중급 단어장, 고급 단어장, 시험 단어장, 공무원 단어장 등으로 나뉘어 있습니다.
- 암기고래를 이용하려면 회원가입을 해야 하나요?
로그인 없이 단어장을 학습하고, 단어 퀴즈를 풀 수 있습니다. 회원가입을 하시면 원하는 단어장을 북마크하여 보관하거나, 나만의 단어장을 만드는 등 훨씬 효율적으로 학습할 수 있습니다. 물론 회원가입은 무료입니다.^^
- 단어장을 음성과 그림으로 설명해 준다는 게 무슨 말인가요?
암기고래는 모든 단어를 친절한 음성과 단어에 해당하는 그림으로 설명해 드립니다. 
전문가의 음성 설명을 통해 단어의 발음 및 예문 등을 효율적으로 학습할 수 있고, 반복 청취는 물론 휴대폰 대기화면에서도 단어를 확인할 수 있습니다.
- 결심 모드가 무엇인가요?
암기고래 결심 모드는 하루에 외울 단어 개수와 요일을 정하면 자동으로 공부 스케줄을 만들어 주는 기능입니다. 스케줄 관리까지 모두 암기고래가 해주니 암기고래를 믿고, 나만의 결심을 만들어 보세요.
외국어 공부 전문가들이 추천한 바로 그 단어장 앱!
단어장을 듣기만 해도 암기가 저절로! 암기고래!
지금 암기고래 앱을 다운로드하고 바로 단어 학습을 시작해 보세요!
암기고래는 네트워크 연결 없이 오프라인으로도 단어장을 들을 수 있습니다.(앱 다운로드 후 홈 탭 - 오른쪽 상단 메뉴 - 고객센터 - 자주 묻는 질문 확인)
암기고래에게 궁금한 점이 있으면 언제든지 알려 주세요.
- 암기고래 앱 - 홈 탭 - 오른쪽 상단 메뉴 - 고객센터 - 1:1문의

bluejetty:00099228:android.description:
Welcome to Gamma AI App, your powerful personal assistant powered by latest models of all popular GPT’s! Whether you're crafting sales copy, preparing a speech, solving math problems, or just looking for a reliable chat companion, Gamma AI App is here to help. bluejetty:00180014:ios.description:
Học tiếng Nhật N5 N1 - Mikun là ứng dụng học tiếng Nhật tốt nhất hiện nay với dữ liệu từ cơ bản đến nâng cao. 
Hơn 10000 từ vựng, 2000 kanji, 1000 mẫu ngữ pháp tiếng Nhật thông dụng luyện thi JLPT N5-N1.
Học tiếng Nhật N5 N1 - Mikun bao gồm các nội dung:
- Bảng chữ cái hiragana, katakana, tập viết, kiểm tra bảng chữ cái.
- Mẫu câu giao tiếp tiếng Nhật:
 + 16 chủ đề bao quát các lĩnh vực của cuộc sống.
 + 1000 mẫu câu hội thoại theo các chủ đề giao tiếp phổ biến.
- Giáo trình Minna No Nihongo:
 + 50 bài Minna No Nihongo bao gồm từ vựng và ngữ pháp.
 + Đầy đủ âm thanh và các chế độ luyện tập, kiểm tra từ vựng.
- Cùng nhau học tiếng Nhật NHK
- Từ vựng:
 + 1000 Từ Vựng Tiếng Nhật JLPT N5 gồm 12 chủ đề
 + 1500 Từ Vựng Tiếng Nhật JLPT N4 gồm 7 chủ đề
 + 2000 Từ Vựng Tiếng Nhật JLPT N3 gồm 12 chủ đề
 + 2500 Từ Vựng Tiếng Nhật JLPT N2 gồm 12 chủ đề
 + 3000 Từ Vựng Tiếng Nhật JLPT N1 gồm 14 chủ đề
- Kanji: 
 + 2000 kanji được chia theo cấp độ từ N1 - N5
 + Đầy đủ cách viết, nghĩa, giải nghĩa, ví dụ...
- Ngữ pháp tiếng Nhật: 
 + 1000 mẫu ngữ pháp tiếng Nhật chia theo cấp độ từ N5 đến N1. 
 + Đầy đủ giải thích và ví dụ cho từng cấu trúc cụ thể.
- Luyện nghe:
 + Shawdowing tiếng Nhật N5 - N4 và N3 - N2.
 + Giáo trình これで大丈夫 và bài luyện nghe tiếng Nhật theo cấp độ từ N5 đến N1 có đáp án.
- Luyện đọc: Tổng hợp bài luyện đọc tiếng Nhật theo cấp độ từ N5 đến N1. Bao gồm từ vựng, ngữ pháp, bài dịch và hướng dẫn cho từng bài học cụ thể.
- Chế độ luyện tập ghi nhớ từ vựng, kanji khoa học và hiệu quả: Flashcard, Trắc nghiệm, Ghép từ, Kiểm tra, Viết từ.
Chân thành xin lỗi bạn vì sản phầm có hiển thị quảng cáo. Đây là nguồn thu để giúp nhóm phát triển các sản phẩm. Cám ơn bạn đã tin dùng Học tiếng Nhật N5 N1 - Mikun

bluejetty:00024907:ios.name: Auri: AI Keyboard & Assistant
bluejetty:00024907:ios.summary:
Write better. Get answers. Type a lot less. Auri is a keyboard with an assistant inside, so you can speak, write, fix, translate, and ask in any app.
Hi, I'm Auri. Tell me what you want to say or do, and I'll help right where you type. Rat
bluejetty:00024907:ios.description:
Write better. Get answers. Type a lot less. Auri is a keyboard with an assistant inside, so you can speak, write, fix, translate, and ask in any app.
Hi, I'm Auri. Tell me what you want to say or do, and I'll help right where you type. Rated 4.7 and used by 280,000+ people.
► IN YOUR KEYBOARD, IN ANY APP
- Say it with voice dictation (industry-leading accuracy with a 1.1% word error rate). Tap the mic and talk the way you talk. I drop the filler, keep what you meant, and type it clean. Change your mind mid-sentence; I follow. Pick how it lands: Raw, Clean, Concise, Casual, or Professional.
- Fix it in one tap. Grammar, spelling, and punctuation in any language. Paraphrase in 22 styles, from Concise to Business Email to Persuasive, or describe your own. Translate into 31 languages as you type. Continue a sentence, or give me the topic and I'll write the draft.
- Ask me without leaving the app. Tap my key and ask about your text, your schedule, or anything at all. 
- Let me do it. From the keyboard or the app, I can add a calendar event, set a reminder, look up a contact, find places near you, search and send Gmail, and read or update a Notion page. I show you what I'm about to do and wait for your Confirm. Every source is yours to allow or turn off in Settings.
- Still a full keyboard. Swipe typing, 83 languages, every layout: QWERTY, QWERTZ, QZERTY, AZERTY, Colemak, Dvorak, 30 themes, a keyboard clipboard for the things you type often, and a vocabulary that learns your names.
► OPEN AURI WHEN IT NEEDS MORE ROOM
- Chat with four engines and 20 personas. Auto picks for you. Fast is for everyday questions, Reasoning for the hard ones, and Visual answers as a screen you can explore: cards, comparisons, and steps you can tap.
- Ask to check your email, update your Notion, find places, manage your calendar, or set reminders. 
- Hand me a PDF, a photo, or a scan and ask about it. 
- Ask for a PDF, a CSV, or an image and I'll create the file.
- I remember what matters from one chat to the next, when you let me. Clear it any time.
► RECORD IT. GET THE NOTES.
- Record a meeting, a lecture, or a thought on a walk. Import an audio or video file, paste a YouTube link, or scan a PDF. I transcribe it perfectly in 58 languages with speaker labels, then turn it into meeting notes, a summary, a checklist, a blog post, an essay, or a translation. Everything lands in your Library, next to your notes, where you can ask me about any of it.
- Write notes in Markdown with headings, checklists, tables, and images. Dictate into them. Export as PDF, DOCX, Markdown, and more.
► ON YOUR WATCH AND YOUR MAC
Ask me from your wrist, record voice notes, or dictate on Apple Watch straight into your iPhone keyboard or your Mac with Auri Voice. The Auri app on Mac carries your chats and Library. Words you add once follow you across every device.
► YOUR WORDS STAY YOURS
I'm privacy-first by design. I don't collect what you type or say. I never appear in password or card fields. Notes and chats are encrypted in your own iCloud, requests carry no personal identifiers, and nothing is used to train AI models. Your calendar, mail, location, and Health are read only when you allow it, and only for the request you made.
► UPGRADE TO PRO WHEN YOU WANT NO LIMITS.
Auri gives you the full keyboard with 83 languages, swipe typing, dictation, writing tools (writing, translation, paraphrasing, grammar check), chat (Fast, Reasoning, Visual), and state-of-the-art transcription, counted by minutes and daily uses. Auri Pro stops counting and unlocks unlimited usage, adds every keyboard theme, layout, and every translation language. One subscription for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Questions? Write to me at hi@auri.ai or open Need Help in Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://auri.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://auri.ai/terms

bluejetty:00127211:ios.name: FS Golf
bluejetty:00127211:ios.summary: Improve your game and bring your practice to a new level with the FlightScope Golf mobile app. Pair your device with a FlightScope radar to record training sessions providing accurate data and automatically trimmed video. FS Golf provides v
bluejetty:00127211:ios.description:
Improve your game and bring your practice to a new level with the FlightScope Golf mobile app. Pair your device with a FlightScope radar to record training sessions providing accurate data and automatically trimmed video. FS Golf provides various ways of displaying data so you can choose your favourite and focus solely on aspects you want to improve.
Designed for players of all skill levels, from professionals to beginners, in order to enhance their training sessions. Hone your skills with purpose by using Data Margins – choose parameters and pick their minimal and maximum values to get visual feedback when your shot meets set requirements.
Record your sessions assisted by the FS Golf app on your Apple Watch. You can choose out of six different layouts to display selected parameters of recorded shots. Use your device to review shots and easily change clubs without stopping the session or reaching out for your smartphone. Our Apple Watch app also allows you to check the radar’s status so you will always know when it is ready for the next shot.
Features:
Recording videos with customizable data overlay – choose displayed parameters and put them in an order that suits you.
3D trajectory, top and side views – analyze your shot trajectories from different angles and perspectives.
Grouping shots – review shots grouped by the club you have used.
Data Margins – you can assign margins to any parameter or set of parameters. Results are highlighted green when they are within those values or red when they are outside the scope.
Social Media – share your recorded videos with a customizable data blocks overlay.
Apple Watch – choose one out of six layouts and display selected parameters instantly on your smartwatch, review your shots, switch clubs quickly and easily, and check when the radar is ready for the next shot, all on your wrist.
Compatible with radar models: Mevo+, X3, Xi Series, X2, and X2 Elite.
Parameters for Mevo+ : Carry Distance, Club Head Speed, Ball Speed, Vertical Launch Angle, Spin Rate, Smash Factor, Apex Height, Angle of Attack, Spin Loft, Horizontal Launch Angle, Spin Axis, Roll Distance, Lateral, Shot Type.
Additional parameters for the X3: Club Path, Face to Path, Face to Target, Dynamic Loft, Vertical Descent Angle, Vertical Swing Plane, Horizontal Swing Plane, Low Point, Curve.
Additional parameters for Xi Series, X2, and X2 Elite: Club Path, Face to Path, Face to Target, Dynamic Loft, Vertical Descent Angle, Vertical Swing Plane, Horizontal Swing Plane, Low Point.
Please note: In order to function properly, this app requires to be connected to the FlightScope radar device: Mevo+, X3, Xi, Xi+, Xi Tour, X2, or X2 Elite. You can order your X3 or Mevo+ unit at www.FlightScope.com or www.FlightScopeMevo.com
This version requires an iPhone supporting the two latest versions of iOS and watchOS 5.0 or later. The HealthKit is only used to run the FS Golf app on the Apple Watch. The app will collect your health data with each shot.

- Weekly and monthly timesheet.
- PDF invoices to send to customers. 
- Earnings reports.
- Calendar to map your daily earning for each month.
- Billing and payment tracking.
- Configurable overtime and break time for time tracking.
- Export data as CSV.
- Sync data between all your devices.
- Passcode protection.
