bluejetty:00127960:ios.description:
Rummy Card Game Classic — play Straight Rummy offline.
No internet required. No sign-up. Just a clean, classic Rummy card game focused on sets, runs, discards, and smart hand planning.
Rummy Card Game Classic is based on Straight Rummy: draw cards, make melds, lay off where you can, discard carefully, and try to empty your hand before your opponents.
Why you’ll like Rummy Card Game Classic
• Offline play — no internet required
• No account / no sign-up
• Play against computer players
• Choose from two, three, or four-player games
• Difficulty options: Easy, Medium, or Hard
• Make sets and runs
• Lay off cards to reduce your deadwood
• Custom rules including stock reset, Block Rummy, meld-before-layoff, and Rummy Bonus
• Win targets: 100, 200, or 500
• Stats tracking
• Hand replays
• Speed options, themes, deck designs, card faces, and suit color options
Classic Straight Rummy gameplay
The goal is simple: form melds and go out first.
A meld can be:
• A set — cards of the same rank, such as three 7s
• A run — cards in sequence in the same suit, such as 5, 6, 7 of hearts
On your turn, draw from the stock or discard pile, meld or lay off cards when you can, then discard. Empty your hand to win the round and score points from the cards left in your opponents’ hands.
Choose your rules
Customize the game to play your way:
• Stock reset — reset, shuffle, or Block Rummy
• Rummy Bonus — score double when you get rid of all your cards in one turn
• Meld before laying off — require players to make a meld before laying off to table melds
• Win target — play to 100, 200, or 500
• Number of players — choose two, three, or four players
• AI level — Easy, Medium, or Hard
Review and replay hands
Track your results with built-in stats, then replay previous hands to review key moments and improve your play.
Comfortable card play
Choose your preferred speed, card face, deck design, table theme, mobile card layout, and suit color palette. Play with standard two-color suits or four-color suit palettes for improved readability.
Play Rummy anytime
Rummy Card Game Classic is designed for relaxed offline play. No internet. No sign-up. No waiting for other players. Just open the app and play.

bluejetty:00069819:ios.description:
Seus investimentos ficam bem mais alinhados aos seus sonhos e objetivos quando você usa o Kinvo.
De um jeitinho fácil, prático e intuitivo, você consegue acompanhar investimentos num só lugar, organizá-los em múltiplas carteiras por estratégias ou objetivos, definir metas, ver a rentabilidade, compará-los a benchmarks e analisar cada detalhe de renda fixa e renda variável com ferramentas exclusivas.
Pra acompanhar investimentos com mais facilidade, importe-os usando as conexões B3 (bolsa de valores), BTG Pactual, Itaú, XP, Órama, entre outras.
E se seus investimentos pagam dividendos, veja aquela grana extra caindo na sua conta com previsibilidade e receba notificação a cada pagamento com a análise de proventos.
-
Conexões e cadastro manual:
Com a conexão B3, é possível importar e acompanhar seus investimentos em renda variável, como suas ações da Bovespa e também Tesouro Direto. Nas demais conexões, como BTG Pactual e outras, também é possível importar renda fixa e renda variável.
Sempre que precisar, também dá pra cadastrar renda fixa e variável manualmente. Assim, é possível até acompanhar investimentos personalizados, como imóveis, gado, moedas, terrenos e muito mais.
-
Rentabilidade:
Será que seus investimentos ganham do CDI, IPCA, IFIX, IBOV e poupança? Veja e compare a rentabilidade da renda fixa, como Tesouro Direto, CDB, LCI, LCA, e de renda variável, como ações, FIIs, ETFs, BDRs, criptos, investimentos americanos e até imóveis e muito mais. Tenha autonomia para transformar seus investimentos em realização de objetivos.
-
Proventos:
Tá planejando viver de renda passiva com seus dividendos? Quem sabe usar seus proventos pra reinvestir ou comprar uma casa, carro, viajar? Seja lá qual for o destino dos seus proventos, no Kinvo é possível acompanhar a agenda de pagamento de dividendos, JCP e rendimentos e ser notificado sempre quando eles forem pagos. Prático, né?
-
Ações em tempo real:
Além de importar suas ações da Bovespa e Tesouro Direto com facilidade usando a conexão B3, também é possível ver as ações em tempo real, além de FIIs, BDRs e ETFs, e saber na hora se vão bem ou mal com o Kinvo Trade.
Poder acompanhar investimentos, como ações, em tempo real é essencial – afinal, o timing perfeito pra compra e venda otimiza muito os seus ganhos e evita prejuízos.
-
Analise cada detalhe de renda fixa e variável, seja CDB, LCI, LCA, Tesouro Direto, ações, FIIs, ETFs, BDRs, criptos e outras categorias. Assim, você sempre sabe quando é preciso fazer ajustes pra melhorar a performance.

— Saiba o poder de compra dos seus investimentos frente à inflação;
— Acompanhe o calendário dos seus proventos;
— Analise o Risco x Retorno da carteira e de investimentos individualizados;
— Saiba quais são os ativos mais agressivos e defensivos em Sensibilidade de Ativos;
— Compare seus investimentos aos principais benchmarks no Comparador de Ativos;

bluejetty:00087570:ios.name: #blockit: Block Shorts & Reels
bluejetty:00087570:ios.summary:
Keep the good, block the bad. #blockit removes Shorts, Reels and endless feeds from popular websites on Safari, and leaves everything else exactly where it was.
No account. No built-in browser to log into. Nothing sent to any server, ever.
bluejetty:00087570:ios.description:
Keep the good, block the bad. #blockit removes Shorts, Reels and endless feeds from popular websites on Safari, and leaves everything else exactly where it was.
No account. No built-in browser to log into. Nothing sent to any server, ever.
And a 7 day free trial to see the difference yourself.
No VC funding or growth team here. #blockit is built by one indie developer, and has been quietly maintained since 2020 as the sites keep changing.
WHAT GETS BLOCKED
• Shorts, Reels and short-form feeds
• Endless home feeds and suggested content
• Explore pages, related videos, comments if you want
• Entire websites by URL
Your call, per site, with simple switches.
WHAT YOU KEEP
• Everything else
• Search, messages, and notifications
• The profiles and pages you actually meant to visit
All in your normal Safari, logged in as yourself, with nothing sitting in between.
WORKS ON
• YouTube.com: block Shorts, home recommendations, related videos, comments, end screens, even the subscriptions feed
• Instagram.com: block Reels, Stories, Explore, suggested posts, or the whole feed
• Facebook.com: block the news feed, Stories, Reels, Marketplace, and Groups
• Reddit.com: block the home feed, subreddit feeds, or comments
• X.com: block For You, Following, Explore, even notifications
• LinkedIn.com: block the home feed
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
#blockit is a pure Safari content blocker, a technology Apple designed so it cannot read or transmit anything from the pages you visit. Don't take our word for it: enable #blockit in Settings and Apple itself confirms "#blockit" does not have permission to read or transmit content from any web pages.
ONE SUBSCRIPTION, EVERY DEVICE
iPhone, iPad and Mac, with iCloud sync keeping every setting and blocked site in step. Set it up once, covered everywhere.
NOTE
#blockit uses Apple Safari Content Blocker technology, and can only remove certain parts of certain websites you browse via the Safari app.
Take back your attention. Just #blockit
– Jordi, developer of #blockit
TERMS OF USE
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00153607:ios.summary:
Catch and Feed – Dive into the addictive underwater fishing adventure!
Have you ever had fish on your brain, but couldn’t visit your favorite lake or river? Catch and Feed brings the thrill of the hunt and the fun of feeding to your mobile
bluejetty:00153607:ios.description:
Catch and Feed – Dive into the addictive underwater fishing adventure!
Have you ever had fish on your brain, but couldn’t visit your favorite lake or river? Catch and Feed brings the thrill of the hunt and the fun of feeding to your mobile device in one relaxing yet action-packed fishing game.
Cast your hook into deep waters—explore rivers, lakes, and oceans to catch fish, from tiny goldfish to mighty piranhas and even sharks! Whether you're into casual fishing or consider yourself a fishing master, this underwater journey will keep you coming back for more.
Catch, reel in, and collect a wide range of fish species. Use your fishing rod, net, or hook & bait to fill your boat with fresh catch. But your mission doesn’t end there—hungry sea creatures are waiting! Prepare the fish and feed them in a satisfying loop of action and strategy.
Features:
Relaxing underwater gameplay with lifelike fish behavior
Explore lake, river, sea, and ocean locations
Catch rare fish like piranhas and sharks
Upgrade your hook, rod, boat, and bait
Feed unique sea creatures and deep-sea dwellers
Simple controls and soothing visuals
Great for fans of fishing and exploration games
Whether you're floating on a boat or diving deep, Catch and Feed blends calm fishing moments with fun fish-feeding challenges in a charming underwater world.
Play and experience the relaxing loop of catch, prepare, and feed beneath the waves!
For support or suggestions, contact us at gamewayfu@wayfustudio.com.

Painless Organization Chart Creation - Simplify the maintenance, presentation, synchronization and sharing of organizational charts without having to deal with complicated drawings - OrgChart helps you render the shapes and place them in the right place automatically.
** NO DRAWING HASSLES **
With OrgChart, you don't have to waste time drawing shapes and connecting lines. OrgChart does it for you automatically. Just enter an element and customize its color, shape, size, text, and layout. OrgChart gives you an INTUITIVE and user-friendly interface to manage your org charts.
** TREE structure ONLY **
OrgChart is THE easy-to-use organizational chart app for iPad. Visualize, maintain and simplify organizational elements in a TREE structure.
## PRIVACY FOCUSED
Your projects are stored on your device or in iCloud Drive, as you prefer.
## PRODUCTIVITY FOCUSED
* Image, MS Excel and PDF export with options to customize the content.
* Organizational charts can be synced between iOS and macOS devices via iCloud Drive. They can be shared as standalone files to other devices.
* OrgChart supports sending people data directly to QuickPlan (https://itunes.apple.com/app/id621375878) as a project member.
* Import from iOS contacts AND makes entering organization items easier, faster and more efficient.
OrgChart is an innovative app that turns COMPLEXITY INTO SIMPLICITY.
## EFFICIENT MAINTENANCE
- You do not need to draw manually anymore - you just need to set the visual styles of the elements.
- Natural gestures to arrange parts, change element hierarchy, order, zoom, collapse, expand.
- Bulk adding and importing iOS contacts.
- The smoothest org chart app on a clean user interface.
- Apply one visual style to all children.
- In a clean user interface.
## STRONG MAINTENANCE
- Multiple org charts organized in tile groups.
- Maintain org charts in outline and diagram view.
- Duplicate and import org charts.
- Import an organizational unit from an iOS contact.
- Batch input of organizational units.
- Update unit properties - photo, unit name, job title, leader, phone, email, notes.
- View organizational charts in color or black and white.
- UNDO support.
- Copy/paste support.
- User interface customization options.
## FLEXIBILITY
- Customization of title and visibility of department fields.
- Visibility of department fields.
- Color of department entries.
- Nine layouts (customize where to place sub-items).
- Eight shapes.
- Size.
- Three line styles.
## INTUITIVE
- Pinch to zoom
- Double tap to edit unit properties.
- Long press to display the function menu.
- Swipe left/right to change hierarchy.
- Press and hold and swipe up/down to change the order and switch between groups.
- Tap with two fingers to collapse/expand all groups together.
## REPORT
- Export a full or partial org chart as an image, Excel, and PDF file (with PDF export options for PDF page size and zoom).
- Export in color or black and white (automatic adjustment to current display color).
## SYNCHRONIZATION
- Sync org charts between iOS and Mac devices via iCloud Drive.
## SHARE
- Export org charts as .org files for sharing.
- Share via email, airdrop, and third-party cloud apps.
OrgChart is the best and only useful org chart app for Apple devices.
## USE CASES
- Create an org chart for communication and presentation.
- An option to manage personal contacts in a tree structure.
- Change visual styles of existing org charts IN SECONDS, for different communication purposes.
- Export a portion of a large org chart for presentation purposes.
- Clean up the organization charts of customers and vendors.
- Create a project team / new department / team.
- Keep track of basic information of people in your team.

bluejetty:00186328:ios.description:
***** Parents‘ Choice Awards’ winner 
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
***** APProved by Famigo!!! 
Lay the basics of your child’s literacy skills with this colorful, mysterious island full of phonics sounds. Children learn and have fun tracing letters, recognizing letter sounds, matching letters, and identifying beginning sounds. Embark on the adventure with adorable Abby the Monkey and her train to discover the secret of this island! 
================== 
The best introduction to phonics reading system! 
================== 
* NOW EVEN BETTER — FABULOUS NEW ACTIVITIES ADDED! 
CHILDREN LEARN TO: 
* Recognize letter sounds 
* Trace uppercase and lowercase letters 
* Match letters 
* Recognize a variety of animals 
* Identify beginning sounds 
PURCHASING THIS APPLICATION (FULL VERSION ONLY), YOU CAN EXPECT TO GET: 
----- 
* 90 animal pictures situated in colorful sceneries, accompanied by authentic animal sounds and phonetic sounds of the animals’ initial letters 
* 21 wonderful, professionally illustrated sceneries 
* 7 alphabet phonetic sectors divided according to the Montessori methodology 
* A series of fun mini-games 
* Reward stickers 
* Surprise upon completion of all levels 
* Easy-to-use, child-friendly interface 
* High-quality audio spoken by a professional voice-over actress 
* Friendly, encouraging environment 
----- 
Hello everyone! Are you up to an adventure? I am Abby the Monkey, the friend you know from a highly-successful application series by 22learn, and I have prepared one for you! If you want to EXPLORE a strange animal island and LEARN PHONETIC LETTER SOUNDS, you shouldn’t wait a minute, and come with me!!! 
But first let me tell you a story…. 
****************************************** 
Once upon a time, there was an island, an island of indescribable beauty and magnificence. There found a shelter the animals small and large, slimy and furry, savage and tame—all protected from evil hunters and curious eyes, supplied with food from the bountiful earth. Each year, a special event was held, when one, and only one, person from the whole humankind was selected and transported to the island (blinded, to preserve the island’s secrecy) to appreciate its beauty and spread the word about it, so that the island would never be forgotten. 
The legend has it, that deep inside the rocky hill on the island, a treasure is kept. Yet, no one knows its secret anymore because the last humankind representative had enraged the animals on the island, and since then, the animals decided never to invite anyone again, and the island got lost in time and space. 
All that remains from our knowledge is that through the whole island, a very special train goes. The train has a mind of its own and likes it when the passengers’ names start from certain sounds! It is said, that if someone was ever capable to fulfill all the train’s wishes, the train would transport the lucky being deep inside the rocks and reveal the island’s precious treasure! 
****************************************** 
But, you are asking, what does all this have to do with me, monkey Abby? Well, imagine what happened to me just recently! I was flying around with my plane when, out of the blue, the storm hit and my plane got lost! 
And now, I am on this weird island that looks exactly like the legendary Phonics Island I told you about! Wohoo, how exciting! But I need someone to help me with all the strange tasks the train asks me to do! Do you want to be the one who will help me, and discover the island’s treasure together with me? 
Thank you for your purchase!

bluejetty:00126656:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00126656:ios.description:
Write your first book, one day at a time.
Learn how to write a book with a simple step-by-step course, then write it right here in the built-in writing tool. Build a daily writing habit, keep your chapters organized, and export your finished manuscript to Word or PDF.
More than 50,000 aspiring authors have downloaded this app to start their book.
If you dream of writing a book even a bestselling book, you’re in the right place!
This is a structured simple and clear program that will guide you through the writing process. We break down the process so that anyone will have the opportunity to write a book. We will show you how to make sure it is a good book, with a good plot, good structure, and good writing.
Here you’ll learn 10 simple lessons to write a book plus an additional 10 bonus tips, a guide on how to find a publisher for your book, how to stay motivated when you write a book and more.
The lesson of this “how to write a book?” program:
* Phase 1 of writing a book - Getting started
Decide what the book is about - Great book writing is constantly referring to something. Write the conflict of your book in a sentence
Build a storyboard for your plot, decide on a book maker or a book creator software.
Set a daily word count goal - A page a day is just about 300 words. You do not need to write a whole lot.
Set a time to work on your book writing every day- Uniformity makes creativity and imagination a whole lot easier.
Set the same place every time when you write a book
* Phase 2 of writing a book: Doing the work
Set a total word count
Give yourself weekly deadlines
Get early feedback - Nothing hurts even worse than writing a publication and after that needing to have to rewrite it since you didn't allow no one has a look at it.
* Phase 3 of writing a book: Finishing
Exactly how do you know when you're done? Short answer: you don't. Not really. So below is what you do to end this book-writing procedure well
Commit to shipping - Finish the book at all costs. Set a deadline or have actually one being set for you
Embrace failure - As you approach the completion of this task, understand that this will be difficult as well as you will certainly definitely mess up
* The reason most people never finish their books
Every year, millions of books go unfinished. Books that could have helped people, brought beauty or wisdom into the world. But they never came to be. And in one way or another, the reason is always the same: the author quit. We will show you how you can avoid it and finish writing the book.
* 10 book writing tips
When you write a book you need sometimes help to stay motivated, we have 10 tips to help you keep going in the process.
* How to Get Your Book Published
OK, you finished writing a book, you are an author! now, If you want to get your book published, you have more choices than ever to accomplish your goal, and the path can be confusing if you’re new to the publishing industry. This lesson lays out the process in the simplest terms possible.
There are three primary paths to getting published:
Land a traditional publisher who will offer you a book contract.
Self-publish by the author: self publishing may be harder to do but you'll earn more for every book you sell.
WRITE YOUR BOOK IN THE APP
- Write chapter by chapter: add, rename, reorder and mark chapters as done
- Daily writing streak: write 50 words a day to keep it going, with one rest day a week
- Daily word goal from 100 to 1,000 words, with a progress ring
- Set a target for your whole book (short story, novella or novel) and track it
- Stuck? Get one of 40 writing prompts to start the words flowing
- Export to Word (.docx), PDF or plain text, or read your book in a clean reading view
- Never lose a word: everything saves automatically, plus backups and Recently deleted
So... are you ready to make a dream come true?
Download now!
Privacy Policy: http://better-courses.com/privacypolicy/
Terms of Service: http://better-courses.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00158318:ios.description:
אפליקציית ערוץ הספורט:
אפליקציית הספורט המובילה בישראל מתעדכנת עם שידורים חיים בכל יום, תקצירים, כתבות, מאמרים, טבלאות ותוצאות.
סיקור נרחב של ליגת האלופות, ליגת העל בכדורגל, NBA, מכבי תל אביב ביורוליג, ליגת ווינר סל וכל מה שמעניין בספורט.
בואו לצפות בתקצירים חינם ולהתעדכן בזמן אמת בתוצאות משחקים.
באפליקציה מספר אזורים:
ראשי: כתבות במגוון נושאים: כדורגל עולמי, כדורגל ישראלי, כדורסל, טורים ודעות, טניס וענפים נוספים.
רדיו: שידורים חיים מידי יום של תוכניות הרדיו של ערוץ הספורט, משחקים ופודקאסטים בשלל נושאים. 
ליגת החלומות ופנטזי ליג: משחק הכדורגל הווירטואלי שמאפשר לכם להרכיב, לנהל ולאמן קבוצת כדורגל מתוך מאגר שחקני כל הקבוצות המשתתפות בליגת העל בכדורגל ובליגת האלופות.
וידאו: עולם VOD עשיר וחינמי עם כל התקצירים וכל תוכניות ערוץ הספורט האהובות.
תוצאות בזמן אמת: תוצאות ונתונים בזמן אמת ממשחקי כדורגל, כדורסל, טניס ועוד - מישראל והעולם.
הקבוצה שלי: החדשות, התוצאות, הסגלים, ההיסטוריה וכל מה שמעניין על קבוצתכם האהודה.
5 חבר'ה: משחק הניחושים של ערוץ הספורט בו תוכלו לנחש את תוצאות המשחקים ולהתחרות בחבריכם.
עוד באפליקציה: סקרים, חידונים, משחקים ושלל פעילויות.

bluejetty:00099061:ios.description:
The Destination Cleveland Mobile App has returned as your go-to trip planning resource. A complement to our website, new functionality makes it even easier to find your way around The Land and plan a trip filled with our greatest hits, hidden gems and everything in between, all in a world-class city that doesn’t take itself too seriously.
Features:
 • Our trip planner helps you figure out where to stay, what to see and where to eat. 
 • Create your own personalized, single- or multi-day tour of The Land, then share it with friends and on social media.
 • Or, choose one of the ready-made Cleveland itineraries curated by our friendly, knowledgeable staff.
 • Explore Cleveland through curated passports, earning achievements and prizes as you check in.
 • Discover things to do, where to eat and all the must-visit spots only locals know.
 • Explore an event calendar filled with concerts, sports, festivals, family activities and other uniquely Cleveland events you won’t find anywhere else.

bluejetty:00175331:ios.description:
Follow the Truth!
What exactly is Truth Social's "Big Tent" approach?
Think of a giant outdoor event tent at your best friend's wedding. Who's there? The combination of multiple families from all over the United States, and the world. Uncle Jim from Atlanta is a proud libertarian. Aunt Kellie from Texas is a staunch conservative. Your cousin John from California is a die-hard liberal. And guess what? They're all together to have an amazing time and share their different viewpoints on the world. Although we don't always agree with each other, we welcome these varied opinions and the robust conversation they bring.
Let your voice be heard. Sign up, join the conversation, and share your unique opinion by posting a Truth, Re-Truth, photo, news story, or video link to communicate with your friends, customers, and the world. Stay informed about breaking news while staying directly connected with the people who influence you – don't be shocked if they take your Truth viral!
Key Features
Profile - Express your unique personality by setting up a profile, avatar, and background. Begin to track your personal connections through follower and following counts as well as history for your posts and likes.
Truth Feed - Get the scoop on the latest thoughts and activities from the people, organizations, and news outlets that interest you. The Truth Feed contains posts from all those you follow brought to life with the help of thumbnail photos, links, and more.
Search - Truth Social really starts to become interesting as you connect with others. Search for a voice that you find interesting and easily follow them right from the search list or view their profile first before deciding.
Notifications - Stay engaged as you build a following. See who's following you and who's interacting with your Truth's.

bluejetty:00080577:android.name: Goods Triple Sort: Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00080577:android.summary: 🎁 Love organizing and matching games? Goods Triple Sort offers a relaxing and satisfying match-3 experience with a unique 3D twist! Simply sort identical goods on rotating shelves to complete triple matches and enjoy the fun of item organiz
bluejetty:00080577:android.description:
🎁 Love organizing and matching games? Goods Triple Sort offers a relaxing and satisfying match-3 experience with a unique 3D twist! Simply sort identical goods on rotating shelves to complete triple matches and enjoy the fun of item organization.
With its simple controls and satisfying gameplay, Goods Triple Sort delivers a calming yet mentally engaging experience. As you drag and match goods—from colorful snacks to vibrant drinks—you'll find yourself immersed in a soothing puzzle journey that sharpens focus and relieves stress.
Each level brings new triple-match challenges, gradually increasing in complexity to keep you engaged. Whether you're looking for a quick mental break or an addictive puzzle experience, the variety of items and rotating shelves ensure every session feels fresh and fun. Designed for all player types, you can easily pick it up and enjoy anytime, anywhere.
✨ How to play ✨
- Swap and sort adjacent goods items to achieve a match 3 result and earn points.
- Continuous triple matching will trigger combos, earning you higher scores.
- Use game props strategically, and they will efficiently assist you in completing the goods sort and triple matching.
- The shelves are divided into inner and outer layers; strategic triple matching will help you complete levels more quickly in 3D goods sorting.
- When all the items on the shelves have been matched and cleared, you will win and unlock a new 3D goods sort puzzle.
- After each goods triple match completion, you will receive stars and coins, which can improve your ranking and allow you to purchase more items.
✨ Game Features ✨
- More than 1,000 interesting 3D triple match designs.
- Upbeat soundtrack and sound effects for an immersive experience.
- The unique scrolling shelf mode enriches the experience of match 3 games. - Endless fun for players of all ages.
- A game interface that immerses you in the goods sorting world.
- Powerful boosters to help you complete the triple matching.
- Cool boosters animation, gives you a comfortable puzzle experience.
- Daily goods sorting challenge. 
- Personal statistics data.
- No network is needed! Play 3D sorting puzzles offline anytime, anywhere.
🚀 Goods Triple Sort is more than just a puzzle game—it’s a relaxing escape and a mental workout rolled into one. As you master each level, you’ll develop sharper thinking and faster reflexes while enjoying a peaceful, rewarding gameplay experience.
Whether you're a casual puzzler or a match-3 master, Goods Triple Sort offers endless sorting fun and rewarding challenges. Are you ready to climb the leaderboard and become a true goods triple match expert?
💌 Questions or feedback? Contact us anytime: tsanglouis58@gmail.com. Your input helps shape the future of Goods Triple Sort—we're always listening!

listings.name: Goods Triple Sort: Puzzle Game
listings.description:
🎁 Love organizing and matching games? Goods Triple Sort offers a relaxing and satisfying match-3 experience with a unique 3D twist! Simply sort identical goods on rotating shelves to complete triple matches and enjoy the fun of item organization.

With its simple controls and satisfying gameplay, Goods Triple Sort delivers a calming yet mentally engaging experience. As you drag and match goods—from colorful snacks to vibrant drinks—you'll find yourself immersed in a soothing puzzle journey that sharpens focus and relieves stress.

Each level brings new triple-match challenges, gradually increasing in complexity to keep you engaged. Whether you're looking for a quick mental break or an addictive puzzle experience, the variety of items and rotating shelves ensure every session feels fresh and fun. Designed for all player types, you can easily pick it up and enjoy anytime, anywhere.

✨ How to play ✨
- Swap and sort adjacent goods items to achieve a match 3 result and earn points.
- Continuous triple matching will trigger combos, earning you higher scores.
- Use game props strategically, and they will efficiently assist you in completing the goods sort and triple matching.
- The shelves are divided into inner and outer layers; strategic triple matching will help you complete levels more quickly in 3D goods sorting.
- When all the items on the shelves have been matched and cleared, you will win and unlock a new 3D goods sort puzzle.
- After each goods triple match completion, you will receive stars and coins, which can improve your ranking and allow you to purchase more items.

✨ Game Features ✨
- More than 1,000 interesting 3D triple match designs.
- Upbeat soundtrack and sound effects for an immersive experience.
- The unique scrolling shelf mode enriches the experience of match 3 games. - Endless fun for players of all ages.
- A game interface that immerses you in the goods sorting world.
- Powerful boosters to help you complete the triple matching.
- Cool boosters animation, gives you a comfortable puzzle experience.
- Daily goods sorting challenge. 
- Personal statistics data.
- No network is needed! Play 3D sorting puzzles offline anytime, anywhere.

🚀 Goods Triple Sort is more than just a puzzle game—it’s a relaxing escape and a mental workout rolled into one. As you master each level, you’ll develop sharper thinking and faster reflexes while enjoying a peaceful, rewarding gameplay experience.

Whether you're a casual puzzler or a match-3 master, Goods Triple Sort offers endless sorting fun and rewarding challenges. Are you ready to climb the leaderboard and become a true goods triple match expert?

💌 Questions or feedback? Contact us anytime: tsanglouis58@gmail.com. Your input helps shape the future of Goods Triple Sort—we're always listening!

Die BR24-App versorgt Sie immer mit den wichtigsten Nachrichten.
Unsere App-Angebote:
TOPTHEMEN AUS BAYERN & DER WELT:
HIER IST BAYERN! Mit BR24. Alles, was Bayern, Deutschland und die Welt bewegt. In den BR24-Topstorys lesen Sie, was gerade wichtig ist. Breaking News? Wir informieren Sie schnellstmöglich mit einer Push-Benachrichtigung. Und liefern Ihnen Faktenchecks, Recherchen, Erklärungen und Hintergründe aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport, Wissen, Kultur und der Netzwelt. Als Artikel und im Video. Mit BR24live verpassen Sie keine wichtigen Ereignisse, Neuigkeiten oder Sport-Events. Sie wollen auf dem neuesten Stand bleiben? Unsere Liveticker versorgen Sie mit brandaktuellen News. Wir berichten auch über Sport-Highlights wie die Fußball-Bundesliga, EM oder Olympia. Mit der BR24-App sind Sie immer ganz nah dran am Geschehen.
REGIONALE NACHRICHTEN & HINTERGRÜNDE:
Erfahren Sie unter „Bayern“ alle Neuigkeiten und Informationen aus Ihrer Region: Mittelfranken, Oberfranken, Unterfranken, Niederbayern, Oberpfalz, Schwaben und Oberbayern. Mit unserer Regio-Push erhalten Sie News und Live-Streams aus Ihrer Umgebung.
RADIO/TV
Der Hauptmenüpunkt "Radio/TV" bündelt die multimedialen Inhalte von BR24 auf einen Blick:
- BR24 100 Sekunden: Nachrichtenvideos
- BR24 TV: Die aktuelle Nachrichtensendung von BR24
- BR24 Radio: Aktuelle Nachrichten zum Anhören
- Regional, bayernweit, weltweit
MELDUNGEN:
Hier lesen Sie die neusten Kurz-Nachrichten – kompakt und übersichtlich zusammengefasst.
RUBRIKEN:
Tauchen Sie tiefer in Themen aus Wirtschaft, Wissen, Kultur, Netzwelt, und Weltgeschehen ein, immer sachlich und verständlich. BR24 begleitet hier Themen wie die Europawahl 2024, Börsennachrichten, Großereignisse und vieles mehr. Die BR24-Sport-Redaktion versorgt sie mit aktuellen Sport-Nachrichten, Spielanalysen und Livetickern, rund um ihren bayerischen Lieblingsverein.
Und der BR24 #Faktenfuchs geht Fakenews und Falschbehauptungen auf die Spur.
WETTER & VERKEHR:
Nutzen Sie die aktuellen Wetter- und Verkehrsinformationen für Bayern und Ihre Region.
DATENSCHUTZ:
Datenschutz: Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten sehr ernst. Bei uns erfahren Sie transparent, welche Daten wir erheben und wie wir sie verwenden.
Sie haben Fragen oder Verbesserungsvorschläge für die BR24-App? Wir versuchen unser Angebot stetig zu verbessern und freuen uns über Ihr Feedback: feedback@br24.de

bluejetty:00174364:ios.summary:

You own a weather station that submits measurement data to Wunderground.com (WeatherUnderground)? You want to get a quick overview, as well as
bluejetty:00174364:ios.description:
The app for PWS owners and 'Weather Underground' contributors, exclusively for iOS and WatchOS!
You own a weather station that submits measurement data to Wunderground.com (WeatherUnderground)? You want to get a quick overview, as well as detailed diagrams with the readings of your weather station and those of more than 250,000 other weather stations of the Wunderground network?
Then myPWS is exactly the right app for you! All you need is: your personal API key, which will be created in your personal account on Wunderground.com for you to retrieve.
Once you've configured access to Wunderground.com for myPWS by entering your API key, myPWS will let you view the latest readings from your weather station, as well as any other weather station registered on Wunderground.com. You can use an area map to search for near or far weather stations all over the world and have them displayed for detailed diagrams and current readings.
myPWS offers you extensive diagrams with the
• measured values of the current and the previous day
• the last 7 days (per hour / per day)
• any day in the past*
• monthly data*
• yearly data*
• data of two PWS in one single comparison chart*
• combined data of one PWS in a single chart*
• wind direction chart*
Up to two different types of data can be displayed together in a diagram, e.g. to look at temperature and air pressure together in one graph.
Furthermore you can
• cache and export data via iCloud our email to your other devices on which you also use myPWS*. This saves data API calls which are limited to 1,500 per day through Wunderground.com via your API key
• add more than two stations to your station list*
• export diagram data via CSV, PDF or as graphics*
• email - export raw measurement data as provided by Underground
Please note: myPWS requires a Wunderground.com account and a PWS (Personal Weather Station) registered in your account. By registering a PWS you will receive an API key which is needed for the retrieval of data from the Wunderground network by myPWS. The access to PWS measurement data via the Wunderground data server depends on the availability of the WU infrastructure and the WU API services, which are not under the control of the manufacturers of the myPWS app.
* Available as a one-time In App purchase

bluejetty:00175142:ios.description:
With Plantfie, you can identify houseplants, any shrub, herb, flower, tree, or a pesky weed in your garden. Plantfie plant identifier will find the plant in a database of 18 000+ plant species. 
Plantfie provides all-inclusive care for each of your greenies: from a watering reminder and repotting calendar to individual plant help from certified botanists. Free up your time – let Plantfie take care of your plants. 
With more than 100 plant diseases in our database, you can be sure your plant gets the right treatment. 
PLANTFIE FEATURES
► Plant Identifier
What plant is this? Wonder no more. From cactuses and succulents to tundra trees, our plant scanner can recognize flora from all over the world. You’ll know what you’re looking at in a second. 
► Plant Disease Identifier
What’s wrong with my plant? No more guessing. Our fine-tuned disease detector is as precise as the doctor’s eye. Get the correct plant diagnosis and bring your plants back to health. 
► Plant Care Guide and Help
Get a simple but professional care guide for each of your greenies. Learn when to water, prune, fertilize, and mist your plants to make them flourish. 
► Plant Watering Tracker and Reminder
Never forget to water your plant again. Our automatic reminders will let you know when your plant needs a drink. 
► Plant Light Meter Tool
Find a spot with perfect light for your greenie. Point the camera at your plant to learn if it needs to be moved to a brighter or shadier place. 
► Filter Poisonous Species
Worried about your kids or animals getting poisoned by toxic plants? Filter out poisonous species to keep them out of reach of your loved ones. 
► Plant Expert Help
Need professional help from a real botanist? Send a request about your plant issue and get custom recommendations, useful tips, and step-by-step guides from our botanists. 
► Plant Encyclopedia
Learn everything about your favorite plants in our Plant Encyclopedia. It’s engaging and accessible for everyone, regardless of your knowledge of biology.
► Plant Calendar
Schedule plant care and get notifications when it’s time to repot, mist, or fertilize your greenies. Your plants won’t miss out on nutrients anymore. 
► Customized Plant Finder
Looking for a plant for a shady spot? Want a greenie that’s easy to care for? Browse our Plant Encyclopedia with filters turned on to find a plant that matches your needs. 
► Space Sharing
Let your friend take care of your greenies while you’re out of town. With our Space Sharing feature, you can give access to your plant collection to other users. 
Get access to exclusive features and see the difference they make. Give Plantfie a try now!

Easily and safely send money with Zelle, tap and pay using our mobile wallet and instantly access your debit card and credit card if you misplace it or suspect fraud. The MyNCU Mobile App lets you conveniently deposit checks, open accounts, apply for loans, make transfers, and more. Our new quick links in the More menu give you fast access to frequently used features. The new look of our Branch and ATM locator allows for 3D mapping, 360-degree rotations, and street views to make your search easier than ever.

Whether it's saving you a trip to the ATM or taking out the guesswork of divvying up the lunch tab, Zelle is a fast, safe and easy way to send and request money. Funds are sent directly to the recipient's account in a matter of minutes¹, and all you need is the recipient's email address or U.S. mobile phone number.

• Mobile Deposit
Conveniently deposit your checks through the MyNCU Mobile App with the tap of a button.
• Biometric Security
Safely and securely log in using the latest in biometric technology to secure your mobile banking. Access is easy using facial recognition, fingerprints, or a username and password.
• Apply Online
Conveniently apply for accounts or loans through the MyNCU App.
• Bill Pay & Transfers
Easily transfer between accounts and use Bill Pay to make paying bills a breeze.
• Money Management
This easy-to-use personal finance dashboard inside Online Banking and the MyNCU Mobile App gives you access debt payoff calculators and the ability to set and track your financial goals and trends.

bluejetty:00151125:ios.description:
DESCRIPTION
Deccan Chronicle Holdings Limited (DCHL) is the publisher of largest circulated English Newspaper in South India – ‘Deccan Chronicle’ with a circulation of over 1.45 Million Copies per day across Andhra Pradesh, TamilNadu, Karnataka and Kerala with Eleven editions from Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Rajahmundry, Vishakapatnam, Anantapur, Karimnagar, Nellore, Chennai, Coimbatore, Bengaluru and Kochi.
DCHL also publishes ‘Asian Age’, an English daily newspaper in Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, and London; Financial English Daily ‘Financial Chronicle’ out of the Metro Cities of Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore and Chennai; Telugu Daily, weekly, monthly ’Andhra Bhoomi’ in Andhra Pradesh.
Deccan Chronicle’s iPhone App provides you an opportunity to avail the newspaper’s complete insight and also continuously updated articles throughout the world. This app brings the news paper and its content one step closer to the users enabling them to personalize and share their favorite news articles and read it from anywhere for free.
FEATURES
•All content available for free.
•Top News: Latest news as and when they occur from all over the world.
•India: Updated Stories from all over India.
•Cities: News from various cities in Andhra Pradesh, TamilNadu, Karnataka and Kerala.
•Entertainment: Latest movie reviews and updates from Bollywood, Hollywood, Tollywood, Kollywood and more.
•Tabloid: Tabloid stories from Hyderabad, Chennai, Bengaluru and Kochi.
•Science and Technology: Latest updates on gadgets, gaming, space and more.
•Lifestyle: Stories from fashion, health, corporate, stress, pets, books, latest trends, cars and bikes and many more.
•Photo Galleries: Top images of people and events from around the world.
•Columns: Opinion from some of the biggest names in the business of Sports, Arts, Entertainment, Business and Lifestyle. 
•Sunday Chronicle: Sunday’s special supplement from print edition.
•Share: Users can share their favorite stories and pictures through mail or twitter.
•Comment: Users can post comments for any and every story.
•Breaking news: Get Breaking news and other alerts from Deccan Chronicle via push notification.
•Simple and easy navigation.

bluejetty:00122227:ios.description:
The card game of Argentina. 
The objective is to be the first to reach a number of points, which can be 10, 20, 30, or 40. You can play 1 against 1, or play as a team, with two or three players (4 or 6 players in total). For the mode with 6 players, you can choose whether to play head-to-head or not. Each player receives 3 cards. Whoever throws the highest card wins the trick, the best of three wins the round (hand). The points of the winning hand depend on the value of the agreed "cantos", "toques" or "gritos".
• Cantos: "Flor", "Contraflor", "Contraflor al Resto". Toques: "Envido", "Real Envido", "Falta Envido". Gritos: "Truco", "Retruco", "Vale 4".
Value of the cards (from lowest to highest):
• Commons: 4, 5, 6, 7.
• Black Cards: 10, 11, 12.
• Cartas Bravas: 1, 2, 3, 7 of coins, 7 of swords, 1 of clubs, 1 of swords.
• Value of the cards for the envido or the flor: the cards are worth what their number indicates, except for 10, 11, and 12 which are worth zero. With 2 cards of the same suit, 20 points are added.
You can look at your partner's cards by clicking on their card.
Choose whether to play with flor or not!
This online game allows you to play at any time, just by rotating your iPhone or iPad you can enjoy the game vertically or horizontally!
You can find more information on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/jugartrucoargentino
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/

● Play Anywhere, Anytime: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Whether you’re on a boring commute or a cozy night in, your bunny team is always ready for a delivery mission.
Stop scrolling and start swallowing! Download Hole Express today and join the "Tidy" revolution.

bluejetty:00070071:ios.description:
My Moon Phase is the best app for tracking the lunar calendar. It has a sleek dark design which makes it easy to view information such as the current moon cycle, moonrise & moonset times as well as extras such as when the next full moon will be. If you're interested in moon photography, you can also find out when the golden hours and blue hours are so you can take the most beautiful photos.
- View the moon cycle for any date in the future by scrolling on the date bar or by tapping the calendar button!
- Either allow the app to use your current location or manually select a location of your choice to use!
- See how cloudy the sky is expected to be on upcoming days so you can work out whether you'll be able to see the moon or not!
- Find the upcoming moon phases straight on the main screen - you'll instantly know when the next full moon, new moon, first quarter and last quarter are.
- Golden hour and blue hour times are available to allow you to calculate when to take photos.
- More specific information is available such as the moon's distance from Earth, the age of the moon as well as the current altitude. This is available for any date on the lunar calendar.
- Receive notifications when the moon reaches a particular phase of your choice.
- Optimized for the latest iPhone and iPad models.
- Completely free of charge for all functionality, no in-app purchases.
If you want the most efficient way of keeping up with the lunar calendar and the current moon phases, then My Moon Phase is the right app for you. This version is ad-supported and is similar to apps such as Deluxe Moon Pro and MoonX.

bluejetty:00179867:ios.description:
Welcome to Keiki World — the ultimate learning app for toddlers and kids aged 2-6+ that transforms playtime into powerful early learning experiences. Keiki World is 100% ad-free, kidSAFE Certified, and a Mom’s Choice Award winner
Approved by early-learning experts, Keiki World meets the specific developmental needs of toddlers and preschoolers — helping parents raise future-ready learners who master preschool basics while also developing creativity, problem-solving skills, and the confidence to figure things out.
Flash cards, colorful worksheets, toddler games, interactive cartoons, and more essential activities for your little one. Trusted by families in more than 170 countries, Keiki 
World offers over 1,500 interactive activities and 500+ printables, developing vital skills, including:
- ABC tracing & spelling
- Speech & Communication
- Counting ability 
- Color & shape recognition 
- Hand-eye coordination 
- Fine motor skills 
- Logical thinking 
- Problem solving 
- Creativity 
- Self-confidence and cooperation
- Attentiveness & alertness
Keiki World is 100% ad-free, kidSAFE Certified, and a Mom’s Choice Award winner.
Keiki World Approach
Daily consistent learning – Short, interactive sessions fit naturally into everyday family life, building steady progress and curiosity.
Future-ready skills – Every game nurtures early academics, creativity, critical thinking, communication, and emotional intelligence to prepare kids for school and for life
Screen-free practice – More than 500 printables, worksheets, and hands-on activities extend learning into real-world family moments.
Expert-Crafted
Expert-designed curriculum – Developed by educators and child-development specialists to support each stage of growth and confidence.
Keiki World Interactive Activities
Make your kid’s screen time fun and meaningful with games and activities like:
- ABC Puzzles – Train letter recognition & phonics with drag-and-drop puzzles.
- Trace Letters – Practice writing in a cosmic interface that builds focus and fine-motor skills.
- Memory Cards – Find pairs and boost memory on topics from ABC to animals and colors.
- Jigsaw Puzzles – Assemble images to learn shapes, imagination, and logical thinking.
- Fill the Gaps – Match objects by shape and color to strengthen attention and logic.
- Funny Kids Songs – Learn letters, numbers, animals, and phonics through music.
Plus: Educational Cartoons, Sorting, Cooking — and even more!
Worksheets & Offline Learning
Over 500 printables and skill-based worksheets, organized by topic, provide more than 400 hours of purposeful learning. They include: Writing, Speech & Language, Math, Logic, Creativity, Dinosaurs, and Useful Tips for Parents. Each one is designed to nurture curiosity, independence, and a lifelong love of learning.
Your child can learn colors, numbers, letters, animals, drawing, and much more — all in one app!
Subscription Details
- Once the free Keiki World trial period is over, users are automatically charged the price specified in the app.
- Auto-renewal option can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. You can cancel your subscription at any time, but please do so at least 24 hours before the end date of the current period.
- Your ideas, opinions, and suggestions are welcome at support@keiki.app. Feel free to contact us if you need help with any app-related
Privacy Policy: https://bit.ly/3EV70Xw
Terms of Use: https://bit.ly/3ibVRrJ
Sincerely yours, Keiki Team

bluejetty:00063646:ios.summary: The world's live music, in your pocket. Stream the Internet Archive's massive collection of concert recordings, plus a huge archive of live Phish shows from Phish.in. Thousands of artists from the 1960s to today: Grateful Dead, Billy String
bluejetty:00063646:ios.description:
The world's live music, in your pocket. Stream the Internet Archive's massive collection of concert recordings, plus a huge archive of live Phish shows from Phish.in. Thousands of artists from the 1960s to today: Grateful Dead, Billy Strings, Goose, String Cheese Incident, and so many more.
Discover. Search by artist, taper, venue, festival, date, or song. Browse recent shows or dive deep into decades of music.
Listen your way. Let Infinite Shuffle keep the music going, queue up what's next with Play Next and Add to Queue, or hand off playback between your devices. Stream over Bluetooth and AirPlay, in lossless FLAC if you like. Set a sleep timer to drift off. Scrobble to Last.fm or Libre.fm.
Take it on the road. CarPlay puts your shows right on the dash, and Siri starts them hands-free: just say "Play a show on Live Music Archive."
See the music. The visualizer turns any concert into a live light show that reacts to every note. And the whole app comes in Light or Dark.
Always have something to listen to. Download shows for offline play. Offline Refresh automatically swaps out finished shows for new ones, so your library stays fresh, even without a connection.
Make it yours. Favorite artists, shows, tapers, and venues sync across your devices and your archive.org account. Track your listening history. Share concerts with friends.
Terms and Conditions: https://livemusicarchive.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://livemusicarchive.app/privacy

bluejetty:00079367:ios.description:
BNB Remit is a cutting-edge mobile banking initiative introduced by Bhutan National Bank Ltd.,
specifically designed to meet the remittance requirements of Bhutanese citizens living abroad,
referred to as BLA. This innovative application serves as a seamless solution for receiving
inward remittances, guaranteeing fast and secure transactions for BLA individuals. By
integrating innovative payment features, BNB Remit ensures swift money transfers, allowing
BLA members to effortlessly receive funds directly into their bank accounts. This user-friendly
solution simplifies money transfers between loved ones, even across significant distances,
fostering seamless connectivity.
 In the realm of remittance services, BNB Remit stands out for its ability to provide fast, secure,
and easily accessible fund transfer options, automated incentive payout, higher transaction
limits and lower transfer fees.
Key Features:
a. Instant Registration: Seamlessly register using your phone number.
b. Real-Time Exchange Rates: Stay updated with dynamically adjusted exchange rates on a daily basis.
c. Beneficiary Addition: Easily add the account details of your loved ones or your personal account for seamless transactions.
d. Secure Fund Transfers: Conveniently and securely send money to desired recipients.

bluejetty:00184273:ios.description:
The Beacon Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Beacon Community Mobile customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Beacon Mobile App, you must be enrolled as an Beacon Community Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

AUSTRALIA - HAZARD PERCEPTION TEST APP
Hazard Perception Test 2026 AU is a practice and study app for the Official Hazard Perception Test in Australia.
Top Features:
#1. Official Revision Clips
Get the 36 HPT real test questions. You can practice videos for any state in Australia.
#2. Clear and Helpful Explanation
All the revision clips are up to date with the official test and regulations currently in Australia. You will get an explanation after each perception test to get you ready for the real test.
#3. Suitable for Everyone
Hazard Perception Test 2026 AU is suitable for driving test learners from New South Wales (NSW), Victoria (VIC), South Australia (SA), Western Australia (WA), Tasmania (TAS), Queensland (QLD) and Northern Territories (NT). The Hazard Perception Test is compulsory in most states in Australia and territories for driving test learners, P1 and P2 license holders. This app is a must if you want to take your driver knowledge test or your learner permit test.
Key Highlights:
• Practice for the hazard perception test NSW, VIC and QLD
• 6 Free practice test videos with 30 more to unlock.
• All revision clips and perception test videos.
• Study with thousands of driver licence learners from Australia!
• Real interactive videos to get familiar with the real test questions.
• Get instant results after each exam question.
• Detailed dashboard to identify your strengths and weaknesses.
• Don’t need driving license school anymore!
• Dark mode to study at night!
Why choose HPT Test AU? 
• We make the HPT preparation easy.
• We help you pass the exam quick and get a perfect score!
• We help every hazards test taker to shorten their licence study.
• We give you the tools to get a perfect score for the Australian driving test.
• We cover all topics of the HPT test such as Reflex activities, Crossing lanes, Night driving, and Overtaking.
Contact Us:
Visit Our Website: https://hpt-au.pineapplestudio.com.au/
Email: support-mobile@pineapplestudio.com.au
Connect on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pineapplecoding/
Subscription Option:
Hazard Perception Test 2026 AU offers a single subscription to suit everyone's needs. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan below:
• One-month plan: AUD 4.99
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: https://hpt-au.pineapplestudio.com.au/hazard-perception-test-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://hpt-au.pineapplestudio.com.au/hazard-perception-test-terms-conditions.html
Good luck on your Hazard Perception Test!
The Pineapple Studio Team

bluejetty:00127976:ios.description:
Become the owner of the town in the game Homesteads!
Create an ideal place to live in the Wild West! Plant and harvest, take care of animals and produce the materials you need for farming. Sell and exchange goods to develop your town. Build houses, factories and other structures to increase the comfort of residents.
Don't forget about the comfort of the town - use an incredible variety of decorations to create your dream city. Invite friends and help your new neighbors. Exchange gifts and take part in exciting adventures together. Exciting quests and stories from the Wild West are waiting for you!
Homesteads features:
 - Interact with unique game mechanics: catch criminals in the town, don't let them spread panic among townspeople. Try your luck in the Saloon. Open mines and quarries. Send ships for unique overseas delicacies.
 - Unlimited space for design solutions: create a metropolis in the Wild West, decorate the city at your discretion and make it unique. 
 - Meet friendly characters with a unique story of life. They will help you navigate the game and provide their services for the production of goods. 
 - Playing together is more fun - invite friends, help your neighbors and exchange gifts.
Homesteads is a game with unique mechanics, graphics and characters. You will meet new friends and take part in exciting adventures in the vast expanses of the Wild West!
Hurry up to download the game! Try on a cowboy hat and bring order to the town!

bluejetty:00027629:ios.description:
Excited for fun university activities? My City: University is where you should be.
Go and meet new student friends in this interactive university.
This game is a fully interactive university wherein you can learn together with your student friends.
Play mini-games and attend lots of classes like science, painting, art, music, and even roleplay as a teacher.
Explore areas in the university and discover lots of school games. Dress-up and enjoy breaktime by eating with your friends in the school cafeteria, it's like you're in a restaurant.
■ University Lobby - Unlock secrets and design your own school lobby.
■ Art Classroom - Be the best student at the university by showing
everyone your painting skills. If you like painting, this room will be your favorite.
■ Music Classroom - Play with lots of musical instruments with other students.
■ Science Classroom - Explore, discover as you roleplay a scientist.
■ School Hallway—Meet new students and teachers while playing school games.
■ Cafeteria - Enjoy your break time with lots of foods to buy in the school restaurant.
■ Outdoor Park - School games are fun outdoors. Explore mini-games together with your teacher and other students.
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames

bluejetty:00141636:ios.summary:

WHAT PRODUCTS TO BUY

bluejetty:00141636:ios.description:
The My Lawn app from Scotts simplifies lawn care by creating an easy-to-follow lawn maintenance plan so you know the right products to use at the right time.
KEY FEATURES:
WHAT PRODUCTS TO BUY
Create a lawn care plan for product recommendations. My Lawn will generate a personalized lawn care plan based on your grass type, location, lawn size, and lawn conditions.
WHEN TO APPLY PRODUCTS
Based on product specifications and weather conditions, My Lawn will notify you when it is the perfect time to apply. Make sure you have push notifications enabled to get the notifications.
PURCHASE PRODUCTS
During the growing season, conveniently purchase all the Scotts products needed to care for your lawn for the rest of the season. Products will be delivered straight to your home with free shipping.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAN
Add or remove products within your lawn care plan. Within My Lawn, you have the option to add additional feed, seed, grub, and weed treatments to your plan.
CALCULATE LAWN SIZE 
Don’t know how much to purchase? Use the lawn size calculator in My Lawn. This tool will help you calculate the size of your lawn.
ASK SCOTTS FOR HELP 
Email or call the Scotts representatives for even more lawn care advice. Whether you have a question about how much product to use, or need help identifying and removing a specific type of weed, you’ll always have the knowledge of Scotts experts just a tap away.
LAWN CARE TIPS 
Access and read expert lawn care tips from the Scotts team and watch a library of helpful videos.
WATER TRACKING
Track and manage the amount of water your lawn gets each week by the automatic local rainfall totals and by manually adding when you water your lawn. We will notify you when your grass is in a dormant state when temperatures start to drop.
CALENDAR
Use the calendar to track lawn tasks like mowing, watering, and applying products. Set reminder push notifications so that My Lawn will notify you when it is time to complete your lawn tasks. Take notes and add pictures to your calendar of lawn results, spreader settings, or anything that may help you achieve your lawn goals!

bluejetty:00022668:ios.description:
Welcome to Vostok – your ultimate companion for crafting captivating stories and stunning collages, designed to elevate your social media presence! With Vostok, transforming your ideas into professional-grade posts and stories is now a breeze.
Whether you're a blogger, photographer, or simply love sharing your life's moments on social media, Vostok provides all the tools you need to create content that will make an impact. Our sleek and user-friendly app seamlessly combines your passion for photography and storytelling, offering a dynamic platform to showcase your awe-inspiring moments.
Embracing a minimalist style, Vostok becomes your canvas for unlimited creativity. A vast collection of templates, stickers, and effects empowers you to design unique stories that reflect your individuality.
But Vostok goes beyond creative freedom; it's all about simplicity. Our intuitive interface makes editing and sharing your content effortless, freeing up more time for you to focus on crafting compelling narratives that your followers will adore.
No more waiting! Embark on your Vostok journey today and craft captivating posts and stories that leave a lasting impression!
Here's a glimpse of some of our features:
· 200+ design templates for social media
· Exclusive fonts with Cyrillic support
· 450+ unique stickers
· Atmospheric dust and grain effects for photos
· Variety of backgrounds: paper textures, marble, gradients, colors
· Ad-free with no subscription requirements
· Dark mode compatibility
Recognized as one of the Best Apps of 2019 by Apple.
With over 200+ templates, Vostok is your go-to toolkit for creating standout social media content.
We eagerly look forward to your ideas and feedback.
Connect with us at hello@vostokapp.ru or drop us a direct message on Instagram at @vostokapp.

bluejetty:00023388:ios.description:
Disneyland Wait Times since 2009, Genie Plus info, real-time food blog, information on hours, events, upNEXT showtimes, California Adventure, and Downtown Disney. Everything you need for your next trip to the Disneyland Resort!
Join 3 MILLION users and discover why 15 out of 17 people use MouseWait as their primary Disneyland app. Since 2009, MouseWait has been the most popular and critically acclaimed Disneyland App.
INTRODUCING THE FIRST AI POWERED AMUSEMENT PARK VIRTUAL ASSISTANT!
Introducing Kate, your personal Virtual Plaid!
MouseWait is still free. I haven't put any existing features behind a paywall, and we’ve even added some new ones. However, to continue development, we need to introduce a subscription model. Our new AI concierge incurs costs for each chat, so this is our only viable option!
This is your chance to have your own Virtual Plaid! This subscription unlocks all MouseWait Apps, including Disney World and the lounge.land app (coming soon).
Here's how a MouseWait ALL-ACCESS subscription will pay for itself:
EFFORTLESS DINING RESERVATIONS: Easily check available reservations while Kate helps you find open reservations for hard-to-get restaurants. She'll send you a push notification if she finds an open reservation for your desired restaurant.
INSIDER TIPS: Based on 13 years of MouseWait park data.
SAVE TIME AND MONEY: Gain exclusive access to the lounge.land vacation club, our private forum that scours the web 24/7 for hard-to-find travel deals while assisting you in planning your next vacation!
UNLOCK ALL OF OUR APPS: Including Disney World (WDW Virtual Plaid coming soon), and our upcoming lounge.land vacation club app.
REAL-TIME ITINERARIES (beta): Your assistant will create a plan using breakthrough AI technology, which has been trained on 13 years of park data and vacation experience.
The best part? You can chat with your Plaid about your plan, play trivia with her, and ask as many questions as you'd like using natural language!
Your time is valuable. Imagine getting everything you need for your trip in just a few voice commands to your Virtual Plaid personal assistant. This includes finding the best price, optimal travel time, insider tips, and more. 
The Huffington Post acknowledged MouseWait as one of the three "Disneyland Musts You Shouldn't Be Without"
OCWeekly named MouseWait as one of the OC's best apps, "Whether you're a Disneyland Annual Passport Holder or a casual Disneyland visitor, this is a must for everyone."
"One of the 26 Apps You Need To Survive In Los Angeles" BuzzFeed
"MouseWait provides a wealth of information for both casual and frequent visitors to the Disneyland Resort. It does exactly what it claims and more, and it does it extremely well. If you have plans to visit the Disneyland Resort in the future, or are an Annual Passholder, this app is an absolute must." Danny Amezcua, Macworld
+Make new friends with Disney fans worldwide in our family-friendly moderated social Lounge.
+Save time and money with tips and info you won't find anywhere else.
+Fast access to our proprietary Historical Crowd Index
- If you're having a problem with the app or have feedback, email us at support@mousewait.com
AS SEEN ON TV: Ryan Seacrest, Leo Laporte, CBS, KCAL, KTLA News, FRONT PAGE of the Press Enterprise, LA Times, OC Register, OCWeekly, Macworld, PCWorld, TMZ, E!, People Magazine, & OrangeCoast Magazine
"If Walt would have created an app, I have to think it would be something like this." Karate Kidd
"Lots of features, super-fast email support for questions" DavidRac
"Love how I can get all the info I need in one place" stimpy0323
"This app has tons of features, it will be great to use on vacation or just checking in on the latest Disney news" Jen's Music
Follow us @mousewait for Disneyland updates.
Privacy Policy: https://mousewait.org/privacy-policy/
Terms of use: https://mousewait.org/TOS
MouseWait is not affiliated with the Walt Disney Company.

bluejetty:00093509:ios.description:
If you're in Melbourne, Australia, find out when your tram is coming via your iPhone device. tramTRACKER® provides digital passenger information including predicted tram arrival times, disruption updates, and information about Melbourne's tram network.
tramTRACKER features:
* Add favourite routes and receive push notifications if your route is disrupted 
* App widget 
* Tram and stop alarms 
* Browse by Route, Nearby, Search by name/suburb, Most Recent or tram/stop ID
* View scheduled timetables
* Use the myTRAM feature to track your tram along its journey 
* Filter display by route number and low-floor trams
* Get disruption and service updates
* See next low-floor and air conditioned trams
* Route-based stop lists on a built-in route map
For more information, visit yarratrams.com.au/tramtracker
For scheduled services on trains, trams and buses, download the Public Transport Victoria app.
Your feedback is important to constantly improve this application. Submit your feedback at yarratrams.com.au or call 1800 800 007 6am-midnight (all night Friday & Saturday)
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00027041:ios.description:
The range of size in the universe, from the tiniest particles to the epic galaxies - we take you on a journey of size that lets you explore it all with a single swipe. How big is a planet, compared to a human? And how small is an atom really? You can’t fully wrap your head around the scope of things by just reading about them – so this app lets you experience them in comparison to get a feeling for their true scale. By simply swiping you can zoom in and out all the way from the world of fundamental particles up to the largest stars at the edge of the observable universe. 
Seamless zooming between the scales of 10^-35 meters to 10^26 meters (no math required) 
Amazing fun facts for various scale levels, like the smallest bacterium and the largest black hole 
Tap any object for an explanation of what it is and how it works
Beautifully animated illustration of more than 250 objects
Original Kurzgesagt music to complement your experience

bluejetty:00178827:ios.description:
Become an army general and profit from your troops by managing your army base game like a tycoon. It’s a rollercoaster ride - no need to tap and tap or click and click - just invest, train your troops and win wars.
Don’t be idle! Use the cash and gold profits that you make to invest and boost your troops and unlock new zones in this idle game. Then go to war and conquer the world like a tycoon capitalist and become rich with all the idle profits and cash you can earn.
FEATURES
Automate the troops training to invest and increase your idle game income. Don’t idel, but idle!
Earn idle cash and make profit, even when you are offline in this game - like a tycoon!
Hire army managers for your idle army base to increase your troops work and motivation
Enjoy the adventure, no need to tap and click or be a tapper or a clicker in this game.
Become an army idle base millionaire or even a billionaire!
Grow your army empire like a tycoon and become rich with loads of cash and gold!
Profit from upgrading your game zones and hiring more troops to train to become rich!
Like a simulator, use the right idle tycoon game strategy to earn cash and profit.
Prestige, expand and grow your idle army base, both online and offline.
Can you use the right strategy become an idle army tycoon, capitalist, millionaire or billionaire and strike gold?!
This is not a clicker or tapper game, you just need to invest like a tycoon in your army base, to make more cash, gold and profit to invest in your army and troop empire to command and conquer the whole world. Enjoy the adventure!
Increase your earnings, cash, gold and profit - either online or offline earnings.
Build your idle millionaire empire by investing in the right zones and idle troops, so you can earn profit and maximise the workflow in this idle manager game - a bit like an online clicker simulator, but no need to click or tap.
Gain cash resources, gold and revenue in this army tycoon simulation game.
This is war! This isn’t something traditional like a supermarket, mine, police station, TV station or rollercoaster ride! This is an idle army base and as a manager, you’re going to become rich like a capitalist millionaire tycoon - full or wealth, cash and gold.
No internet connection needed to play this idle tycoon empire game.
Automate your idle troops by investing in managers so your can earn profits like a tycoon
Profit like a tycoon from rich money investments to boost your economy, win cash and become a rich millionaire.
No need to clash here as you send your idle troops off to war to earn big cash and gold. This is no ordinary money idle game. 
Areas to unlock include:
EXERCISE YARD - no time to idle here - do sit ups like a successful millionaire tycoon!
URBAN WARFARE - can you manage to SWAT your way?! Like being in the police.
JUNGLE WARFARE - it’s an adventure in the jungle with a capitalist copter at your disposal
ARCTIC WARFARE - game on…profit from your snow stealth
HEAVY MACHINE GUN - hear the tap, tap, tap of heavy machine-guns
HEAVY ARTILLERY - click, click, click, boom, boom! Unlock the big guns!
CHEMICAL WARFARE - no mines here, but wear your mask.
TANKS - a tank shell could make a mine shaft with a big tap, tap, tap - a lot of prestige!
DESERT WARFARE - racing, racing, racing your way around the desert course
NAVAL WARFARE - you might need to be a tycoon to afford a boat, but this could help your become an army base millionaire
EXPLOSIVE TRAINING - manage your grenades with cash in this idle game. You don’t want to go to prison for this one!
PARATROOPER - your evolution from a cadet will be needed as you free fall from your plane and land in the target zone. Tycoons need not apply!
OBSTACLE COURSE - a real adventure for you idle capitalists out there - life is a rollercoaster in this army base tycoon simulator game.
— Your Idle Army Base team —

games@neonplay.com

Zoom for calls. Slack for chat. Google Voice for the phone number. Teams for... wait, why do you have Teams?
Phound gives you calls business calling, messaging, video conferencing, and AI in one app — nothing lost, no app switching, no asking clients to download something just to talk.
Every conversation. One place.
——— WHO IT'S FOR
Teams of all sizes run on Phound. Solo professionals and freelancers who need a real business phone number without the enterprise overhead. Small teams done paying separately for Slack, Zoom, and Google Voice. Growing businesses that want AI summaries, team calling, and broadcast messaging in one place, not four subscriptions. And enterprises that need real control: SSO, centralized admin, dedicated support, and fleet oversight to monitor, manage, and analyze every call across the team.
Start free. Upgrade to Pro at $9.99/month.
——— WHAT YOU GET
Real phone number with voicemail and SMS
Get a US phone number with voicemail transcription and text messaging (SMS/MMS). Call and text anyone — clients, leads, anyone outside your org — without asking them to install a thing. Keep work and personal on one device.
Crystal-clear calling
Make and receive calls from any device. Hand off a call from your laptop to your phone without dropping it. Call anyone in the US, Canada, and Mexico — not just other Phound users.
Team messaging + SMS in one place
Chat 1:1 or in groups. Text customers directly from your Phound number. Every conversation — teammates and clients — lives in one thread, right alongside your calls and meetings.
Video meetings up to 500 participants
Run meetings without switching apps. Record, transcribe, and get AI-generated summaries with action items automatically. Up to 500 participants on Pro and Business.
AI that's woven through everything
Call summaries. Meeting transcripts with action items. Visual voicemail you can read instead of listen to. Phound's AI isn't a bolt-on — it's built into every call, meeting, and message.
Broadcast messaging with Phound Wave
Send voice and text broadcasts to your contacts from your existing Phound number. Replies come back as regular conversations. Perfect for churches, nonprofits, and teams — no extra login, no separate subscription.
——— THE PLANS
Phound Basic (free): Unlimited Phound-to-Phound calling and video. Meetings up to 100 participants. Basic AI meeting summaries. Add a voice-only phone line for $4.95/month.
Phound Pro — $9.99/user/month: Real external phone number, SMS/MMS (North America), advanced AI (call summaries + meeting Q&A + voicemail transcription), and video meetings up to 500 participants.
Phound Business — $18/user/month: Everything in Pro, plus smart IVR (Phound Flows), shared numbers, business voicemail, an AI personal assistant, team conversation summaries, advanced analytics, and an admin dashboard. ~25% nonprofit and church discount available.
Phound Enterprise: Custom contracts, dedicated support, SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and HIPAA/compliance support.
———
Start free at phound.app. Full stack from Pro at $9.99/month.
Subscriptions auto-renew. Manage in Settings. Terms apply.
Terms of Service: https://phound.app/tos
Privacy Policy: https://phound.app/privacy
